translations.source: "Sasa tuna panya wenye umri wa miezi minne ambao hawana kisukari ambao awali walikuwa na kisukari", aliongeza.
translations.reference: "We now have 4-month-old mice that are non-diabetic that used to be diabetic," he added.
translations.hypothesis: "We now have four-month-old mice that are glucose normal, whereas they would have otherwise developed diabetes," he added.

translations.source: Dak. Ehud Ur, profesa wa udaktari katika chuo kikuu cha Dalhousie kule Halifix, Nova Scotia na mwenyekiti wa kitengo cha kliniki na kisayansi kwenye ushirika wa ugonjwa wa kisukari nchini Canada alionya kuwa utafiti bado uko kwenye siku za mapema.
translations.reference: Dr. Ehud Ur, professor of medicine at Dalhousie University in Halifax, Nova Scotia and chair of the clinical and scientific division of the Canadian Diabetes Association cautioned that the research is still in its early days.
translations.hypothesis: Dr Ehud Ur, Professor of Medicine at Dalhousie University in Halifax, Nova Scotia and Chair of the Canadian Diabetes Association’s Clinical and Scientific Committee, warned that the research is still in its early days.

translations.source: Kama wataalam wengine, ana shaka kuhusu kama ugonjwa wa kisukari unaweza kutibiwa, akagundua kuwa matokeo haya hayana umuhimu kwa watu ambao tayari wana ugojwa wa kisukari wa aina 1.
translations.reference: Like some other experts, he is skeptical about whether diabetes can be cured, noting that these findings have no relevance to people who already have Type 1 diabetes.
translations.hypothesis: Like other experts, he is doubtful that diabetes can be cured, noting that the results are less impressive in people who already have type 1 diabetes.

translations.source: Mnamo Jumatatu, Sara Danius, katibu wa kudumu wa Kamati ya Nobel ya Fasihi katika Chuo cha Uswidi, alitangaza hadharani wakati wa kipindi cha redio kwenye Sveriges Radio katika Uswidi kwamba kamati hiyo, kwa kutoweza kumfikia Bob Dylan moja kwa moja kuhusu ushindi wa Tuzo la Nobel la Fasihi 2016, iliacha juhudi zake za kujaribu kumfikia.
translations.reference: On Monday, Sara Danius, permanent secretary of the Nobel Committee for Literature at the Swedish Academy, publicly announced during a radio program on Sveriges Radio in Sweden the committee, unable to reach Bob Dylan directly about winning the 2016 Nobel Prize in Literature, had abandoned its efforts to reach him.
translations.hypothesis: On Monday, Sara Danius, the permanent secretary of the Swedish Academy, announced during a live radio show on Sveriges Radio in Sweden that the academy, unable to reach Bob Dylan directly regarding his 2016 Nobel Prize in Literature, had given up trying to contact him.

translations.source: Danius alisema, "Sasa hivi hatufanyi chochote. Nimepiga simu na kutuma barua pepe kwa mshirika wake wa karibu na kupata majibu ya kirafiki sana. Kwa sasa, hakika hiyo imetosha."
translations.reference: Danius said, "Right now we are doing nothing. I have called and sent emails to his closest collaborator and received very friendly replies. For now, that is certainly enough."
translations.hypothesis: "For now, we're doing nothing. I have spoken to his senior partner and got a very positive response. For now, that's enough," Delius said.

translations.source: Hapo awali, Mkurugenzi Mtendaji wa Ring, Jamie Siminoff, alitamka kampuni hiyo ilianza wakati kengele yake ya mlangoni haikuwa inasikika katika duka lake kwenye karakana yake.
translations.reference: Previously, Ring's CEO, Jamie Siminoff, remarked the company started when his doorbell wasn't audible from his shop in his garage.
translations.hypothesis: Previously, Ring's CEO, Jamie Siminoff, said the company got its start when his doorbell camera malfunctioned in his apartment.

translations.source: Aliunda kengele ya mlango ya Wi-Fi, alisema.
translations.reference: He built a WiFi door bell, he said.
translations.hypothesis: He created a Wi-Fi doorbell, he said.

translations.source: Siminoff alisema mauzo yaliongezeka baada ya yeye kuonekana katika kipindi cha Shark Tank mnamo 2013 ambapo paneli ya onyesho hilo ilikataa kufadhili biashara hiyo mpya.
translations.reference: Siminoff said sales boosted after his 2013 appearance in a Shark Tank episode where the show panel declined funding the startup.
translations.hypothesis: Siminoff said sales increased after he appeared on the reality show Shark Tank in 2013, where the show's panel declined to fund his startup.

translations.source: Baadaye 2017, Siminoff alionekana katika chaneli ya ununuzi ya televisheni QVC.
translations.reference: In late 2017, Siminoff appeared on shopping television channel QVC.
translations.hypothesis: Later in 2017, Siminoff appeared on the QVC shopping channel.

translations.source: Ring pia alitatua mashtaka ya kampuni pinzani ya usalama, Shirika la ADT.
translations.reference: Ring also settled a lawsuit with competing security company, the ADT Corporation.
translations.hypothesis: Ring is also embroiled in a legal battle with security company, ADT.

translations.source: Huku chanjo moja ya majaribio ikionekana kupunguza vifo kutokana na Ebola, hadi kufikia sasa, hakuna dawa zimeonyeshwa dhahiri kufaa kutibu maambukizo yaliyoko.
translations.reference: While one experimental vaccine appears able to reduce Ebola mortality, up until now, no drugs have been clearly demonstrated suitable for treating existing infection.
translations.hypothesis: While one of the vaccines has been shown to reduce deaths from Ebola, to date, no drug has been shown to conclusively treat the infection.

translations.source: Kinywaji kimoja cha kingamwili, ZMapp, hapo awali kilionyesha ahadi uwanjani, lakini tafiti rasmi zilionyesha kilikuwa na faida kidogo kuliko ilivyotafutwa katika kuzuia kifo.
translations.reference: One antibody cocktail, ZMapp, initially showed promise in the field, but formal studies indicated it had less benefit than sought in preventing death.
translations.hypothesis: One monoclonal antibody, ZMapp, previously showed promise in the field, but a formal study indicated it had little effect on mortality.

translations.source: Katika jaribio la PALM, Zmapp ilitumika kama kidhibiti, kumaanisha wanasayansi waliitumia kama msingi na kulinganisha matibabu mengine matatu nayo.
translations.reference: In the PALM trial, ZMapp served as a control, meaning scientists used it as a baseline and compared the three other treatments to it.
translations.hypothesis: In the PALM trial, ZMapp was used as the control, meaning scientists used it as a baseline and compared the other three treatments to it.

translations.source: USA Gymnastics hukubali barua ya Kamati ya Olimpiki ya Marekani na hukubali hitaji kuu la familia ya Olimpiki la kukuza mazingira salama kwa wanariadha wetu wote.
translations.reference: USA Gymnastics supports the United States Olympic Committee's letter and accepts the absolute need of the Olympic family to promote a safe environment for all of our athletes.
translations.hypothesis: USA Gymnastics acknowledges the letter from the United States Olympic & Paralympic Committee and affirms its commitment to the Olympic family’s priority to create a safe environment for all athletes.

translations.source: Tunakubaliana na taarifa ya USOC kwamba masilahi ya wanariadha na vilabu vyetu, na spoti yao, huenda yakashughulikiwa vyema kwa kusonga mbele na mabadiliko ya maana ndani ya shirika letu, badala ya kughairi vyeti.
translations.reference: We agree with the USOC's statement that the interests of our athletes and clubs, and their sport, may be better served by moving forward with meaningful change within our organization, rather than decertification.
translations.hypothesis: We agree with the USOC that the interests of our athletes and our federations, and their sports, will be better served by moving forward with meaningful reforms within our organization, rather than by decertification.

translations.source: USA Gymnastics inaunga mkono uchunguzi huru ambao labda utafafanua jinsi unyanyasaji wa kiwango kama vile ulivyoelezewa kwa ujasiri sana na manusura wa Larry Nassar ungekosa kugunduliwa kwa muda mrefu hivyo na inakumbatia mabadiliko muhimu na ya kufaa.
translations.reference: USA Gymnastics supports an independent investigation that may shine light on how abuse of the proportion described so courageously by the survivors of Larry Nassar could have gone undetected for so long and embraces any necessary and appropriate changes.
translations.hypothesis: USA Gymnastics supports the independent investigation that will hopefully determine how abuse on the scale described by the survivors of Larry Nassar could have gone undetected for so long and embraces the significant and positive changes that are already underway.

translations.source: USA Gymnastics na USOC zina lengo moja — kuifanya spoti ya sarakasi, na nyingine, salama iwezekanavyo ili wanariadha wafuate ndoto zao katika mazingira salama, chanya na ya kuwezesha.
translations.reference: USA Gymnastics and the USOC have the same goal — making the sport of gymnastics, and others, as safe as possible for athletes to follow their dreams in a safe, positive and empowered environment.
translations.hypothesis: USA Gymnastics and the USOC share a vision of making gymnastics a safer sport, and one where athletes can pursue their dreams in a safe, positive and supportive environment.

translations.source: Katika miaka yote ya 1960, Brzezinski alimfanyia kazi John F. Kennedy kama mshauri wake na pia utawala wa Lyndon B. Johnson.
translations.reference: Throughout 1960s, Brzezinski worked for John F. Kennedy as his advisor and then the Lyndon B. Johnson administration.
translations.hypothesis: In the 1960s, Brzezinski worked for John F. Kennedy as his foreign policy advisor and also for Lyndon B. Johnson's administration.

translations.source: Wakati wa uteuzi wa 1976, alimshauri Carter kuhusu sera ya nje, kisha akafanya kazi kama Mshauri wa Usalama wa Kitaifa (NSA) kutoka 1977 hadi 1981, na alichukua hatamu kutoka kwa Henry Kissinger.
translations.reference: During the 1976 selections he advised Carter on foreign policy, then served as National Security Advisor (NSA) from 1977 to 1981, succeeding Henry Kissinger.
translations.hypothesis: During the 1976 election, he advised Carter on foreign policy, and then served as National Security Advisor (NSA) from 1977 to 1981, taking over from Henry Kissinger.

translations.source: Kama NSA, alimsaidia Carter katika kushughulikia masuala ya dunia kidiplomasia, kama vile Mikataba ya Kambi David, 1978; kurekebisha uhusiano wa Marekani na China mwishoni mwa miaka ya 1970; Mapinduzi ya Irani, ambayo yalipelekea janga la mateka la Irani, 1979; na shambulio la Kisovyeti katika Afganistani, 1979.
translations.reference: As NSA, he assisted Carter in diplomatically handling world affairs, such as the Camp David Accords, 1978; normalizing US–China relations thought the late 1970s; the Iranian Revolution, which led to the Iran hostage crisis, 1979; and the Soviet invasion in Afghanistan, 1979.
translations.hypothesis: As NSA, he assisted Carter in dealing with several international crises, such as the Camp David Accords, 1978; the normalization of relations between the United States and China in the late 1970s; the Iranian Revolution, which led to the Iran hostage crisis in 1979; and the Soviet invasion of Afghanistan in 1979.

translations.source: Sinema, iliyoshirikisha Ryan Gosling na Emma Stone ilipata uteuzi katika kategoria zote kuu.
translations.reference: The movie, featuring Ryan Gosling and Emma Stone, received nominations in all major categories.
translations.hypothesis: The movie, which stars Ryan Gosling and Emma Stone, received nominations in all major categories.

translations.source: Gosling na Stone walipokea uteuzi wa Muigizaji na Mwigizaji wa kike Bora mtawalia.
translations.reference: Gosling and Stone received nominations for Best Actor and Actress respectively.
translations.hypothesis: Gosling and Stone received the nominations for Best Actor and Best Actress respectively.

translations.source: Uteuzi mwingine unahusisha Picha, Mwelekezi, Sinema, Muundo wa Mavazi, Uhariri wa Filamu, Alama ya Asili, Muundo wa Uzalishaji, Uhariri wa Sauti, Uchanganyaji wa Sauti na Mchezo Halisi wa Skrini Bora.
translations.reference: The other nominations include Best Picture, Director, Cinematography, Costume Design, Film-editing, Original Score, Production Design, Sound Editing, Sound Mixing and Original Screenplay.
translations.hypothesis: Other categories include Photography, Directing, Cinematography, Costume Design, Film Editing, Makeup Design, Production Design, Sound Design, Sound Mixing and Best Visual Effects.

translations.source: Nyimbo mbili kutoka kwa sinema, Audition (The Fools Who Dream) na Mji wa Nyota, zilipendekezwa kuwa nyimbo bora asilia. Studio ya Lionsgate ilipendekezwa mara 26 – zaidi ya studio nyingine yoyote.
translations.reference: Two songs from the movie, Audition (The Fools Who Dream) and City of Stars, received nominations for best original song. Lionsgate studio received 26 nominations — more than any other studio.
translations.hypothesis: Two songs from the movie, Audition (The Fools Who Dream) and City of Stars, were nominated for Best Original Song. Lionsgate Studio received 26 nominations – more than any other studio.

translations.source: Mwishoni mwa Jumapili, Rais wa Marekani Donald Trump, katika taarifa iliyowasilishwa kupitia katibu wa uandishi wa habari, alitangaza kwamba vikosi vya Marekani vitaondoka Siria.
translations.reference: Late on Sunday, the United States President Donald Trump, in a statement delivered via the press secretary, announced US troops would be leaving Syria.
translations.hypothesis: On Sunday, the U.S. President Donald Trump, in a statement released through the office of the press secretary, announced that U.S. forces would withdraw from Syria.

translations.source: Tangazo lilifanywa baada ya Trump kuwa na mazungumzo ya simu na Rais wa Uturuki Recep Tayyip Erdogan.
translations.reference: The announcement was made after Trump had a phone conversation with Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan.
translations.hypothesis: The announcement was made after a phone call between Trump and Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan.

translations.source: Uturuki ilikua yachukua ulinzi wa wapiganaji wa ISIS waliotekwa ambao, tangazo lilisema kuwa, nchi za Ulaya zilikataa kurudi.
translations.reference: Turkey would also take over guarding captured ISIS fighters which, the statement said, European nations have refused to repatriate.
translations.hypothesis: Turkey had already detained some suspected ISIS fighters that European countries refused to take back, the announcement said.

translations.source: Hii haithibitishi tu kuwa baadhi ya dinosaria walikuwa na manyoya, nadharia ambayo tayari imezagaa, bali pia inatoa maelezo ambayo kijumla visukuku haviwezi, kama vile rangi na mpangilio wa pande-tatu.
translations.reference: This not only confirms that at least some dinosaurs had feathers, a theory already widespread, but provides details fossils generally cannot, such as color and three-dimensional arrangement.
translations.hypothesis: This not only confirms that some dinosaurs had feathers, a theory that has already been circulating, but also provides information that is not available from fossils, such as coloration and the three-dimensional arrangement of the feathers.

translations.source: . Wanasayansi wanasema manyoya ya mnyama huyu yalikuwa ya rangi ya kahawia-nyekundu upande wa juu na hafifu au rangi ya karotini upande wa chini.
translations.reference: . Scientists say this animal's plumage was chestnut-brown on top with a pale or carotenoid-colored underside.
translations.hypothesis: Scientists say the animal's fur was reddish-brown on top and light or yellowish-orange below.

translations.source: Utambuzi huo pia unatoa ufahamu wa mageuko ya manyoya katika ndege.
translations.reference: The find also grants insight into the evolution of feathers in birds.
translations.hypothesis: The identification also provides insights into the evolution of feathers in birds.

translations.source: Kwa sababu manyoya ya dinosau hayana chimbuko uliyostawishwa vizuri, inayoitwa rachi, lakini huwa na sifa zingine za manyoya — barbu na barbule — watafiti waligundua rachi labda ni maendeleo ya baadaye ya uvumbuzi kuliko sifa hizi nyingine.
translations.reference: Because the dinosaur feathers do not have a well-developed shaft, called a rachis, but do have other features of feathers — barbs and barbules — the researchers inferred the rachis was likely a later evolutionary development that these other features.
translations.hypothesis: Because the feathers of dinosaurs are not well preserved, the rachis, which is the central shaft of the feather, but they do have other features of feathers — barbs and barbules — researchers have discovered that the rachis is probably a later evolutionary development than these other features.

translations.source: Muundo wa manyoya unaonyesha kwamba hayakutumika katika kupeperuka bali yalitumiwa kudhibiti joto au uonyesho. Watafiti walipendekeza kwamba, ingawa huu ni mkia wa dinosauri mchanga, sampuli inaonyesha manyoya ya utu uzima na si manyoya laini ya ndani ya kifaranga.
translations.reference: The feathers' structure suggests that they were not used in flight but rather for temperature regulation or display. The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
translations.hypothesis: The feather structure indicates that they were not used for flight but for insulation or display. The researchers suggested that, although this is a juvenile dinosaur, the specimen indicates that feathers were more widespread than previously thought, and not just restricted to birds.

translations.source: Watafiti walipendekeza kwamba, hata kama huu ni mkia wa dinosau mdogo, sampuli hiyo inaonyesha manyoya ya ukubwa na si manyoya ya kifaranga mdogo.
translations.reference: The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
translations.hypothesis: The researchers suggested that, even if this is a juvenile dinosaur, the specimen shows a level of maturity and is unlikely to be a young chick.

translations.source: Bomu la gari lililolipuliwa katika hedikota ya polisi katika Gaziantep, Uturuki jana asubuhi liliwaua maafisa wawili wa polisi na kuwajeruhi watu wengine zaidi ya ishirini.
translations.reference: A car bomb detonated at police headquarters in Gaziantep, Turkey yesterday morning killed two police officers and injured more than twenty other people.
translations.hypothesis: A car bomb exploded outside a police headquarters in Gaziantep, Turkey yesterday morning, killing two police officers and injuring more than twenty other people.

translations.source: Ofisi ya Gavana ilisema kumi na tisa wa wale waliojeruhiwa walikuwa maafisa wa polisi.
translations.reference: The governor's office said nineteen of the injured were police officers.
translations.hypothesis: The Governor's office said nine of the injured were police officers.

translations.source: Polisi walisema wanashuku wanaodaiwa kuwa wanamgambo wa Daesh (ISIL) kwa kuhusika na shambulio hilo.
translations.reference: Police said they suspect an alleged Daesh (ISIL) militant of responsibility for the attack.
translations.hypothesis: Police said they suspected the attack was the work of the Islamic State (ISIL) group.

translations.source: Walipata kuwa Jua lilifanya kazi kwa kanuni msingi sawa na za nyota nyingine: Shuguli za nyota zote kwenye mfumo zilipatikana kuendeshwa na mng'ao wao, mzunguko wao na hakuna jingine.
translations.reference: They found the Sun operated on the same basic principles as other stars: The activity of all stars in the system was found to be driven by their luminosity, their rotation, and nothing else.
translations.hypothesis: They found that the Sun worked on the same basic principles as other stars: all stars in the universe are powered by the same forces, and their properties are determined by their mass, temperature, and nothing else.

translations.source: Mng'ao na mzunguko hutumika pamoja ili kuamua namba ya Rossby ya nyota, ambayo inahusiana na mtiririko wa utegili.
translations.reference: The luminosity and rotation are used together to determine a star's Rossby number, which is related to plasma flow.
translations.hypothesis: Brightness and color are used together to determine a star's spectral type, which is related to its temperature.

translations.source: Jinsi idadi ya Rossby inavyokuwa ndogo, ndivyo nyota zinapungua kuwa wa utendaji kwa kuzingatia mabadiliko ya sumaku.
translations.reference: The smaller the Rossby number, the less active the star with respect to magnetic reversals.
translations.hypothesis: The lower the Rossby number, the less the stars are affected by magnetic field changes.

translations.source: Wakati wa safari yake, Iwasaki alikumbwa na matata mara nyingi.
translations.reference: During his trip, Iwasaki ran into trouble on many occasions.
translations.hypothesis: During his journey, Iwasaki faced many difficulties.

translations.source: Aliporwa na maharamia, akashambuliwa huko Tibeti na mbwa mwenye kichaa, akakwepa ndoa katika Nepali na akakamatwa huko India.
translations.reference: He was robbed by pirates, attacked in Tibet by a rabid dog, escaped marriage in Nepal and was arrested in India.
translations.hypothesis: He was robbed by bandits, bitten by a rabid dog in Tibet, nearly married in Nepal, and arrested in India.

translations.source: Kiwango cha 802.11n hufanya kazi katika masafa ya gigahezi 2.4 na gigahezi 5.0.
translations.reference: The 802.11n standard operates on both the 2.4Ghz and 5.0Ghz frequencies.
translations.hypothesis: 802.11n standard operates on both 2.4 and 5.0 GHz bands.

translations.source: Hii itaiwezesha kutangamana kwa nyuma na 802.11a, 802.11b na 802.11g, mradi tu kituo cha ardhini kina redio mbili.
translations.reference: This will allow it to be backwards compatible with 802.11a, 802.11b and 802.11g, provided that the base station has dual radios.
translations.hypothesis: This will allow it to connect back to 802.11a, 802.11b and 802.11g networks, provided the base station has two radios.

translations.source: Kasi za 802.11n ni haraka sana kuliko zile za watangulizi wake zikiwa upeo wa kinadharia wa kiwango cha juu cha 600Mbit/s.
translations.reference: The speeds of 802.11n are substantially faster than that of its predecessors with a maximum theoretical throughput of 600Mbit/s.
translations.hypothesis: 802.11n speeds are significantly faster than its predecessors with a theoretical maximum bit rate of 600 Mbit/s.

translations.source: Duvall, ambaye ameolewa na ana watoto waliokomaa, hakuacha hisia kubwa kwa Miller, ambayehadithi ilimhusu.
translations.reference: Duvall, who is married with two adult children, did not leave a big impression on Miller, to whom the story was related.
translations.hypothesis: Duvall, who is married with grown children, had little in common with Miller, whom the story portrayed as a bachelor.

translations.source: Alipoambiwa atoe maoni, Miller alisema, "Mike huongea sana wakati wa kesi…nilikuwa najitayarisha kwa hivyo sikuwa ninasikia kwa kweli alichokuwa akisema."
translations.reference: When asked for comment, Miller said, "Mike talks a lot during the hearing...I was getting ready so I wasn't really hearing what he was saying."
translations.hypothesis: When asked for comment, Miller said, "Mike is very verbose during the hearing… I was prepared for that and I wasn’t really paying attention to what he was saying."

translations.source: "Tutajaribu kupunguza utoaji wa dayoksidi ya kaboni kwa kila kipimo cha GDP kwa kiwango muhimu kufikia 2020 kutoka kiwango cha 2005", Hu alisema.
translations.reference: "We will endeavour to cut carbon dioxide emissions per unit of GDP by a notable margin by 2020 from the 2005 level," Hu said.
translations.hypothesis: "We will try to reduce carbon dioxide emissions per unit of GDP by 40% to 45% by 2020 from 2005 levels," Hu said.

translations.source: Hakuweka kiwango cha kukatwa, akisema itafanywa kulingana na pato la kiuchumi la China.
translations.reference: He did not set a figure for the cuts, saying they will be made based on China's economic output.
translations.hypothesis: He did not set a specific target for the reduction, saying it would be based on China's economic performance.

translations.source: Hu aliimiza nchi zinazokua “kuepuka njia ya kitambo ya kuchafua kwanza na kusafisha baadaye.’’
translations.reference: Hu encouraged developing countries "to avoid the old path of polluting first and cleaning up later."
translations.hypothesis: Hu urged countries to "avoid the old path of first polluting and then cleaning up."

translations.source: Aliongeza kwamba "hawapaswi, hata hivyo, kuombwa kuchukua wajibu ambao ni zaidi ya hatua yao ya ukuaji, uwajibikaji na uwezo."
translations.reference: He added that "they should not, however, be asked to take on obligations that go beyond their development stage, responsibility and capabilities."
translations.hypothesis: He added that they "should not, however, be asked to take on responsibilities that are beyond their stage of development, capabilities and capacity."

translations.source: Kikundi cha Wasomi wa Iraq kiliwasilisha ripoti yao saa 12 GMT leo.
translations.reference: The Iraq Study Group presented its report at 12.00 GMT today.
translations.hypothesis: The Iraqi Governing Council presented its report at 12 GMT today.

translations.source: Inatoa ilani kwamba hakuna yeyote anayeweza kutoa hakikisho kwamba mpango wowote wa hatua katika Iraki wakati huu utakomesha vita vya kimadhehebu, vurugu inayozidi, au mwelekeo kwenye machafuko.
translations.reference: It warns No one can guarantee that any course of action in Iraq at this point will stop sectarian warfare, growing violence, or a slide toward chaos.
translations.hypothesis: It asserts that no one can credibly promise that any action plan adopted by Iraq will end the civil war, sectarian violence, or the country's descent into chaos.

translations.source: Ripoti hiyo inaanza kwa ombi la mjadala wazi na kuundwa kwa maafikiano katika Marekani kuhusu sera kuhusu Mashariki ya Kati.
translations.reference: The Report opens with plea for open debate and the formation of a consensus in the United States about the policy towards the Middle East.
translations.hypothesis: The report begins with a plea for open and constructive dialogue to be established in the United States about policy toward the Middle East.

translations.source: Ripoti hiyo inashutumu vikali karibu kila kipengele cha sera ya sasa ya Mtendaji kuhusu Iraki na inahimiza ubadilishaji wa mwelekeo mara moja.
translations.reference: The Report is highly critical of almost every aspect of the present policy of the Executive towards Iraq and it urges an immediate change of direction.
translations.hypothesis: The report is highly critical of almost every aspect of the current policy toward Iraq and calls for an immediate change in direction.

translations.source: Kwanza kati ya mapendekezo yake 78 ni kwamba mpango mpya wa kidiplomasia unapaswa kuchukuliwa kabla ya mwisho wa mwaka huu ili kuweka katika hali ya usalama mipaka ya Iraq dhidi ya uingiliaji wa maadui na kuanzisha tena uhusiano wa kidiplomasia na majirani zake.
translations.reference: First among its 78 recommendations is that a new diplomatic initiative should be taken before the end of this year to secure Iraq’s borders against hostile interventions and to re-establish diplomatic relations with its neighbors.
translations.hypothesis: The first of his 78 recommendations is that a new diplomatic initiative should be undertaken before the end of this year to put in place the necessary security guarantees to protect Iraq from external aggression and to re-establish normal relations with its neighbours.

translations.source: Seneta wa sasa na Mke wa Rais wa Ajentina Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner alitangaza uwaniaji wake wa urais jana jioni katika La Plata, mji ulio kilomita 50 (maili 31) kutoka Buenos Aires.
translations.reference: Current senator and Argentine First Lady Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner announced her presidential candidacy yesterday evening in La Plata, a city 50 kilometers (31 miles) away from Buenos Aires.
translations.hypothesis: Current Senator and wife of former Argentinian President, Cristina Fernández de Kirchner announced her presidential bid yesterday evening in La Plata, a city 50 miles (31 km) from Buenos Aires.

translations.source: Bi. Kirchner alitangaza nia yake ya kuwania urais katika Ukumbi wa Ajentina, mahali pale pale alipotumia kuanzisha kampeni yake ya Seneti mnamo 2005 kama memba wa ujumbe wa wilaya ya Buenos Aires.
translations.reference: Mrs. Kirchner announced her intention to run for president at the Argentine Theatre, the same location she used to start her 2005 campaign for the Senate as member of the Buenos Aires province delegation.
translations.hypothesis: Mr. Kirchner announced his presidential bid in the Argentine capital, the same venue he used to launch his Senate campaign in 2005 as a candidate for Buenos Aires province.

translations.source: Mjadala ulianzishwa na mzozo juu ya kutumia zaidi kwa msaada na ujenzi upya katika Kimbunga Katrina; ambacho wahafidhina wa fedha wabebandika kwa ucheshi “Mpango wa Bushwa New Orleans.”
translations.reference: The debate was sparked by controversy over spending on relief and reconstruction in the wake Hurricane Katrina; which some fiscal conservatives have humorously labeled "Bush's New Orleans Deal."
translations.hypothesis: The debate was kicked off by a dispute over the use of aid and reconstruction funds in the aftermath of Hurricane Katrina; which fiscal conservatives derisively dubbed "the Bush New Orleans Plan."

translations.source: Ukosoaji huru wa juhudi za ujenzi upya umezingatia utoaji wa kandarasi za ujenzi upya kwa wajuzi wanaodhaniwa wa Washington.
translations.reference: Liberal criticism of the reconstruction effort has focused on the awarding of reconstruction contracts to perceived Washington insiders.
translations.hypothesis: The independent auditor's report on the reconstruction efforts has focused on the allocation of reconstruction contracts by the Washington-based Global Fund.

translations.source: Watu zaidi ya milioni nne walienda Roma kuhudhuria mazishi.
translations.reference: Over four million people went to Rome to attend the funeral.
translations.hypothesis: Over four million people went to Rome to attend the funeral.

translations.source: Idadi ya watu waliokuwepo ilikuwa kubwa sana kwamba haikuwezekana kwa kila mtu kupata kuingia kwenye mazishi katika uwanja wa St. Peter.
translations.reference: The number of people present was so large that it was not possible for everybody to gain access to the funeral in St. Peter's Square.
translations.hypothesis: The number of people present was so great that it was impossible for everyone to receive communion in St. Peter's Square.

translations.source: Skrini kadhaa kubwa za televisheni ziliangikwa mahali mbalimbali jijini Roma ili kuwezesha watu kutazama sherehe hiyo.
translations.reference: Several large television screens were installed in various places in Rome to let the people watch the ceremony.
translations.hypothesis: Several large television screens were set up in various locations across Rome to allow people to watch the event.

translations.source: Katika miji mingine mingi ya Italia na ulimwengu kwa ujumla, haswa katika Polandi, mipangilio sawa ilifanywa, ambayo ilionekana na idadi kubwa ya watu.
translations.reference: In many other cities of Italy and in the rest of the world, particularly in Poland, similar setups were made, which were viewed by a great number of people.
translations.hypothesis: In many other Italian and world cities, especially in Poland, similar events were organized, which were attended by a large number of people.

translations.source: Wanahistoria wameshutumu sera za zamani za FBI kwa kuangazia rasilimali kwenye kesi ambazo ni rahisi kutatua, hasa kesi za magari yaliyoibwa, kwa madhumuni ya kuongeza kiwango cha mafanikio cha wakala.
translations.reference: Historians have criticized past FBI policies for focusing resources on cases which are easy to solve, especially stolen car cases, with the intent of boosting the agency's success rate.
translations.hypothesis: Historians have criticised the FBI's old policy of highlighting successes in cases which are easy to solve, such as car theft cases, in order to artificially boost the agency's success rate.

translations.source: Bunge lilianza kufadhili kikundi chenye nia chafu katika mwaka wa kifedha wa 2005 na kuaini kuwa FBI lazima itoe makachero kumi kwa ponografia ya watu wazima.
translations.reference: Congress began funding the obscenity initiative in fiscal 2005 and specified that the FBI must devote 10 agents to adult pornography.
translations.hypothesis: The legislature began funding the specialised unit in fiscal year 2005 and stipulated that the FBI provide ten agents to the unit.

translations.source: Robin Uthappa alifanya alama za juu za fursa, pointi 70 katika mipira 41 kwa kufikia nne 11 na sita 2.
translations.reference: Robin Uthappa made the innings highest score, 70 runs in just 41 balls by hitting 11 fours and 2 sixes.
translations.hypothesis: Robin Uthappa was the highest scorer with 70 runs off 41 balls with 11 fours and 2 sixes.

translations.source: Wachezaji wa kati wa kriketi, Sachin Tendulkar na Rahul Dravid, walicheza vizuri na kushirikiana katika masafa mia moja.
translations.reference: Middle order batsmen, Sachin Tendulkar and Rahul Dravid, performed well and made a hundred-run partnership.
translations.hypothesis: The middle-order batsmen, Sachin Tendulkar and Rahul Dravid, played well together and added a century stand.

translations.source: Lakini, baada ya kupoteza wiketi ya kapteni India ilifanya pointi 36 na kupoteza wiketi 7 kumaliza fursa.
translations.reference: But, after losing the captain's wicket India only made 36 runs loosing 7 wickets to end the innings.
translations.hypothesis: But after losing the captain, India were all out for 36, losing by 7 wickets.

translations.source: Rais wa Marekani George W. Bush alifika Singapori asubuhi ya Novemba 16, hivyo kuanza ziara ya Asia ya wiki moja.
translations.reference: U.S. President George W. Bush arrived in Singapore the morning of November 16, beginning a week-long tour of Asia.
translations.hypothesis: United States President George W. Bush arrived in Singapore on the morning of November 16, beginning a week-long tour of Asia.

translations.source: Alisalimiwa na Naibu Waziri Mkuu wa Singapori Wong Kan Seng na wakajadili masuala ya biashara na ughaidi na Waziri Mkuu wa Singapori Lee Hsien Loong.
translations.reference: He was greeted by Singapore's Deputy Prime Minister Wong Kan Seng and discussed trade and terrorism issues with the Singapore Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong.
translations.hypothesis: He was received by Singapore's Deputy Prime Minister, Wong Kan Seng, and discussed business and counter-terrorism issues with Singapore's Prime Minister, Lee Hsien Loong.

translations.source: Baada ya wiki ya kushindwa katika uchaguzi wa nusu muhula, Bush aliambia hadhira kuhusu upanuzi wa biashara katika Asia.
translations.reference: After a week of losses in the midterm election, Bush told an audience about the expansion of trade in Asia.
translations.hypothesis: After a week of losses in the mid-term elections, Bush told the audience about an expansion of business in Asia.

translations.source: Waziri Mkuu Stephen Harper amekubali kutuma ‘Mkataba wa Hewa Safi’ wa serikali kwa kamati ya vyama vyote kwa ukaguzi, kabla ya kusomwa kwake kwa mara ya pili, baada ya mkutano wa Jumanne wa dakika 25 na kiongozi wa NDP Jack Layton kwenye PMO.
translations.reference: Prime Minister Stephen Harper has agreed to send the government's 'Clean Air Act' to an all-party committee for review, before its second reading, after Tuesday's 25 minute meeting with NDP leader Jack Layton at the PMO.
translations.hypothesis: Prime Minister Stephen Harper agreed to send the government's Clean Air Act to a legislative committee for review, before its second reading, after a 25-minute meeting Tuesday with NDP Leader Jack Layton at the PMO.

translations.source: Layton alikuwa ameomba mabadiliko ya mswada wa kimazingira wa wahafidhina wakati wa mkutano na PM, akiomba “uandishi upya wa undani na mkamilifu” wa mswada wa kimazingira wa chama cha Wahafidhina.
translations.reference: Layton had asked for changes to the conservatives' environmental bill during the meeting with the PM, asking for a "thorough and complete rewriting" of the Conservative party's environmental bill.
translations.hypothesis: Layton had previously demanded the PM's green policy be changed during a meeting, asking for a "complete and utter rewrite" of the Conservative party's green policy.

translations.source: Tangu Serikali ya Shirikisho ilipoingilia kati kuhusu ufadhili wa hospitali ya Mersey katika Davenport, Tasmania, serikali ya jimbo na baadhi ya wabunge wa shirikisho wameshutumu kitendo hiki kama sarakasi kabla ya uchaguzi wa kishirika utakaofanyika mnamo Novemba.
translations.reference: Ever since the Federal Government stepped in to take over funding of the Mersey hospital in Devonport, Tasmania, the state government and some federal MPs have criticised this act as a stunt in the prelude to the federal election to be called by November.
translations.hypothesis: Since the Federal Government intervened in the funding of the Mersey Hospital in Davenport, Tasmania, the State Government and some Federal politicians have criticised the action as electioneering in the lead-up to the Federal election in November.

translations.source: Lakini Waziri Mkuu John Howard alisema kitendo hicho kilikuwa tu cha kulinda majengo ya hospitali kutokana na kushushwa hadhi na serikali ya Tasmania, kwa kutoa dola milioni 45 za Australia.
translations.reference: But Prime Minister John Howard has said the act was only to safeguard the facilities of the hospital from being downgraded by the Tasmanian government, in giving an extra AUD$45 million.
translations.hypothesis: But Prime Minister John Howard said the action was only to protect the hospital buildings from further degradation by the Tasmanian state government, which had refused to allocate the extra $45 million Australian dollars.

translations.source: Kulingana na taarifa za hivi punde, vipimo vya kiwango cha bahari vilionyesha tufani ilizalishwa. Kulikuwa na baadhi ya shughuli dhahiri za tufani zilizorekodiwa karibu na Pago Pago na Niue.
translations.reference: According to the latest bulletin, sea level readings indicated a tsunami was generated. There was some definite tsunami activity recorded near Pago Pago and Niue.
translations.hypothesis: According to the latest reports, sea level pressure readings show a storm has formed. There were some tropical cyclone activity recorded near Pago Pago and Niue.

translations.source: Hakuna madhara makubwa au majeraha yaliyoripotiwa huko Tonga, lakini nguvu za umeme zilipotea kwa muda, hali ambayo iliripotiwa kuzuia mamlaka ya Tongan kupokea onyo la tsunami lililotolewa na PTWC.
translations.reference: No major damage or injuries have been reported in Tonga, but power was temporarily lost, which reportedly prevented Tongan authorities from receiving the tsunami warning issued by the PTWC.
translations.hypothesis: There were no major injuries or damages reported in Tonga, but the power went out temporarily, which officials in Tonga reported hindered their ability to receive the tsunami warning issued by PTWC.

translations.source: Shule kumi na nne katika Hawaii zilizoko au zilizo karibu na mipaka ya pwani zilifungwa siku nzima Jumatano licha ya tahadhari kuondolewa.
translations.reference: Fourteen schools in Hawaii located on or near coastlines were closed all of Wednesday despite the warnings being lifted.
translations.hypothesis: Fourteen schools in Hawaii located near or adjacent to the shoreline were closed all day Wednesday despite the warning being lifted.

translations.source: Rais wa marekani George W. Bush alikaribisha tangazo hilo.
translations.reference: U.S. President George W. Bush welcomed the announcement.
translations.hypothesis: The announcement was welcomed by United States President George W. Bush.

translations.source: Msemaji wa Bush Gordon Johndroe alitaja ahadi ya Korea Kaskazini kama “hatua kuu kuelekea lengo la kufikia uondoaji wa kuaminika wa silaha za kinyuklia katika rasi ya Kikorea.”
translations.reference: Bush spokesman Gordon Johndroe called North Korea's pledge "a major step towards the goal of achieving the verifiable denuclearization of the Korean peninsula."
translations.hypothesis: Bush's spokesman, Gordon Johndroe, called North Korea's announcement "a move in the right direction toward the goal of a permanent and verifiable elimination of nuclear weapons on the Korean peninsula."

translations.source: Dhoruba ya kumi iliyopewa jina ya msimu wa Kimbunga cha Atlantiki, Dhoruba ya Nusutropiki ya Jerry, iliundwa katika Bahari ya Atlantiki leo.
translations.reference: The tenth named storm of the Atlantic Hurricane season, Subtropical Storm Jerry, formed in the Atlantic Ocean today.
translations.hypothesis: The tenth named storm of the Atlantic hurricane season, Tropical Storm Jerry, has formed in the Atlantic Ocean today.

translations.source: Kituo cha Kitaifa cha Vimbunga (NHC) kinasema kwamba wakati huu, Jerry hakitoi tishio kwa ardhi.
translations.reference: The National Hurricane Center (NHC) says that at this point Jerry poses no threat to land.
translations.hypothesis: The National Hurricane Center (NHC) says that as of this time, Jerry does not pose a threat to land.

translations.source: Corps of Engineers cha Marekani kilikadiria kwamba inchi 6 za mvua huenda zikabomoa matuta ambayo yaliharibiwa awali.
translations.reference: The U.S. Corps of Engineers estimated that 6 inches of rainfall could breach the previously damaged levees.
translations.hypothesis: The US Army Corps of Engineers estimated that 6 more inches of rain could breach the remaining levee.

translations.source: Wadi ya Tisa, ambayo ilishuhudia mafuriko ya hadi futi 20 kwa kimo wakati wa Kimbunga Katrina, sasa iko kwenye maji yanayofikia kiunoni kwani tuta lililokuwa karibu lilifurika.
translations.reference: The Ninth Ward, which saw flooding as high as 20 feet during Hurricane Katrina, is currently in waist-high water as the nearby levee was overtopped.
translations.hypothesis: The Ninth Ward, which saw up to 20 feet of water during Hurricane Katrina, is now surrounded by water as the levee system protecting it was topped.

translations.source: Maji yanamwagika juu ya tuta katika sehemu ya futi 100 upana.
translations.reference: Water is spilling over the levee in a section 100 feet wide.
translations.hypothesis: Water pours over the lip of the falls in a 100-foot wide curtain.

translations.source: Msimamizi wa Commons Adam Cuerden alielezea kufadhaika kwake kuhusu ufutaji huo alipoongea na Wikinews mwezi uliopita.
translations.reference: Commons Administrator Adam Cuerden expressed his frustration over the deletions when he spoke to Wikinews last month.
translations.hypothesis: Commons Administrator Adam Cuerden expressed his frustration about the deletion when he spoke to Wikinews last month.

translations.source: "Yeye [Wales] kimsingi alindanganya tangu mwanzo. Kwanza kwa kufanya kama hii ni kwa sababu za kisheria. Pili, kwa kujifanya alikuwa anatusikiliza, hadi saana yake ifutwe."
translations.reference: "He [Wales] basically lied to us from the start. First, by acting as if this was for legal reasons. Second, by pretending he was listening to us, right up to his art deletion."
translations.hypothesis: "He [Wales] was basically deceiving us from the start. First, by saying this was for legal reasons. Second, by pretending to listen to us until his sentence was commuted."

translations.source: Hasira ya jamii imesababisha juhudi za sasa za kutayarisha sera kuhusu kadiri ya ngono kwa wavuti ambayo inakaribisha mamilioni ya vyombo vya habari vilivyo na leseni wazi.
translations.reference: The community irritation led to current efforts to draft a policy regarding sexual content for the site which hosts millions of openly-licensed media.
translations.hypothesis: The public outcry has led to current efforts to establish a policy on age-appropriate content for the Internet that would require millions of websites to obtain a license.

translations.source: Kazi iliyofanywa ilikuwa hasa ya nadharia, lakini programu ilitengenezwa ili kuiga mitazamo iliyofanywa ya galaksi ya Mshale.
translations.reference: The work done was mostly theoretical, but the program was written to simulate observations made of the Sagittarius galaxy.
translations.hypothesis: The work was mostly theoretical, but a program was developed to simulate the evolution of the galaxies.

translations.source: Athari ambayo timu ilikuwa ikitafuta ingesababishwa na nguvu za mawimbi baina ya dutu nyeusi za galaksia na dutu nyeusi za Kilimia.
translations.reference: The effect the team was looking for would be caused by tidal forces between the galaxy's dark matter and the Milky Way's dark matter.
translations.hypothesis: The effect the team was looking for would be caused by the gravitational waves rippling through spacetime between black holes.

translations.source: Kama vile mwezi unavuta nguvu duniani, na kusababisha mawimbi, vivyo hivyo ndivyo Njia ya Kimaziwa hutia nguvu kwenye giligili la alama ya Mshale.
translations.reference: Just like the moon exerts a pull on the earth, causing tides, so does the Milky Way exert a force on the Sagittarius galaxy.
translations.hypothesis: Just as the moon pulls on the Earth, creating tides, so too does the Arrow constellation pull on the fabric of reality.

translations.source: Wanasayansi waliweza kuhitimisha kuwa udusi mweusi unaathiri udusi mwingine mweusi kwa njia ile ile ya kawaida.
translations.reference: The scientists were able to conclude that the dark matter affect other dark matter in the same way regular matter does.
translations.hypothesis: Scientists have been able to determine that black carbon affects snow and ice albedo (reflectivity) in the same way as dark-coloured dust.

translations.source: Nadharia hii inasema kuwa dutu nyingi yenye giza inayozingira galaksi iko karibu na galaksi kwa aina ya mwangaza, na inatengenezwa kwa chembechembe nyingi ndogo.
translations.reference: This theory says that most dark matter around a galaxy is located around a galaxy in a kind of halo, and is made of lots of small particles.
translations.hypothesis: This theory says that most of the universe's missing mass is in the form of a substance called dark matter, and it is made up of many tiny particles.

translations.source: Ripoti kwenye televisheni zinaonyesha moshi mweupe unaotoka kwenye mmea huo.
translations.reference: Television reports show white smoke coming from the plant.
translations.hypothesis: Reports on television showed white smoke rising from the plant.

translations.source: Mamlaka ya ndani inaonya wakaaji walio karibu na mmea huo kukaa ndani, kuzima viyoyozi na kutokunywa maji ya bomba.
translations.reference: Local authorities are warning residents in the vicinity of the plant to stay indoors, turn off air-conditioners and not to drink tap water.
translations.hypothesis: Local authorities are warning residents living near the plant to stay indoors, turn off air conditioning and not to drink tap water.

translations.source: Kulingana na shirika la nyuklia la Japan, mionzi, cesiamu na iodini zimetambuliwa kiwandani.
translations.reference: According to Japan's nuclear agency, radioactive caesium and iodine has been identified at the plant.
translations.hypothesis: According to the Japanese nuclear agency, radiation, cesium and iodine have been detected industrially.

translations.source: Serikali inabashiri kuwa hii inaonyesha kuwa vyombo vinayokuwa na Urani kwenye tovuti vinaweza kuwa vimetoboka na vinavuja.
translations.reference: Authorities speculate that this indicates that containers holding uranium fuel at the site may have ruptured and are leaking.
translations.hypothesis: The government speculates that this indicates that the tanks containing the uranium have been leaking.

translations.source: Dk. Tony Moll aligundua Kifua Kikuu Kinachokinza Dawa Kabisa (XDR-TB) katika eneo la KwaZulu-Natal, Afrika Kusini.
translations.reference: Dr. Tony Moll discovered the Extremely Drug Resistant Tuberculosis (XDR-TB) in the South African region KwaZulu-Natal.
translations.hypothesis: Dr Tony Moll discovered extensively drug-resistant TB (XDR-TB) in the KwaZulu-Natal province of South Africa.

translations.source: Katika mahojiano, alisema aina mpya ilikuwa "ya kusumbua sana na ya kutisha kwa sababu ya kiwango cha juu cha kufariki."
translations.reference: In an interview, he said the new variant was "very highly troubling and alarming because of the very high fatality rate."
translations.hypothesis: In an interview, he said the new variant was "more severe and concerning because of the high mortality rate."

translations.source: Huenda baadhi ya wagonjwa waliambukizwa mdudu huyo hospitalini, kama anavyofikiria Dkt. Moll, na angalau wawili walikuwa wafanyakazi hospitalini.
translations.reference: Some patients might have contracted the bug in the hospital, Dr. Moll thinks, and at least two were hospital health workers.
translations.hypothesis: Some of the patients were possibly infected in the hospital, as Dr. Moll believes, and at least two were known to be hospital staff.

translations.source: Katika mwaka mmoja, mtu aliyeambukizwa huenda akaambukiza wato 10-15 wa karibu.
translations.reference: In one year's time, an infected person may infect 10 to 15 close contacts.
translations.hypothesis: In one year, an infected person may transmit the disease to 10–15 close contacts.

translations.source: Hata hivyo, asilimia ya XDR-TB katika kikundi kizima cha watu wenye kifua kikuu bado inaonekana kuwa chini, watu 6,000 kati ya 330,000 walioambukizwa kwa wakati wowote maalumu katika Afrika Kusini.
translations.reference: However, the percentage of XDR-TB in the entire group of people with tuberculosis still seems to be low; 6,000 of the total 330,000 people infected at any particular moment in South Africa.
translations.hypothesis: However, the proportion of XDR-TB in the overall population of people with TB has remained stable, with 6000/330 000 (1.8%) people diagnosed with XDR-TB in South Africa during the study period.

translations.source: Setilaiti, ambazo zote mbili zilikuwa na uzani wa zaidi ya pauni 1,000, na kusafiri kwa takribani maili 17,500 kwa saa, ziligongana maili 491 juu ya Dunia.
translations.reference: The satellites, both of which weighed in excess of 1,000 pounds, and traveling at approximately 17,500 miles per hour, collided 491 miles above the Earth.
translations.hypothesis: The satellites, each weighing more than 1,000 pounds, and traveling at about 17,500 miles per hour, collided 491 miles above the Earth.

translations.source: Wanasayansi wanasema mlipuko uliosababishwa na mgongano huo ulikuwa mkubwa.
translations.reference: Scientists say the explosion caused by the collision was massive.
translations.hypothesis: Scientists say the explosion resulting from the impact was enormous.

translations.source: Bado wanajaribu kuamua kiwango cha ukubwa cha mgongano na jinsi Ulimwengu utaathirika.
translations.reference: They are still trying to determine just how large the crash was and how the Earth will be affected.
translations.hypothesis: They are still trying to determine the size of the impactor and how much damage it will cause.

translations.source: Amri ya Kimkakati ya Marekani ya ofisi ya Idara ya Ulinzi ya Marekani inafuatilia vifusi.
translations.reference: The United States Strategic Command of the U.S. Department of Defense office is tracking the debris.
translations.hypothesis: The US Department of Defence's Strategic Command is in charge of tracking satellites.

translations.source: Matokeo ya uchambuzi wa uchoraji yatatumwa kwenye tovuti ya umma.
translations.reference: The result of plotting analysis will be posted to a public website.
translations.hypothesis: The results of the analysis will be published on a public website.

translations.source: Daktari aliyefanya kazi katika Hospitali ya Watoto ya Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania atashtakiwa kwa uuaji uliochochewa baada ya mamake kupatikana ameuawa katika buti ya gari lake Jumatano, mamlaka ya Ohio inasema.
translations.reference: A doctor who worked at Children's Hospital of Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania will be charged with aggravated murder after her mother was found dead in the trunk of her car Wednesday, authorities in Ohio say.
translations.hypothesis: A doctor who worked at a children's hospital in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, is being charged with murder after his mother was found dead in the trunk of his car on Wednesday, according to Ohio authorities.

translations.source: Dk. Malar Balasubramanian, mwenye umri wa miaka 29, alipatikana katika Blue Ash, Ohio, kitongoji kilichoko takriban maili 15 kaskazini mwa Cincinnati akiwa amelala chini kando ya barabara akiwa amevalia tishati na nguo za ndani katika hali iliyoonekana kuwa ya matumizi ya dawa nyingi.
translations.reference: Dr. Malar Balasubramanian, 29, was found in Blue Ash, Ohio, a suburb approximately 15 miles north of Cincinnati lying on the ground beside the road in a T-shirt and underwear in an apparently heavily medicated state.
translations.hypothesis: Dr. Mala Balasubramanian, 29, was found dead in Blue Ash, a suburb about 15 miles north of Cincinnati, lying on the sidewalk wearing a shirt and underwear in what appeared to be a drug-related suicide.

translations.source: Aliwaelekeza maafisa kwenye Oldsmobile yake nyeusi ambayo ilikiwa kwa umbali wa futi 500.
translations.reference: She directed officers to her black Oldsmobile Intrigue which was 500 feet away.
translations.hypothesis: He directed the officers to his black Oldsmobile which was parked about 500 feet away.

translations.source: Hapo, walipata mwili wa Saroja Balasubramanian, aliyekuwa na umri wa miaka 53, umefunikwa kwa blanketi zilizokuwa na madoa ya damu.
translations.reference: There, they found the body of Saroja Balasubramanian, 53, covered with blood-stained blankets.
translations.hypothesis: There, they found the body of Sarojamma Balasubramanian, 53, covered with a blood-soaked bedsheet.

translations.source: Polisi walisema kwamba ilionekana kama mwili huo ulikuwa hapo kwa takriban siku moja.
translations.reference: Police said that the body appeared to have been there for about a day.
translations.hypothesis: Police said it appeared the body had been there for about a day.

translations.source: Kesi za kwanza za ugonjwa huo msimu huu ziliripotiwa mwishoni mwa Julai.
translations.reference: The first cases of the disease this season were reported in late July.
translations.hypothesis: The first cases of the disease this season were reported in late July.

translations.source: Ugonjwa huo hubebwa na nguruwe, kisha huhamia kwa binadamu kupitia mbu.
translations.reference: The disease is carried by pigs, which then migrates to humans through mosquitos.
translations.hypothesis: The disease is transmitted by pigs and then to humans by mosquitoes.

translations.source: Mkurupuko huo umechochea serikali ya India kuchukua hatua kama kuwatuma wawinda nguruwe katika maeneo yaliyoathiriwa sana, na kusambaza maelfu ya mapazia ya mbu na kunyunyiza dawa za kuua wadudu.
translations.reference: The outbreak has prompted the Indian government to undertake such measures as deployment of pig catchers in seriously affected areas, distributing thousands of mosquito curtains and spraying pesticides.
translations.hypothesis: The outbreak has prompted the Indian government to take action such as sending in the army to affected areas, distributing mosquito nets, and spraying insecticides.

translations.source: Vichupa milioni kadhaa vya chanjo ya uvimbe wa ubongo vimeahidiwa na serikali, ambavyo vitasaidia kuandaa mawakala wa afya kwa mwaka ujao.
translations.reference: Several million vials of encephalitis vaccine have also been promised by the government, which will help prepare health agencies for next year.
translations.hypothesis: Several million doses of meningococcal vaccines have been ordered by governments, which will help to prime health workers over the next year.

translations.source: Mipango ya kufikisha chanjo mwaka huu katika maeneo yanayojulikana kihistoria kuathirika sana ilicheleweshwa kwa sababu ya ukosefu wa fedha na kipaumbele cha chini ikilinganishwa na magonjwa mengine.
translations.reference: Plans for vaccines to be delivered to the historically most affected areas this year were delayed due to lack of funds and low prioritisation relative to other diseases.
translations.hypothesis: Plans to deliver vaccines this year to the areas that have historically been most affected have been delayed due to a lack of funding and lower priority given to the disease compared to others.

translations.source: Mnamo 1956 Slania alihamia Uswidi, ambako miaka mitatu baadaye alianza kazi katika Ofisi ya Posta ya Uswidi na akawa mchoraji wao mkuu.
translations.reference: In 1956 Słania moved to Sweden, where three years later he began work for the Swedish Post Office and became their chief engraver.
translations.hypothesis: In 1956, Slania emigrated to Sweden, where three years later he began working for the Swedish Post Office and became their chief cartoonist.

translations.source: Alizalisha stempu zaidi ya 1,000 kwa Uswidi na nchi nyingine 28.
translations.reference: He produced over 1,000 stamps for Sweden and 28 other countries.
translations.hypothesis: He designed more than 1,000 stamps for Sweden and 28 other countries.

translations.source: Aina ya homa ya ndege iliyo hatari kwa binadamu, H5N1, imethibitishwa kuambukiza bata mwitu aliyekufa, aliyepatikana Jumatatu, katika kinamasi karibu na Lyon mashariki mwa Ufaransa.
translations.reference: The strain of bird flu lethal to humans, H5N1, has been confirmed to have infected a dead wild duck, found on Monday, in marshland near Lyon in the east of France.
translations.hypothesis: A highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) virus has been confirmed in a dead wild duck found on Monday in a park near Lyon in eastern France.

translations.source: Ufaransa ni nchi ya saba katika Jumuiya ya Ulaya kukabiliwa na virusi hivi; kufuatia Austria, Ujerumani, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Ugiriki na Italia.

translations.source: Ghambers alikuwa amemshtaki Mungu kwa "vifo, uharibifu na ugaidi uilioenea, wa mamilioni ya mamilioni ya wakaazi wa Dunia."
translations.reference: Chambers had sued God for "widespread death, destruction and terrorization of millions upon millions of the Earth's inhabitants."
translations.hypothesis: Chambers had sued God for "causing, creating, and/or allowing the death, destruction, and carnage of millions of innocent human beings."

translations.source: Chambers, anayeamini kuwa kuwepo kwa Mungu hakujulikani, anasema kuwa kesi yake ni ya “kijinga” na “mtu yeyote anaweza kumshtaki yeyote.”
translations.reference: Chambers, an agnostic, argues that his lawsuit is "frivolous" and "anybody can sue anybody."
translations.hypothesis: Chambers, who believes God's existence is unknowable, says his case is "absurd" and "anyone can sue anyone."

translations.source: Hadithi iliyotolewa kwenye mchezo wa kifaransa wa kuigiza wa opera na Camille Saint-Saens ni wa msanii “ambaye maisha yake yanaamuriwa na upendo wa madawa na Japani.

translations.hypothesis: The story, set to music by Camille Saint-Saëns, is of a man whose life is ruled by his love of a particular drug, opium.

translations.source: Kama matokeo, watendaji huvuta misokoto ya bangi kwenye jukwaa, na ukumbi wenyewe unawahimiza hadhira kushiriki.

translations.source: Spika wa awali Newt Gingrich, gavana wa Texas Rick Perry na Mbunge Michelle Bachmann walimaliza katika nafasi za nne, tano, na sita mtawalia.

translations.source: Bachmann, aliyeshinda Kura ya maoni ya Ames Straw mnamo Agosti, aliamua kukomesha kampeni yake.

translations.source: Kwa mujibu wa polisi, dereva wa gari lililomgonga mpigaji picha huenda akakabiliwa na mashtaka ya jinai.
translations.reference: According to police, the driver of the vehicle that hit the photographer is unlikely to face criminal charges.

translations.source: Walinda amani wa Umoja wa Mataifa, ambao waliwasili Haiti baada ya mtetemeko wa ardhi wa 2010, wanalaumiwa kwa ueneaji wa ugonjwa huo ulioanza karibu na kambi ya kikosi hicho.
translations.reference: UN peacekeepers, whom arrived in Haiti after the 2010 earthquake, are being blamed for the spread of the disease which started near the troop's encampment.
translations.hypothesis: The UN peacekeeping force, which has been deployed in Haiti since the 2010 earthquake, is suspected of having started the outbreak near their base.

translations.source: Kulingana na shtaka hilo, uchafu kutoka kwenye kambi ya Umoja wa Mataifa haukutakaswa vizuri, hivyo kusababisha bakteria kuingia kwenye tawi la Mto Artibonite, mojawapo ya mito mikubwa sana ya Haiti.
translations.reference: According to the lawsuit, waste from the UN camp was not properly sanitized, causing bacteria to enter the tributary of the Artibonite River, one of Haiti's largest.
translations.hypothesis: According to the charges, waste from the UN compound was improperly disposed of, causing bacteria to enter the Artibonite River, one of Haiti's largest rivers.

translations.source: Kabla ya kufika kwa vikosi, Haiti haikuwa imekumbana na shida zinazohusiana na magonjwa tangu miaka ya 1800.
translations.reference: Prior to the arrival of troops, Haiti had not encountered problems related to the disease since the 1800s.
translations.hypothesis: Before the arrival of the troops, Haiti had not experienced any cases of the disease since the early 1800s.

translations.source: Taasisi ya Haki na Demokrasia ya Haiti imerejelea utafiti huru ambao unapendekeza kwamba kikosi cha kulinda amani cha Kinepali cha Umoja wa Mataifa kilileta ugonjwa huo Haiti bila kujua.
translations.reference: The Haitian Institute for Justice and Democracy has referenced independent studies that suggest the Nepalese UN peacekeeping battalion unknowingly brought the disease to Haiti.
translations.hypothesis: The Haitian Institute for Human Rights has suggested that a Nepalese U.N. peacekeeping unit may have inadvertently brought the disease to Haiti.

translations.source: Danielle Lantagne, mtaalamu wa UN kuhusu ugonjwa huo, alisema kuna uwezekano mkurupuko huo ulisababishwa na walinda amani.
translations.reference: Danielle Lantagne, a UN expert on the disease, stated the outbreak was likely caused by the peacekeepers.
translations.hypothesis: Danielle Lantagne, a UN expert on the disease, said the outbreak was most likely caused by a security incident.

translations.reference: Also the Pacific Tsunami Warning Center said that there was no Tsunami indication.
translations.hypothesis: Also, the Pacific Tsunami Warning Center said there was no tsunami threat.

translations.source: Polisi wa kitambo wa Filipino amewateka nyara watalii wa Hong Kong kwa kuteka basi lao katika Manila, mji mkuu wa Ufilipino.
translations.reference: A former Filipino policeman has kept Hong Kong tourists hostage by hijacking their bus in Manila, the capital of the Philippines.
translations.hypothesis: A group of Filipino rebels have kidnapped a busload of Hong Kong tourists in Manila, the capital of the Philippines.

translations.source: Rolando Mendoza alifyatua bunduki yake ya M16 kwa watalii.
translations.reference: Rolando Mendoza fired his M16 rifle at the tourists.
translations.hypothesis: Rolando Mendoza aimed his M16 at the tourists.

translations.source: Mateka kadhaa wamenusuriwa na angalau sita wamethibitishwa kufa kufikia sasa.
translations.reference: Several hostages have been rescued and least six have been confirmed dead so far.
translations.hypothesis: Several hostages have been released and at least six deaths have been confirmed so far.

translations.source: Mateka sita, wakiwemo watoto na wazee, waliachiliwa mapema kama vile wapiga picha wa Ufilipino.
translations.reference: Six hostages, including the children and elderly, were released early, as were the Filipino photographers.
translations.hypothesis: Six hostages, including children and the elderly, had already been released earlier in the day, including the Filipino journalists.

translations.source: Wapiga picha baadaye walichukua nafasi ya mwanamke mzee kwani alihitaji kwenda haja. Mendoza alivamiwa kwa risasi.
translations.reference: The photographers later took the place of an aged lady as she needed the lavatory. Mendoza was gunned down.
translations.hypothesis: The cameraman then took the place of the elderly woman, who had to go to the bathroom. Mendoza was then shot in the face.

translations.source: Liggins alifuata nyayo za babake na kujiunga na kazi ya udaktari.
translations.reference: Liggins followed in his father’s footsteps and entered a career in medicine.
translations.hypothesis: Liggins followed in his father's footsteps and pursued a career in medicine.

translations.source: Alijifunza kuwa mkunga na akaanza kufanya kazi katika Hospitali ya Kitaifa ya Wanawake ya Auckland mnamo 1959.
translations.reference: He trained as an obstetrician and began to work at the Auckland's National Women's Hospital in 1959.
translations.hypothesis: She trained as a nurse and began work at Auckland Public Hospital in 1959.

translations.source: Alipokuwa akifanya kazi hospitalini, Liggins alianza kuchunguza uchungu wa mapema wa uzazi katika muda wake wa ziada.
translations.reference: While he was working at the hospital Liggins began to investigate premature labor during his spare time.
translations.hypothesis: While working at the hospital, Liggins began investigating the early onset of puberty in his spare time.

translations.source: Utafiti wake ulionyesha kwamba kama homoni ingetumiwa, ingeongeza kasi ya ukuaji wa mapafu ya mtoto.
translations.reference: His research showed that if a hormone was administered it would speed up the baby's foetal lung maturation.
translations.hypothesis: His research indicated that if the hormone was used, it would speed up the development of the child's lungs.

translations.source: Xinhua aliripoti kwamba wachunguzi wa serikali walipata vifaa vya 'sanduku nyeusi' vya kurekodi matukio kwenye ndege siku ya Jumatano.
translations.reference: Xinhua reported that government investigators recovered two 'black box' flight recorders on Wednesday.
translations.hypothesis: Xinhua reported that investigators found the plane's 'black box' recorders on Wednesday.

translations.source: Mabondia wenzake pia walimuombeleza Luna.
translations.reference: Fellow wrestlers also paid tribute to Luna.
translations.hypothesis: Fellow attendees also told him about Luna.

translations.source: Tommy Dreamer alisema, “Luna alikuwa Malkia wa kwanza wa Kukithiri. Meneja wangu wa kwanza. Luna aliaga dunia mnamo usiku wa miezi miwili. Kipekee kama alivyo tu. Mwanamke hodari.”
translations.reference: Tommy Dreamer said "Luna was the first Queen of Extreme. My first manager. Luna passed away on the night of two moons. Pretty unique just like her. Strong woman."
translations.hypothesis: Tommy Dreamer said, "Luna was the first Queen of Extreme. My first manager. Luna left this world two months ago. One of a kind. A true woman.

translations.source: Justin “Goldust” Runnels ametoa maoni kwamba “Luna alikuwa mdhaifu kama mimi … labda hata zaidi … umpende na utamkosa… kwa matumaini yupo mahali pazuri.”
translations.reference: Dustin "Goldust" Runnels commented that "Luna was as freaky as me...maybe even more...love her and will miss her...hopefully she's in a better place."
translations.hypothesis: Justin "Goldust" Runnels posted "Luna was as real as they get...maybe even more so...love ya miss ya...hopefully your in a better place."

translations.source: Kwa watu 1,400 waliopiga kura ya maoni kabla ya uchaguzi wa 2010 wa shirikisho, wale wanaopinga Australia kuwa jamhuri waliongezeka kwa asilimia 8 tangu mwaka wa 2008.
translations.reference: Out of 1,400 people polled prior to the 2010 federal election, those who oppose Australia becoming a republic grew by 8 per cent since 2008.
translations.hypothesis: For the 1,400 people surveyed before the 2010 federal election, support for Australia becoming a republic has risen 8 per cent since 2008.

translations.source: Kaimu Waziri Mkuu Julia Gillard alidai wakati wa kampeni ya uchaguzi wa ushirika wa 2010 kwamba aliamini Australia inafaa kuwa jamhuri mwishoni mwa utawala wa Malkia Elizabeth II.
translations.reference: Caretaker Prime Minister Julia Gillard claimed during the campaign of the 2010 federal election that she believed Australia should become a republic at the end of Queen Elizabeth II's reign.
translations.hypothesis: Acting Prime Minister Julia Gillard stated during the 2010 federal election campaign that she believed Australia should become a republic after the end of Queen Elizabeth II's reign.

translations.source: Asilimia 34 ya walio kwenye uchunguzi wanashiriki maoni haya, kumtaka Malkia Elizabeth wa II awe malikia wa mwisho wa Australia.
translations.reference: 34 per cent of those in the poll share this view, wanting Queen Elizabeth II to be Australia's last monarch.
translations.hypothesis: 34% of respondents share this opinion, wanting Queen Elizabeth II to be the last monarch of Australia.

translations.source: Katika wingi wa kura, asilimia 29 ya wale waliofanyiwa utafiti wanaamini Australia inapaswa kuwa jamhuri haraka iwezekanavyo, huku asilimia 31 wakiamini Australia haipaswi kamwe kuwa jamhuri.
translations.reference: At the extremes of the poll, 29 per cent of those surveyed believe Australia should become a republic as soon as possible, while 31 per cent believe Australia should never become a republic.
translations.hypothesis: In the majority of polls, around 29 per cent of respondents believe Australia should become a republic as soon as possible, while 31 per cent think Australia should never become a republic.

translations.source: Aliyeshinda nishani ya dhahabu ya Olimpiki alikuwa amepangiwa kuogelea katika mtindo huru wa mita 100 na mita 200 na mbio tatu za kupokezana vijiti katika Michezo ya Jumuiya ya Madola, lakini kwa sababu ya malalamiko yake uzima wake umekuwa na shaka.
translations.reference: The Olympic gold medalist was due to swim in the 100m and 200m freestyle and in three relays at the Commonwealth Games, but due to his complaints his fitness has been in doubt.
translations.hypothesis: The Olympic gold medallist was due to swim in the 100m and 200m freestyle and three relays at the Commonwealth Games, but his health has been questioned because of his complaint.

translations.source: Hakuweza kunywa dawa zinazohitajika kutuliza maumivu yake kwani zimepigwa marufuku katika Michezo.
translations.reference: He has been unable to take the drugs needed to overcome his pain as they are banned from the Games.
translations.hypothesis: He couldn't take the necessary medication for his pain as they are prohibited in competition.

translations.source: Curtis Cooper, mtaalamu wa hisabati na profesa wa sayansi ya kompyuta katika Chuo Kikuu cha Missouri, amegundua nambari tasa kubwa zaidi kufikia sasa mnamo Januari 25.
translations.reference: Curtis Cooper, a mathematician and computer science professor at the University of Central Missouri, has discovered the largest known prime number to date on January 25.
translations.hypothesis: Curtis Cooper, a mathematician and computer scientist at the University of Missouri, found the largest known prime number as of January 25.

translations.source: Watu kadhaa walithibitisha uvumbuzi huo kutumia maunzi na programu tofauti kufikia mwanzoni mwa Februari na ikatangazwa mnamo Jumanne.
translations.reference: Several people verified the discovery using different hardware and software by the beginning of February and it was announced on Tuesday.
translations.hypothesis: Several people confirmed the startup's discovery using different crypto and fiat platforms to finally settle on Tuesday.

translations.source: Kuna uwezekano kwamba nyotamkia zilikuwa chanzo cha kusafirisha maji katika dunia, pamoja na vitu vilivyo na kaboni vinavyoweza kuunda protini na kusaidia uhai.
translations.reference: Comets may possibly have been a source of water delivery to the earth along with organic matter that can form proteins and support life.
translations.hypothesis: It is possible that asteroids were responsible for delivering water to Earth, as well as the organic molecules that can form proteins and support life.

translations.source: Wanasayansi wanatumai kuelewa jinsi sayari huundwa, hasa jinsi Dunia ilivyoundwa, kwani nyotamkia ziligongana na Dunia kitambo.
translations.reference: Scientists hope to understand how planets form, especially how the Earth formed, since comets collided with the Earth long ago.
translations.hypothesis: Scientists hope to learn more about how planets form, including how our own solar system formed, as the telescopes will be able to see light from the very early universe.

translations.source: Cuomo, mwenye umri wa miaka 53, alianza ugavana wake mapema mwaka huu na kutia saini mswada mwezi uliopita wa kuhalalisha ndoa za jinsia moja.
translations.reference: Cuomo, 53, began his governorship earlier this year and signed a bill last month legalizing same-sex marriage.
translations.hypothesis: Cuomo, 53, who was sworn in as governor earlier this year, signed the bill into law last month to legalize same-sex marriage.

translations.source: Alitaja uvumi huo kama "mapayuko na upumbavu wa kisiasa".
translations.reference: He referred to the rumors as "political chatter and silliness".
translations.hypothesis: He called the rumours "cheap blackmail and political propaganda."

translations.source: Alifikiria kugombea urais mnamo 2016.
translations.reference: He is speculated to make a run for president in 2016.
translations.hypothesis: He considered running for president in 2016.

translations.source: NextGen ni mfumo ambao Utawala wa Shirikisho la Anga unadai ungeruhusu ndege kutumia njia fupi na kuokoa mamilioni ya galoni za mafuta kila mwaka na kukata uzalishaji wa kaboni.
translations.reference: NextGen is a system the FAA claims would allow aircraft to fly shorter routes and save millions of gallons of fuel each year and cut carbon emissions.
translations.hypothesis: NextGen is a system that the Federal Aviation Administration claims will allow planes to take the most efficient routes and save millions of gallons of fuel and cut carbon emissions.

translations.source: Hutumia teknolojia yenye msingi wa setalaiti kinyume na teknolojia ya kitambo yenye msingi wa radar ya ardhini ili kuwezesha wadhibiti wa trafiki ya anga kupata vyombo vya angani kwa usahihi zaidi na kuwapatia marubani taarifa za usahihi zaidi.
translations.reference: It uses satellite-based technology as opposed to older ground-radar-based technology to allow air traffic controllers to pinpoint aircraft with greater precision and give pilots more accurate information.
translations.hypothesis: It uses space-based technology as opposed to ground-based radar technology to allow air traffic controllers to see aircraft more precisely and provide pilots with more accurate information.

translations.source: Hakuna usafiri wa ziada unaowekwa na treni za juu ya ardhi hazitasimama huko Wembley, na maegesho ya magari na vituo vya kuegesha na kusafiri havipatikani huko.
translations.reference: No extra transport is being put on and overground trains will not stop at Wembley, and car parking and park-and-ride facilities are unavailable at the ground.
translations.hypothesis: There are no additional services provided by the Underground and the high-speed trains do not stop at Wembley, and parking for cars and buses is extremely limited.

translations.source: Hofu ya ukosefu wa usafiri kulizua uwezekano kwamba mchezo huo ungelazimika kuchezwa nyuma ya milango iliyofungwa bila wafuasi wa timu hiyo.
translations.reference: Fears of lack of transportation raised the possibility that the game would be forced to play behind closed doors without the team's supporters.
translations.hypothesis: Fears over a potential travel ban prompted suggestions that the match might have to be played behind closed doors with no fans from the team's home city in attendance.

translations.source: Utafiti uliochapishwa Alhamisi katika jarida la Science uliripoti kuhusu kuundwa kwa spishi mpya ya ndege katika Visiwa vya Galapagos vya Kiekuado.
translations.reference: A study published on Thursday in the journal Science reported on formation of a new bird species on the Ecuadorean Galápagos Islands.
translations.hypothesis: A study published on Thursday in the journal Science reported the discovery of a new species of finch in the Galapagos Islands of Ecuador.

translations.source: Watafiti kutoka Chuo Kikuu cha Princeton katika Marekani na Chuo Kikuu cha Uppsala katika Uswidi waliripoti spishi hiyo mpya iligeuka katika vizazi viwili pekee, ingawa mchakato huu ulikuwa unaaminika kuchukua muda mrefu zaidi, kwa sababu ya kuzaana kati ya wenyeji shorewanda wa Darwin, Geospiza fortes , na wahamiaji shorewanda wa dungusi kakati, Geospiza conirostris.
translations.reference: Researchers from Princeton University in the United States and Uppsala University in Sweden reported the new species evolved in just two generations, though this process had been believed to take much longer, due to breeding between an endemic Darwin finch, Geospiza fortes, and the immigrant cactus finch, Geospiza conirostris.
translations.hypothesis: Researchers from Princeton University in the United States and Uppsala University in Sweden reported that the new species had apparently evolved in just two generations, although this process was probably much longer, because it involved the hybridization of the original Darwin's finches, Geospiza fortis, and a now-extinct finch, Geospiza conirostris.

translations.source: Dhahabu inaweza kutengenezwa ikawa maumbo tofauti tofauti. Inaweza kuvingirishwa ikawa maumbo madogo.
translations.reference: Gold may be worked into all sorts of shapes. It can be rolled into tiny shapes.
translations.hypothesis: Gold can be made into many different shapes. It can be rolled into thin sheets.

translations.source: Inaweza kuvutwa na kuwa waya nyembamba, ambayo inaweza kusokotwa na kusukwa. Inaweza kubabatwa au kufiringishwa kufanya bamba.
translations.reference: It can be pulled into thin wire, which can be twisted and plaited. It can be hammered or rolled into sheets.
translations.hypothesis: It can be drawn into thin wires, which can be hammered and stretched. It can be cast or forged into many shapes.

translations.source: Inaweza kutengenezwa nyembamba zaidi, na kukwamishwa kwenye metali nyingine. Inaweza kutengenezwa nyembamba zaidi hadi wakati mwingine ilitumika kupamba picha zilizochorwa kwa mkono zinazoitwa “miswada iliyoangazwa”.
