translations.reference: It can be made very thin, and stuck onto other metal. It can be made so thin that it was sometimes used to decorate the hand-painted pictures in books called "illuminated manuscripts".
translations.hypothesis: It can be made very thin, and is often laminated to other metals. It can be made extremely thin again in a process called "drawing" to produce thin sheets used in electrical contacts or as decorative gilding on illuminated manuscripts.

translations.source: Hii inaitwa pH ya kemikali. Unaweza kutengeneza kiashiria kutumia juisi ya kabichi nyekundu.
translations.reference: This is called a chemical's pH. You can make an indicator using red cabbage juice.
translations.hypothesis: This is called the chemical pH. You can make an indicator using red cabbage juice.

translations.source: Sharubati ya kabichi hubadilisha rangi kulingana na uasidi au ubesi (ualkali) wa kemikali.
translations.reference: The cabbage juice changes color depending on how acidic or basic (alkaline) the chemical is.
translations.hypothesis: Red cabbage juice turns reddish-purple or reddish-blue depending on the acidity or alkalinity of the chemical.

translations.source: Kiwango cha pH huashiriwa na kiasi cha ioni za Hidrojeni (H katika pH) kwenye kemikali iliyofanyiwa jaribio.
translations.reference: The pH level is indicated by the amount of Hydrogen (the H in pH) ions in the tested chemical.
translations.hypothesis: The pH is determined by the amount of hydrogen ions (H+) in a solution.

translations.source: Ioni za Hidrojeni ni protoni ambazo zilibambuliwa elektroni zazo (kwani atomu za Hidrojeni huwa na protoni moja na elektroni moja).
translations.reference: Hydrogen ions are protons that had their electrons stripped off them (since Hydrogen atoms consist of one proton and one electron).
translations.hypothesis: Hydrogen ions are just protons that have lost their electrons (since a hydrogen atom has only one proton and one electron).

translations.source: Funganya poda mbili kavu kisha, kwa mikono safi yenye unyevu, ziingize kwenye mpira.
translations.reference: Swirl the two dry powders together and then, with clean wet hands, squeeze them into a ball.
translations.hypothesis: Open the two foil pouches and, with clean dry hands, carefully place the powder inside the rubber bulb.

translations.source: Unyevu kwenye mikono yako utaguswa na tabaka za nje, ambayo utahisi ikiwa tofauti na kuunda ganda aina fulani.
translations.reference: The moisture on your hands will react with the outer layers, which will feel funny and form a sort of shell.
translations.hypothesis: Moisture on your hands will then come into contact with the outer layers, which you'll feel as a sort of gritty film.

translations.source: Miji ya Harappa na Mohenjo-daro ilikuwa na choo cha kisasa katika karibu kila nyumba, kilichounganishwa kwenye mfumo tata wa maji taka.
translations.reference: The cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro had a flush toilet in almost every house, attached to a sophisticated sewage system.
translations.hypothesis: The cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro had a modern sewage system in nearly every house, connected to an intricate system of drains.

translations.source: Mabaki ya mfumo wa maji taka yamepatikana kwenye nyumba za miji ya Kiminoa ya Crete na Santorini katika Ugiriki.
translations.reference: Remains of sewage systems have been found in the houses of the Minoan cities of Crete and Santorini in Greece.
translations.hypothesis: The remains of an early sewage system have been found in the Minoan palaces of Crete and Santorini in Greece.

translations.source: Pia kulikuwa na choo katika Misri, Uajemi na China ya kale. Katika ustaarabu wa Kirumi, wakati mwingine choo zilikuwa sehemu ya nyumba za bafu za umma ambapo waume na wake walichanganyika pamoja.
translations.reference: There were also toilets in ancient Egypt, Persia and China. In Roman civilization, toilets were sometimes part of public bath houses where men and women were together in mixed company.
translations.hypothesis: There were also toilets in ancient Egypt, Persia and China. In ancient Rome, sometimes toilets were part of the public bathhouses where men and women would mingle.

translations.source: Unapompigia simu mtu aliye mbali maelfu ya maili, unatumia satelaiti.
translations.reference: When you call someone who is thousands of miles away, you are using a satellite.
translations.hypothesis: When you call someone who is thousands of miles away, you are using a satellite.

translations.source: Setilaiti iliyo angani hupata simu kisha inaiakisi tena chini, karibu papo hapo.
translations.reference: The satellite in space gets the call and then reflects it back down, almost instantly.
translations.hypothesis: The satellite in space receives the signal and immediately re-transmits it back down to Earth.

translations.source: Setalaiti ilitumwa angani kwa kutumia roketi. Wanasayansi hutumia darubini angani kwa sababu anga ya dunia huvuruga sehemu ya nuru na mtazamo wetu.
translations.reference: The satellite was sent into space by a rocket. Scientists use telescopes in space because the Earth’s atmosphere distorts some of our light and view.
translations.hypothesis: The satellite was launched into orbit using a rocket. Scientists use space telescopes because the Earth's atmosphere distorts some of the light and our view.

translations.source: Huhitaji roketi kubwa yenye urefu wa zaidi ya futi 100 kuweka setalaiti au darubini angani.
translations.reference: It takes a giant rocket over a 100 feet high to put a satellite or telescope in space.
translations.hypothesis: You don't need a giant rocket over 100 feet tall to put a satellite or telescope into space.

translations.source: Gurudumu limebadilisha dunia kwa njia za ajabu. Jambo kubwa zaidi ambalo gurudumu limetufanyia ni kutupatia uchukuzi rahisi na wa haraka.
translations.reference: The wheel has changed the world in incredible ways. The biggest thing that the wheel has done for us is given us much easier and faster transportation.
translations.hypothesis: The wheel has changed the world in amazing ways. The greatest thing the wheel has done for us is give us easy and fast transportation.

translations.source: Imetuletea treni, gari, na vifaa vingine vingi vya uchukuzi.
translations.reference: It has brought us the train, the car, and many other transportation devices.
translations.hypothesis: It has given us trains, cars, and many other forms of transportation.

translations.source: Chini yake kunao paka zaidi zenye mwili wa wastani ambao hula mawindo yenye mwili wa wastani kuanzia sungura hadi swara na kulungu.
translations.reference: Under them are more medium sized cats that eat medium sized prey ranging from rabbits to antelopes and deer.
translations.hypothesis: Below them are the medium-sized cats that prey on medium-sized ungulates, ranging from pigs to deer and antelopes.

translations.source: Mwishowe, kuna paka wengi wadogo (wakiwemo paka huru vipenzi) ambao hula mawindo madogomadogo ambayo ni mengi, kama wadudu, panya, mijusi, na ndege.
translations.reference: Finally, there are many small cats (including loose pet cats) that eat the far more numerous small prey like insects, rodents, lizards, and birds.
translations.hypothesis: Finally, there are many small carnivores (including the domestic cat) that prey on small animals, such as insects, mice, voles, and birds.

translations.source: Siri ya mafanikio yao ni dhana ya niche, kazi maalum ambayo kila paka anashikilia na inayomzuia kushindana na wengine.
translations.reference: The secret to their success is the concept of the niche, a special job each cat holds that keeps it from competing with others.
translations.hypothesis: The key to their success is the niche concept, a specific task that each tomcat performs and that keeps them from competing with one another.

translations.source: Simba ni baadhi ya wanyama wa jamii ya paka wanaopenda ujamii zaidi, na wanaishi katika vikundi vikubwa vinavyoitwa prides.
translations.reference: Lions are the most social cats, living in large groups called prides.
translations.hypothesis: Lions are some of the most social of the cat family, and live in big groups called prides.

translations.source: Makundi ya simba yanatengenezwa na waume kati ya mmoja na watatu wazima wanaohusiana, pamoja na wengi wa kike kama thelathini na mashibli.
translations.reference: Prides are made up of one to three related adult males, along with as many as thirty females and cubs.
translations.hypothesis: Lion prides are made up of one to three adult males, several related females, and their offspring.

translations.source: Wanawake kawaida ndio uhusiana sana wao kwa wao, kwa kuwa familia kubwa ya madada na mabinti.
translations.reference: The females are usually closely related to each other, being a large family of sisters and daughters.
translations.hypothesis: Women are often more related to each other than they are to their own children, because of the extended family of sisters and cousins.

translations.source: Makundi ya simba hutenda kama makundi ya mbwa mwitu au mbwa, wanyama ambao kwa kushangaza ni sawa na simba (lakini si paka wengine wakubwa) kitabia, na pia ni hatari kwa mawindo yao.
translations.reference: Lion prides act much like packs of wolves or dogs, animals surprisingly similar to lions (but not other big cats) in behavior, and also very deadly to their prey.
translations.hypothesis: Lion prides themselves as the wolves or dogs of the jungle, animals that are closely related to lions (but not as closely as domestic cats) in behavior, and similarly to their prey.

translations.source: Mwanariadha wa mambo anuwai, simbamarara anaweza kupanda (ingawa si vizuri), kuogelea, kuruka mbali sana na kuvuta kwa nguvu mara tano ya zile za mwanamume mwenye nguvu.
translations.reference: A well rounded athlete, the tiger can climb (though not well), swim, leap great distances and pull with five times the force of a strong human.
translations.hypothesis: An all-around athlete, the chimpanzee can run (though not very fast), swim, jump and has five times the strength of a man.

translations.source: Chui yuko kwenye kundi moja (jenasi panther) na simba, lengau na chui wa America ya kusini na kati. Hawa paka wanne pekee ndio wanaoweza kunguruma.
translations.reference: The tiger is in the same group (Genus Panthera) as lions, leopards, and jaguars. These four cats are the only ones who can roar.
translations.hypothesis: The leopard is in the same genus (Panthera) as the lion, tiger, and jaguar. These four are the only cats that can roar.

translations.source: Mgurumo wa simbamarara si kama mgurumo mkubwa wa simba, bali ni zaidi kama sentensi ya kemeo yenye maneno yanayotolewa kwa kelele.
translations.reference: The tiger's roar is not like the full-voiced roar of a lion, but more like a sentence of snarly, shouted words.
translations.hypothesis: The roar of a lion is not like the trumpeting of an elephant, but more like a sentence with words spoken in a shout.

translations.source: Paka mwitu hupenda kula wanyama wadogo. Hushika tumbili, nyoka, panya na ndege kama wanaweza. Karibu wanyama wote ambao paka mwitu huwinda ni wadogo kumliko.
translations.reference: Ocelots like to eat small animals. They will catch monkeys, snakes, rodents and birds if they can. Almost all of the animals that the ocelot hunts are far smaller than it is.
translations.hypothesis: Wild cats like to eat small animals. They catch monkeys, snakes, mice and birds if they can. Most of the animals that the wild cat hunts are smaller than it.

translations.source: Wanasayansi wanafikiria kwamba paka mwitu hufuata na kutafuta wanyama wa kula (windo) kwa harufu, kunusa ili kutafuta walikokuwa ardhini.
translations.reference: Scientists think that ocelots follow and find animals to eat (prey) by smell, sniffing for where they've been on the ground.
translations.hypothesis: Scientists think that the wildcat stalks and pounces on its prey, using its sense of smell to find prey that is hidden in the ground.

translations.source: Wanaweza kuona vizuri sana kwa giza na maono ya usiku pia wanasonga kwa kimya sana. Ocelots huwinda mawindo yao kwa kujichanganya na mazingira yao kasha kurukia mawindo yao.
translations.reference: They can see very well in the dark with night vision, and move very stealthily, too. Ocelots hunt their prey by blending in with their surroundings then pouncing on their prey.
translations.hypothesis: They can see very well in the dark and night vision is also very good. Ocelots hunt by stalking their prey and then pouncing on it.

translations.source: Wakati kundi dogo la vitu vilivyo hai (idadi ndogo) linatenganishwa na idadi kubwa walimotoka (kama wakipita juu ya milima au mto, au wakihamia kwenye kisiwa kigeni hivi kwamba hawawezi kurudi nyuma kwa urahisi) mara nyingi watajipata katika mazingira tofauti na walimokuwa awali.
translations.reference: When a small group of living things (a small population) gets separated from the main population that they came from (like if they move over a mountain range or a river, or if they move to a new island so that they can't easily move back) they will often find themselves in a different environment than they were in before.
translations.hypothesis: When a small number of organisms (a subset) of a population is separated from the larger population (e.g., by a mountain range or a river, or by being transported to a distant island) they may find themselves in a new environment and subject to new selective pressures.

translations.source: Mazingira haya mapya yana rasilimali tofauti na washindani tofauti, kwa hivyo idadi mpya ya watu itahitaji vipengele au mazoea tofauti ili kuwa washindani imara kuliko walichohitaji awali.
translations.reference: This new environment has different resources and different competitors, so the new population will need different features or adaptations to be a strong competitor than what they had needed before.
translations.hypothesis: This new environment has different resources and different competitors, so the new population will need different features or practices in order to be as successful as the previous population.

translations.source: Idadi asili haijabadilika kamwe, bado wanahitaji mbinu zile zile za za awali.
translations.reference: The original population hasn't changed at all, they still need the same adaptations as before.
translations.hypothesis: The original numbers were never changed, they still need those same old methods.

translations.source: Kwa muda, jinsi idadi mpya inavyoanza kuzoea mazingira yao mapya, wanaanza kuonekana zaidi na zaidi tofauti na idadi ile nyingine.
translations.reference: Over time, as the new population begins to adapt to their new environment, they start to look less and less like the other population.
translations.hypothesis: Over time, as the new population becomes better adapted to its new environment, it will begin to diverge from the original population.

translations.source: Mwishowe, baada ya maelfu au hata mamilioni ya miaka, wakazi hao wawili wataonekana tofauti sana kwamba hawawezi kuitwa spishi moja.
translations.reference: Eventually, after thousands or even millions of years, the two populations will look so different that they can't be called the same species.
translations.hypothesis: Eventually, after thousands or even millions of years, the two populations will become so different that they can no longer interbreed.

translations.source: Tunauita mchakato huu speciation, ambalo linamanisha uundaji wa spishi mpya. Speciation ni matokeo yasiyoweza kuepukika na sehemu muhimu sana ya mageuzi.
translations.reference: We call this process speciation, which just means the formation of new species. Speciation is an unavoidable consequence and a very important part of evolution.
translations.hypothesis: We call this process speciation, which means the formation of new species. Speciation is an inevitable and necessary consequence of evolution.

translations.source: Mimea hutengeneza oksijeni ambayo binadamu hupumua, na huingiza kabonidioksidi ambayo binadamu hutoa nje (yaani, kupumua nje).
translations.reference: Plants make oxygen which humans breathe, and they take in carbon-dioxide which humans exhale (that is, breathe out).
translations.hypothesis: Plants produce oxygen, which humans breathe in, and take in carbon dioxide, which humans breathe out (i.e. exhale).

translations.source: Mimea hupata chakula chao kutoka kwa jua kupitia usanisinuru. Pia hupatia kuvuli
translations.reference: Plants make their food from the sun by photosynthesis. They also provide shade.
translations.hypothesis: Plants get their food from the sun through a process called photosynthesis. They also provide shade.

translations.source: Sisi hutengeneza nyumba zetu kwa mimea na kutengeneza nguo zetu kwa mimea. Chakula kingi ambacho sisi hula ni mimea. Bila mimea, wanyama hawawezi kuishi.
translations.reference: We make our houses from plants and make clothes from plants. Most foods that we eat are plants. Without plants, animals could not survive.
translations.hypothesis: We build our houses with plants and make our clothes from plants. Most of the food we eat is from plants. Without plants, animals could not live.

translations.source: Mosasaurus ilikuwa mwindaji mkubwa wa wakati huo, kwa hivyo haikuogopa chochote isipokuwa Mosasaurus wengine.
translations.reference: Mosasaurus was the apex predator of its time, so it feared nothing, except other mosasaurs.
translations.hypothesis: The Mosasaurus was the top predator of its time, so it had no natural enemies other than other Mosasaurs.

translations.source: Taya zake kubwa zilikuwa na zaidi ya meno 70 kali kama wembe, pamoja na seti ya ziada kwenye paa la mdomo wake, kumaanisha kwamba chochote kilichokutana naye hakingehepa.
translations.reference: Its long jaws were studded with more than 70 razor-sharp teeth, along with an extra set in the roof of its mouth, meaning that there was no escape for anything that crossed its path.
translations.hypothesis: Its huge teeth — more than 70 sharp, blade-like teeth, with an extra set in the roof of its mouth — meant that nothing it bit into could easily escape.

translations.source: Hatujui kwa kweli, lakini inaweza kuwa alikuwa na ulimi uliogawanyika. Lishe yake ni pamoja na kasa, samaki wakubwa, mosasau wengine, na labda anaweza kuwa kiumbe alaye wenziwe.
translations.reference: We don't know for sure, but it may have had a forked tongue. Its diet included turtles, large fish, other mosasaurs, and it may even have been a cannibal.
translations.hypothesis: We don't really know, but it may have had a split tongue. Its diet probably included fish, large squid, and other marine life, and it may have even eaten its own companions.

translations.source: Pia alishambulia chochote kilichoingia majini; hata dinosau mkubwa kama vile T. rex hangejimudu dhidi yake.
translations.reference: It also attacked anything that entered the water; even a giant dinosaur such as T. rex would be no match for it.
translations.hypothesis: It also attacked anything that went into the water; even a huge dinosaur like T. rex would not have been a match for it.

translations.source: Wakati nyingi ya vyakula vyao tunavifahamu, Warumi walikuwa na sehemu yao ya vitu vya karamu vya kushangaza au visivyo vya kawaida, pamoja na nguruwe mwitu, tausi, konokono, na aina ya panya inayoitwa dormouse
translations.reference: While most of their food would be familiar to us, Romans did have their share of strange or unusual feast items, including wild boar, peacock, snails, and a type of rodent called a dormouse
translations.hypothesis: While much of their cuisine is familiar, the Romans also had their share of bizarre or exotic foods, including dormice, peacocks, flamingo, and a type of vole called a nucella.

translations.source: Tofauti nyingine ilikuwa kwamba huku watu masikini na mwanamke wakila chakula chao huku wameketi kwenye viti, watu tajiri walipenda kuwa na karamu pamoja ambapo wangepumzika kwa upande huku wakila vyakula vyao.
translations.reference: Another difference was that while the poor people and the woman ate their food while sitting in chairs, the rich men liked to have banquets together where they would lounge on their sides while they ate their meals.
translations.hypothesis: Another difference was that while the poor and the women ate their meals while sitting on the floor, the rich preferred to have banquets where they reclined on couches while they ate.

translations.source: Milo ya kale ya Kiroma haingejumuisha vyakula vilivyoingia Uropa kutoka Marekani au kutoka Asia katika karne za baadaye.
translations.reference: Ancient Roman meals couldn't have included foods that came to Europe from America or from Asia in later centuries.
translations.hypothesis: The ancient Roman diet would not have included foods that came to Europe from the Americas or from Asia in later centuries.

translations.source: Kwa mfano, hawakuwa na mahindi, wala nyanya, wala viazi, wala kakao, na hakuna Mrumi wa zamani aliyewahi kuonja batamzinga.
translations.reference: For instance, they didn't have corn, nor tomatoes, nor potatoes, nor cocoa, and no ancient Roman ever tasted a turkey.
translations.hypothesis: For example, they had no maize, nor tomatoes, nor potatoes, nor cacao, and no ancient Roman has ever tasted a pineapple.

translations.source: Wababeli waliwajengea kila mmoja wa miungu yao hekalu la msingi ambalo lilizingatiwa kuwa nyumba ya mungu huyo.
translations.reference: The Babylonians built each of their gods a primary temple that was considered the home of the god.
translations.hypothesis: The Babylonians built a ziggurat for each of their gods which was considered to be the god's special home.

translations.source: Watu wangeleta dhabihu kwa miungu na makuhani wangejaribu kushughulikia mahitaji ya miungu kupitia sherehe na tamasha.
translations.reference: People would bring sacrifices to the gods and the priests would try to attend to the needs of the gods through ceremonies and festivals.
translations.hypothesis: People would bring offerings to the gods and the priests would try to divine the gods' will through oracles and other means.

translations.source: Kila kasri lilikuwa na uwanja wazi wa kasri na kisha mahali pa ndani patakatifu ambamo ni makasisi tu wangeweza kuingia.
translations.reference: Each temple had an open temple courtyard and then an inner sanctuary that only the priests could enter.
translations.hypothesis: Each temple had an outer court which was open to everyone and then an inner sanctum where only priests could go.

translations.source: Wakati mwingine piramidi maalum zenye umbo la mnara, zinazoitwa ziggurat, zilijengwa ili ziwe sehemu ya hekalu.
translations.reference: Sometimes special pyramid shaped towers, called ziggurats, were built to be a part of the temples.
translations.hypothesis: Sometimes a special tower-like pyramid, called a ziggurat, was built as part of the temple.

translations.source: Sehemu ya juu ilikuwa makao matakatifu ya mungu.
translations.reference: The top of the tower was special sanctuary for the god.
translations.hypothesis: The upper part was the temple dedicated to the god.

translations.source: Katika hali joto ya hewa ya Mashariki ya Kati, nyumba haikuwa muhimu sana.
translations.reference: In the warm climate of the Middle East, the house was not so important.
translations.hypothesis: In the hot climate of the Middle East, the house was not so important.

translations.source: Sehemu kubwa ya maisha ya familia ya Kiebrania ilifanyikia nje.
translations.reference: Most of the life of the Hebrew family happened in the open air.
translations.hypothesis: Most of the life of the Jewish family took place outdoors.

translations.source: Wanawake walifanya mapishi kwenye yadi; stoo zilikuwa kaunta wazi tu zilizoelekea barabarani. Mawe yalitumika kujengea barabara.
translations.reference: Women did the cooking in the yard; stores were just open counters looking into the street. Stone was used for building houses.
translations.hypothesis: Women made cloth in the yards; stores were just open-front sheds facing the road. Stones were used to pave the road.

translations.source: Hakukua na misitu mikubwa kwenye ardhi ya Canaan, kwa hivyo mbao ziliuzwa kwa bei ghali mno.
translations.reference: There were no large forests in the land of Canaan, so wood was extremely expensive.
translations.hypothesis: There were no large forests in the land of Canaan, so timber was very expensive.

translations.source: Greenland ilikuwa na watu chache. Katika Norse sagas wanasema kwamba Erik aliye Mwekundu alifukuzwa kutoka Iceland kwa mauaji, na wakati wa kusafiri Magharibi zaidi, aliipata Greenland na kuiita Greenland.
translations.reference: Greenland was settled sparsely. In the Norse sagas they say that Erik the Red was exiled from Iceland for murder, and when travelling further west, found Greenland and named it Greenland.
translations.hypothesis: Greenland was inhabited by few people. In the Norse sagas it says that Eric the Red was exiled from Iceland for murder, and when sailing west in search of new land, he found Greenland and named it Greenland.

translations.source: Lakina licha ya ugunduzi wake, makabila ya Eskimo yalikuwa tayari yanaishi huko wakati huo.
translations.reference: But regardless of his discovery, Eskimo tribes were already living there at the time.
translations.hypothesis: But despite the discovery, the Inuit people had already been living there for thousands of years.

translations.source: Ingawa kila nchi ilikuwa ya 'Kiskandinavia', kulikuwa na tofauti nyingi kati ya watu, wafalme, mila na historia za Denmaki, Uswidi, Norway na Aislandi.
translations.reference: Though each country was 'Scandinavian', there were many differences between the people, kings, customs and history of Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Iceland.
translations.hypothesis: Although every country was 'Scandinavian', there were many differences between the people, the kings, the customs and the histories of Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Iceland.

translations.source: Iwapo umetazama sinema ya Hazina ya Kitaifa, huenda ukafikiri ramani ya hazina iliandikwa nyuma ya Tangazo la Uhuru.
translations.reference: If you have watched the movie National Treasure, you may think a treasure map was written on the back of the Declaration of Independence.
translations.hypothesis: If you've seen the movie National Treasure, you might think the treasure map was hidden on the back of the Declaration of Independence.

translations.source: Hata hivyo, hilo si kweli. Ingawa kuna kitu kilichoandikwa nyuma ya hati, si ramani ya hazina.
translations.reference: However, that is not true. Although there is something written on the back of the document, it is not a treasure map.
translations.hypothesis: However, that is not the case. While there's a paper trail behind the token, it's not a map to the treasure.

translations.source: Nyuma ya Tangazo la Uhuru kuliandikwa maneno “Tangazo halisi la Uhuru la tarehe 4 Julai 1776”. Maandishi hayo yako katika sehemu ya chini ya hati, juu chini.
translations.reference: Written on the back of the Declaration of Independence were the words "Original Declaration of Independence dated 4th July 1776". The text appears on the bottom of the document, upside down.
translations.hypothesis: Behind the Declaration is written "The Unanimous Declaration of the 13 United States of America, 4th July 1776". The text is at the bottom of the document, upside down.

translations.source: Wakati hakuna anayejua kwa hakika ni nani aliyeiandika, inajulikana kwamba hati hiyo kubwa ya ngozi (ina vipimo vya inchi 29¾ kwa inchi 24½) ilikunjwa kwa uhifadhi.
translations.reference: While no one knows for certain who wrote it, it is known that early in its life, the large parchment document (it measures 29¾ inches by 24½ inches) was rolled up for storage.
translations.hypothesis: While it is not known for sure who authored it, it is known that the large leather-bound document (measuring 29¾ by 24½ inches) was rolled up for storage.

translations.source: Kwa hivyo, kuna uwezekano kuwa nukuu liliongezwa liwe kama ishara.
translations.reference: So, it is likely that the notation was added simply as a label.
translations.hypothesis: So, there's a possibility the quotes were added to throw him off.

translations.source: Utuaji siku ya shambulio na mapigano yaliyofuata yalikuwa yameweka huru kaskazini mwa Ufaransa, lakini kusini bado haikuwa huru.
translations.reference: The D-Day landings and the following battles had freed the north of France, but the south still wasn't free.
translations.hypothesis: The attack on the day and the fighting that followed had secured the north of France, but the south was not yet free.

translations.source: Ilitawaliwa na Wafaransa wa “Vichy”. Hawa walikuwa watu wa Ufaransa ambao walikuwa wamefanya amani na Wajerumani mnamo 1940 na kufanya kazi na washambulizi badala ya kupigana nao.
translations.reference: It was ruled by the "Vichy" French. These were French people who had made peace with the Germans in 1940 and worked with the invaders instead of fighting them.
translations.hypothesis: It was ruled by the French of "Vichy". These were French people who had made peace with the Germans in 1940 and worked with the invaders rather than fight them.

translations.source: Mnamo Agosti 15 1940, Majeshi ya Kirafiki yalishambulia Ufaransa kusini, shambulio liliitwa "Operesheni Dragoon".
translations.reference: On 15 August 1940, the Allies invaded southern France, the invasion was called "Operation Dragoon".
translations.hypothesis: On August 15 1944, Allied forces landed in the south of France, in a landing called "Operation Dragoon".

translations.source: Kwa kipindi cha majuma mawili tu vikosi vya Marekani na Ufaransa Huru vilikuwa vimekomboa Ufaransa kusini na vilikuwa vikielekea Ujerumani.
translations.reference: In just two weeks the Americans and Free French forces had liberated southern France and were turning towards Germany.
translations.hypothesis: In just two weeks the American and Free French forces had liberated Southern France and were pushing into Germany.

translations.source: Ustaarabu ni utamaduni wa umoja unaoshirikiwa na kundi kubwa la watu wanaoishi na kufanya kazi kwa kushirikiana, jamii.
translations.reference: A civilization is a singular culture shared by a significant large group of people who live and work co-operatively, a society.
translations.hypothesis: A civilisation is a complex culture shared by a large group of people who are living and working together, a society.

translations.source: Neno ustaarabu hutoka katika civilis la Kilatini, ambalo linamaanisha ya kiraia, linalohusiana na civis la Kilatini, linalomaanisha raia, na civitas, linalomaanisha mji au jimbo la mji, na ambalo kwa namna fulani linaelezea ukubwa wa jamii.
translations.reference: The word civilization comes from the Latin civilis, meaning civil, related to the Latin civis, meaning citizen, and civitas, meaning city or city-state, and that also somehow defines the size of the society.
translations.hypothesis: The word civilisation comes from the Latin civis, meaning citizen, and civitas, meaning city or city-state, and roughly indicates the degree of social organization.

translations.source: Majimbo ya miji hutanguliza mataifa. Utamaduni wa kistaarabu huashiria kupitishwa kwa maarifa katika vizazi kadhaa, wayo wa kitamaduni unaoendelea kukaa kwa muda na usambazaji wenye haki.
translations.reference: City-states are the precursors of nations. A civilizational culture implies the passing on of knowledge across several generations, a lingering cultural footprint and fair dissemination.
translations.hypothesis: States Parties promote cultures of safety. A safety culture is characterized by the widespread internalization of values, attitudes, and behaviours that support safety, a commitment to safety at all levels, and effective communication and consultation about safety.

translations.source: Tamaduni ndogo mara nyingi hutoweka bila kuacha ushahidi muhimu wa kihistoria na kukosa kutambuliwa kama ustaarabu barabara.
translations.reference: Minor cultures often vanish without leaving relevant historic evidence and fail to be recognized as proper civilizations.
translations.hypothesis: Small cultures often disappear without leaving any significant historical record and go unrecognized as cultures by mainstream society.

translations.source: Wakati wa Vita vya Mapinduzi, majimbo kumi na matatu kwanza yaliunda serikali dhaifu ya kati – huku Bunge la Marekani likiwa ndiyo sehemu yake pekee – chini ya Vifungu vya Shirikisho.
translations.reference: During the Revolutionary War, the thirteen states first formed a weak central government—with the Congress being its only component—under the Articles of Confederation.
translations.hypothesis: During the Revolutionary War, the original thirteen colonies established a weak central government—with Congress as its only component—under the Articles of Confederation.

translations.source: Kongamano lilikosa uwezo wowote wa kuweka ushuru, na, kwa sababu hakukuwa na mtendaji wa kitaifa au mahakama, lilitegemea mamlaka ya taifa, ambao mara nyingi hawakuwa na ushirikiano, kutekeleza sheria zake.
translations.reference: Congress lacked any power to impose taxes, and, because there was no national executive or judiciary, it relied on state authorities, who were often uncooperative, to enforce all its acts.
translations.hypothesis: The Congress had no taxing powers, and, lacking a national executive or judiciary, it relied on the cooperation of the states, which often failed to implement its laws.

translations.source: Pia haikuwa na mamlaka ya kupuuza sheria na orodha za ushuru kati ya majimbo.
translations.reference: It also had no authority to override tax laws and tariffs between states.
translations.hypothesis: It also lacked the authority to override state laws and tax structures.

translations.source: Vifungu vilihitaji ridhaa ya pamoja kutoka kwa majimbo yote kabla ya kurekebishwa na majimbo yalichukulia serikali kuu kwa mzaha sana kiasi kwamba mara nyingi wawakilishi wao hawakuwepo.
translations.reference: The Articles required unanimous consent from all the states before they could be amended and states took the central government so lightly that their representatives were often absent.
translations.hypothesis: The articles required unanimous consent from all states before they could be amended and the states took the central government to task over this, with representatives often not bothering to show up.

translations.source: Timu ya soka ya Italia, pamoja na timu ya soka ya Ujerumani ndiyo timu ya pili yenye mafanikio zaidi duniani na ilikuwa bingwa wa kikombe cha dunia cha FIFA mwaka wa 2006.
translations.reference: Italy's national football, along with German national football team is the second most successful team in the world and were the FIFA World Cup champions in 2006.
translations.hypothesis: The Italy national football team, along with the German national football team, is one of only two teams to have won the FIFA World Cup more than once, and were the winners in 2006.

translations.source: Michezo maarufu ni pamoja na kandanda, mpira wa kikapu, mpira wa wavu, polo ya majini, mchezo wa uzio, raga, uendeshaji baiskeli, hoki ya barafu, hoki ya gogo na mashindano ya magari ya F1.
translations.reference: Popular sports include football, basketball, volleyball, water-polo, fencing, rugby, cycling, ice hockey, roller hockey and F1 motor racing.
translations.hypothesis: Popular sports include soccer, basketball, volleyball, water polo, fencing, rugby, cycling, ice hockey, field hockey and Formula 1 auto racing.

translations.source: Spoti za msimu wa baridi ni maarufu sana katika maeneo ya Kaskazini, ambako Waitaliano hushindana katika michezo ya kimataifa na ya Olimpiki.
translations.reference: Winter sports are most popular in the Northern regions, with Italians competing in international games and Olympic events.
translations.hypothesis: The winter sports are very popular in the northern areas, where Italians compete in international and Olympic events.

translations.source: Japani humiliki visiwa karibu 7,000 (kikubwa zaidi kikiwa Honshu), hivyo kuifanya Japani kuwa kisiwa cha 7 kikubwa zaidi duniani!
translations.reference: Japans holds nearly 7,000 islands (the biggest being Honshu), making Japan the 7th largest island in the world!
translations.hypothesis: Japan is an archipelago of 7,000 islands (the largest of which is Honshu), making it the 7th largest island in the world!

translations.source: Kwa sababu ya mafungu/vikundi vya visiwa Japani ilivyo navyo, mara nyingi Japani huitwa, kwa msimamo wa kijiografia, "funguvisiwa"
translations.reference: Due to the cluster/group of islands Japan has, Japan is often referred to, on a geographical stance, as an "archipelago"
translations.hypothesis: Due to Japan's many islands, Japan is sometimes referred to, geographically, as an archipelago.

translations.source: Taiwan ilianza nyuma kitambo katika karne ya 15 ambapo mabaharia wa Kiingereza wanaopita hurekodi jina la kisiwa hicho kama Ilha Formosa, au kisiwa kizuri.
translations.reference: Taiwan beginning start way back in 15th century where European sailors passing by record the island’s name as Ilha Formosa, or beautiful island.
translations.hypothesis: Taiwan began in the 15th century when English sailors passing by recorded the name of the island as Ilha Formosa, or beautiful island.

translations.source: Mnamo 1624, kampuni ya Dutch East India ilianzisha msingi kusini magharibi mwa Taiwan, kuanzisha mabadiliko katika mazoea ya uzalishaji wa nafaka na kuwaajili wafanyakazi wa Kichina kufanya kazi kwenye mashamba ya mpunga na sukari.
translations.reference: In 1624,Dutch East India Company establishes a base in southwestern Taiwan, initiating a transformation in aboriginal grain production practices and employing Chinese laborers to work on its rice and sugar plantations.
translations.hypothesis: In 1624, the Dutch East India Company established a trading post in southwestern Taiwan, introducing new agricultural practices and importing Chinese labourers to work on sugar and rice plantations.

translations.source: Mnamo 1683, vikosi vya nasaba ya Qing (1644-1912) vilichukua udhibiti wa maeneo ya pwani ya magharibi na kaskazini ya Taiwan na kutangaza Taiwan kama mkoa wa Milki ya Qing mnamo 1885.
translations.reference: In 1683, Qing dynasty (1644-1912) forces take control of Taiwan’s western and northern coastal areas and declared Taiwan as a province of the Qing Empire in 1885.
translations.hypothesis: In 1683, the Qing Dynasty (1644–1912) forces took control of the western and northern parts of Taiwan and officially declared Taiwan as a prefecture of the Qing Empire in 1885.

translations.source: Mnamo 1895, baada ya kushindwa katika vita vya kwanza vya Sino-Japani (1894-1895), serikali ya Qing yatia sahihi mkataba wa Shimonoseki, ambao kwao inadhihirisha uhuru juu ya Taiwan hadi Japani, ambayo inaongoza kisiwa hadi 1945.
translations.reference: In 1895, after defeat in the First Sino-Japanese War (1894-1895), the Qing government signs the Treaty of Shimonoseki, by which it cedes sovereignty over Taiwan to Japan, which rules the island until 1945.
translations.hypothesis: In 1895, after losing the First Sino-Japanese War (1894–1895), the Qing government signed the Treaty of Shimonoseki, which formally ceded Taiwan to Japan, who ruled the island until 1945.

translations.source: Machu Picchu ina mifumo kuu mitatu, kwa majina Intihuatana, Hekalu la Jua, na Chumba chenye Madirisha Matatu.
translations.reference: Machu Picchu consist of three main structures, namely Intihuatana, the Temple of the Sun, and the Room of the Three Windows.
translations.hypothesis: Machu Picchu has three main structures, known as the Intihuatana, the Temple of the Sun, and the Room of the Three Windows.

translations.source: Nyumba nyingi kwenye kingo za majengo hayo tata zilijengwa upya ili kuwapa watalii taswira bora ya jinsi zilivyokuwa mwanzoni.
translations.reference: Most of the buildings on the edges of the complex have been rebuilt in order to give tourists a better idea of how they originally appeared.
translations.hypothesis: Many of the buildings on the edge of the complex have been rebuilt to give tourists a better idea of what it was like when it was first built.

translations.source: Kufikia mwaka wa 1976, asilimia thelathini ya Machu Picchu ilikuwa imerejeshwa na urejesho unaendelea hadi leo.
translations.reference: By 1976, thirty percent of Machu Picchu had been restored and restoration continues till today.
translations.hypothesis: By 1976, thirty percent of Machu Picchu had been restored and the restoration continues to this day.

translations.source: Kwa mfano, umbizo la upigaji picha tuli wa kawaida zaidi duniani ni milimita 35, ambayo ndiyo iliyokuwa saizi kuu ya filamu katika zama za sinema za kikale.
translations.reference: For example, the most common still image photography format in the world is 35mm, which was the dominant film size at the close of the analog film era.
translations.hypothesis: For example, the most common standard for still photography is 35 mm, which was the standard film size in the early days of motion picture film.

translations.source: Bado inatolewa hadi wa leo, lakini kwa umuhimu zaidi uwiano wa kipengele chake umerithiwa na umbizo za kihisio cha picha za kamera za kidijitali.
translations.reference: It is still produced today, but more importantly its aspect ratio has been inherited by digital camera image sensor formats.
translations.hypothesis: It is still offered today, but more importantly the aspect ratio of its sensor is inherited by digital cinema cameras.

translations.source: Muundo wa 35mm kwa kweli, kwa kiasi Fulani unachanganya, 36mm kwa upana na 24mm kwa urefu.
translations.reference: The 35mm format is actually, somewhat confusingly, 36mm in width by 24mm in height.
translations.hypothesis: The 35mm format is, more or less, 36mm wide and 24mm high.

translations.source: Uwiano-vipimo wa muundo huu (kugawa na kumi na mbili ili kupata uwiano rahisi zaidi wa namba kamili) basi husemekana kuwa 3:2.
translations.reference: The aspect ratio of this format (dividing by twelve to obtain the simplest whole-number ratio) is therefore said to be 3:2.
translations.hypothesis: The aspect ratio of this format (dividing by twelve to get the nearest whole number ratio) is then nominally 3:2.

translations.source: Miundo mingi ya kawaida (familia ya APS ya miundoi, kwa mfano) ni sawa na au takribani sawa na uwiano huu.
translations.reference: Many common formats (APS family of formats, for example) are equal to or closely approximate this aspect ratio.
translations.hypothesis: Many common frameworks (the APS family of frameworks, for example) are based on or build on this hierarchy.

translations.source: Sheria ya thuluthi inayotumiwa vibaya na kudhihakiwa mara nyingi ni mwongozo rahisi unaounda uwezo huku ukidumisha kiwango cha mpango katika picha.
translations.reference: The much-abused and often-ridiculed rule of thirds is a simple guideline creating dynamism while keeping a measure of order in an image.
translations.hypothesis: The Pareto principle, often stated as the 80/20 rule, is a useful heuristic that creates a balance between action and planning.

translations.source: Inasema kwamba mahali palipo na athari kubwa kwa mada kuu ni katika mkutano wa mistari inayogawanya picha kwa thuluthi wima na mshazari (tazama mfano).
translations.reference: It states that the most effective place for the main subject is at the intersection of lines dividing the image into thirds vertically and horizontally (see example).
translations.hypothesis: It says the main effect is in the horizontal resolution, where the 3x3 grid (see example) has a higher resolution than the 1x1 grid.

translations.source: Katika kipindi hiki cha historia ya Ulaya, Kanisa Katoliki, ambalo lilikuwa tajiri na lenye nguvu, likawa chini ya uchunguzi.
translations.reference: During this period of European history, the Catholic Church, which had become rich and powerful, came under scrutiny.
translations.hypothesis: During this time in European history, the Catholic Church, which had been rich and powerful, came under scrutiny.

translations.source: kwa zaidi ya miaka elfu moja dini ya Kikristo imefunga majimbo ya Uropa pamoja licha ya kuwa na lugha na mila tofauti. I
translations.reference: For over a thousand years the Christian religion had bound European states together despite differences in language and customs. I
translations.hypothesis: For more than a thousand years, the Christian religion has bound together the nations of Europe, whatever their language or their race may be.

translations.source: Nguvu zake zilizoenea kote ziliathiri wote toka mfalme hadi mtu wa kawaida.
translations.reference: Its all-pervading power affected everyone from king to commoner.
translations.hypothesis: Its effects were felt by all classes of society from the king downwards.

translations.source: Mojawapo ya kanuni kuu za Kikristo ni kwamba mali inafaa kutumika kupunguza mateso na umasikini na kwamba hazina za kifedha za kanisa ziko hapo hususan kwa sababu hiyo.
translations.reference: One of the main Christian tenets is that wealth should be used to alleviate suffering and poverty and that the monetary funds of the church are there specifically for that reason.
translations.hypothesis: One of the core tenets of Christianity is that material wealth is to be used to alleviate suffering and poverty and that the church's financial resources are there precisely for that purpose.

translations.source: Mamlaka kuu ya kanisa yalikuwa katika Roma kwa zaidi ya miaka elfu na uwepo huu wa mamlaka na pesa katika sehemu moja ulipelekea wengi kuuuliza kama itikadi hii ilikuwa ikitekelezwa.
translations.reference: The central authority of the church had been in Rome for over a thousand years and this concentration of power and money led many to question whether this tenet was being met.
translations.hypothesis: The main power of the church was in Rome for over a thousand years and this concentration of power and money in one place led many to wonder if the faith was being put before the almighty dollar.

translations.source: Baada tu ya kuzuka kwa uhasama, Uingereza ilianzisha kizuizi cha kinevi dhidi ya Ujerumani.
translations.reference: Soon after the outbreak of hostilities, Britain initiated a naval blockade of Germany.
translations.hypothesis: Shortly after the outbreak of hostilities, Britain imposed a naval blockade on Germany.

translations.source: Mkakati ulikuwa na ufanisi, kukatisha vifaa muhimu vya kijeshi na kiraia, ingawa kizuizi hiki kilikiuka sheria ya kimataifa ambayo inakubaliwa kwa jumla iliyoratibiwa na mikataba kadhaa ya kimataifa katika karne mbili zilizopita.
translations.reference: The strategy proved effective, cutting off vital military and civilian supplies, although this blockade violated generally accepted international law codified by several international agreements of the past two centuries.
translations.hypothesis: The strategy was effective, disrupting the movement of military and civilian supplies, though the blockade was in violation of international law which has been broadly accepted and codified in a number of international treaties over the last two centuries.

translations.source: Uingereza ilitega mabomu kwenye maji ya kimataifa ili kuzuia meli zozote kuingia sehemu nzima za bahari, hivyo kuweka hatari hata kwa meli zisizoegemea upande wowote.
translations.reference: Britain mined international waters to prevent any ships from entering entire sections of ocean, causing danger to even neutral ships.
translations.hypothesis: Britain blockaded the seas to prevent any ships from entering or leaving Confederate ports, placing even non-belligerent ships at risk.

translations.source: Kwa kuwa kulikuwa na mwitikio mdogo kwa mbinu hii, Ujerumani ilitarajia majibu kama hayo kwa vita vyake ambavyo havijazuiliwa vya chini ya bahari.
translations.reference: Since there was limited response to this tactic, Germany expected a similar response to its unrestricted submarine warfare.
translations.hypothesis: As there was little reaction to this approach, Germany expected similar results from their unrestricted submarine warfare.

translations.source: Katika miaka ya 1920, mtazamo wa raia na mataifa mengi uliotawala ulikuwa wa upatanisho na utengaji.
translations.reference: During the 1920s, the prevailing attitudes of most citizens and nations was that of pacifism and isolation.
translations.hypothesis: In the 1920s, the dominant attitude of many citizens and nations was one of reconciliation and forgiveness.

translations.source: Baada ya kuona mambo ya kuogofya na ukatili wa vita wakati wa Vita vya Kwanza vya Dunia, mataifa yalitamani kuepuka hali kama hiyo tena wakati ujao.
translations.reference: After seeing the horrors and atrocities of war during World War I, nations desired to avoid such a situation again in the future.
translations.hypothesis: After witnessing the horrors and destruction of World War I, nations were eager to avoid such a conflict in the future.

translations.source: Katika mwaka wa 1884, Tesla alihamia Marekani kukubali kazi katika kampuni ya Edison katika Jiji la New York.
translations.reference: In 1884, Tesla moved to the United States of America to accept a job with the Edison Company in New York City.
translations.hypothesis: In 1884, Tesla emigrated to the United States to take up a position at Edison's company in New York City.

translations.source: Aliwasili Marekani na peni 4 tu, kitabu cha mashairi, na barua ya kupendekeza kutoka kwa Charles Batchelor (meneja wake katika ajira yake ya awali) kwa Thomas Edison.
translations.reference: He arrived in the US with 4 cents to his name, a book of poetry, and a letter of recommendation from Charles Batchelor (his manager in his previous job) to Thomas Edison.
translations.hypothesis: He arrived in the United States with only 4 pennies in his pocket, a book of poems, and a letter of introduction from Charles Batchelor (his former employer) to Thomas Edison.

translations.source: Uchina ya kale ilikuwa na njia ya kipekee ya kuonyesha vipindi tofauti vya wakati; kila hatua ya Uchina au kila familia iliyokuwa mamlakani ilikuwa nasaba maalumu.
translations.reference: Ancient China had a unique way of showing different time periods; each stage of China or each family that was in power was a distinctive dynasty.
translations.hypothesis: Ancient China had a unique way of marking different eras; each dynasty or ruling family had its own special name.

translations.source: Pia kati ya kila nasaba kilikuwa kipindi kisicho na msimamo cha majimbo yaliyogawanyika. Maarufu sana kati ya vipindi hivi ilikuwa enzi za Falme Tatu za ya Han na Jin.
translations.reference: Also between each dynasty was an unstable age of divided provinces. The best-known of these periods was the Three Kingdoms epoch taking place for 60 years between the Han and the Jin Dynasty.
translations.hypothesis: Also between each dynasty there was a period of disunity. The most famous of these periods was the Three Kingdoms period of the late Han Dynasty and the Jin Dynasty.

translations.source: Wakati wa vipindi hivi vita vikali vilifanyika kati ya waangwana wakipigania kiti cha enzi.
translations.reference: During these periods fierce warfare took place between many nobles fighting for the throne.
translations.hypothesis: During these times there were conflicts between the settlers over the land.

translations.source: Falme Tatu ilikuwa enzi yenye umwagaji damu zaidi katika historia ya China ya Kale, maelfu ya watu walikufa wakipigania kuketi kwenye kiti cha juu zaidi katika ikulu ya Xi'an.
translations.reference: The Three Kingdoms was one of the bloodiest eras in Ancient China’s history thousands of people died fighting to sit in the highest seat in the grand palace at Xi’an.
translations.hypothesis: The Three Kingdoms was a very bloody era in Chinese history, with thousands dying in pursuit of the ultimate seat in the imperial palace in Xi'an.

translations.source: Kuna athari nyingi za kijamii na kisiasa kama vile utumiaji wa mfumo wa metriki, mabadiliko kutoka kwa msimamo wa udikteta hadi ujamhuri, utaifa na imani kuwa inchi ni ya watu si ya mtawala mmoja pekee.
translations.reference: There are a lot of social and political effects such as the use of metric system, a shift from absolutism to republicanism, nationalism and the belief the country belongs to the people not to one sole ruler.
translations.hypothesis: There are many social and political implications, such as the use of the metric system, the shift from the divine right of kings to democracy, nationalism, and the belief that the nation is the people, not the property of a single ruler.

translations.source: Pia baada ya Mapinduzi kazi ilikuwa wazi kwa waombaji wote wa kiume, hivyo kuruhusu waliojitakia makuu na wenye mafanikio kufaulu.
translations.reference: Also after the Revolution occupations were open to all male applicants allowing the most ambitious and successful to succeed.
translations.hypothesis: Also after the Revolution, the job was open to all male applicants, allowing the most ambitious and talented to flourish.

translations.source: Vilevile kwa wanajeshi kwa sababu badala ya madaraka ya kijeshi kutegemea darasa sasa yanategemea sifa.
translations.reference: Same goes for the military because instead of army rankings being based on class they were now based on cailaber.
translations.hypothesis: The same goes for military ranks, as opposed to military ranks based on class, they are now based on merit.

translations.source: Mapinduzi ya Kifaransa pia yalichochea wafanyakazi wengine wengi wa nchi nyingine waliokandamizwa kuanza mapinduzi yao wenyewe.
translations.reference: The French Revolution also inspired many other repressed working class people of other country's to began their own revolutions.
translations.hypothesis: The French Revolution also inspired many other oppressed workers in other countries to start their own revolutions.

translations.source: Muhammad alivutiwa sana na mambo zaidi ya maisha haya ya kawaida. Alikuwa akitembelea sana pango ambalo lilikuja kujulikana kama "Hira" katika mlima wa "Noor" (nuru) kwa kutafakari.
translations.reference: Muhammad was deeply interested in matters beyond this mundane life. He used to frequent a cave that became known as “Hira‘” on the Mountain of “Noor” (light) for contemplation.
translations.hypothesis: Muhammad would often retreat to a cave on Mount Hira to meditate.

translations.source: Pango lenyewe, ambalo lilinusurika nyakati, hutoa picha dhahiri ya mielekeo ya kiroho ya Muhammad.
translations.reference: he cave itself, which survived the times, gives a very vivid image of Muhammad’s spiritual inclinations.
translations.hypothesis: The cave itself, which has witnessed history, offers a glimpse into the Prophet Muhammad's spiritual focus.

translations.source: Likiwa juu ya mojawapo ya milima kaskazini mwa Mecca, pango hilo limetengwa kabisa na ulimwengu.
translations.reference: Resting on the top of one of the mountains north of Mecca, the cave is completely isolated from the rest of the world.
translations.hypothesis: Perched atop one of the hills north of Mecca, the cave is quite isolated from the rest of the world.

translations.source: Kwa kweli, si rahisi kupata kamwe hata kama mtu alijua ipo. Ukishaingia kwenye pango, umetengwa kabisa.
translations.reference: In fact, it is not easy to find at all even if one knew it existed. Once inside the cave, it is a total isolation.
translations.hypothesis: In fact, it is so hidden that it is almost impossible to find even if you know it is there. Once you are in the cave, you are completely cut off from the outside world.

translations.source: Hakuna kingine kinachoweza kuonekana ila anga safi na nzuri huko juu na milima mingi inayolizunguka. Ni machache sana ya dunia hii yanayoweza kuonwa au kusikiwa ndani ya pango hili.
translations.reference: Nothing can be seen other than the clear, beautiful sky above and the many surrounding mountains. Very little of this world can be seen or heard from inside the cave.
translations.hypothesis: There is nothing to see but a clear sky above and the rock walls around you. Very little of the outside world can be seen or heard from inside the cave.

translations.source: Piramidi kuu katika Giza ndiyo ya pekee ya maajabu saba ambayo bado inasimama leo.
translations.reference: The Great Pyramid at Giza is the only one of the seven wonders that is still standing today.
translations.hypothesis: The only one of the original Seven Wonders of the Ancient World still standing today is the Great Pyramid of Giza.

translations.source: Piramidi Kuu iliyojengwa na Wamisri katika karne ya tatu BCE ni mojawapo ya majengo makubwa yaliyojengwa kwa heshima ya Firauni waliofariki.
translations.reference: Built by the Egyptians in the third century BCE, the Great Pyramid is one of many large pyramid structures built to honor dead Pharaoh.
translations.hypothesis: The Great Pyramid was built by the ancient Egyptians in the 23rd century BCE and is one of the largest structures ever built in honor of a deceased pharaoh.

translations.source: Kilima cha Giza, au "Giza Necropolis" katika Bonde la Wafu la Misri kina piramidi kadhaa (ambazo piramidi kuu ni kubwa zaidi), makaburi kadhaa madogo, hekalu kadhaa, na Sphinx kuu.
translations.reference: The Giza Plateau, or "Giza Necropolis" in the Egyptian Valley of the Dead contains several pyramids (of which the great pyramid is the largest), several small tombs, several temples, and the great Sphinx.
translations.hypothesis: The Giza Plateau, or "Giza Necropolis" in Egypt's Valley of the Kings contains several pyramids (the largest of which is the Great Pyramid), several smaller tombs, a few ruined temples, and the Great Sphinx.

translations.source: Piramidi kuu iliundwa ili kumheshimu Firauni Khufu, na piramidi, makaburi na mahekalu mengine mengi madogo yalijengwa ili kuheshimu wake na wanafamilia wa Khufu.
translations.reference: The great pyramid was created to honor the Pharaoh Khufu, and many of the smaller pyramids, tombs, and temples were built to honor Khufu's wives and family members.
translations.hypothesis: The Great Pyramid was built to honor the pharaoh Khufu, and several smaller pyramids, tombs and temples were built to honor Khufu's family.

translations.source: Alama ya "gubeti la juu" inaonekana kama V na "alama ya gubeti la chini" kama kibanio au mraba unaokosa upande wake wa chini.
translations.reference: The "up bow" mark looks like a V and the "down bow mark" like a staple or a square missing its bottom side.
translations.hypothesis: The "up-arrow" symbol is seen as a V and the "down-arrow" as an inverted V or an open bottomed square.

translations.source: Juu inamaanisha unapaswa kuanzia nchani na kusukuma uta, na chini inamaanisha unafaa kuanzia kwenye frog (mahali ambapo mkono wako unashikilia uta) na kuvuta uta.
translations.reference: Up means you should start at the tip and push the bow, and down means you should start at the frog (which is where your hand is holding the bow) and pull the bow.
translations.hypothesis: Topspin means you need to start the racket from below and swing up, whereas a backspin is the opposite, starting the racket from above and swinging down.

translations.source: Upinde wa juu kwa kawaida huzalisha sauti tulivu, huku upinde wa chini ukiwa na nguvu na ni imara zaidi.
translations.reference: An up-bow usually generates a softer sound, while a down-bow is stronger and more assertive.
translations.hypothesis: The higher registers tend to be breathier and weaker, while the lower registers are stronger and more powerful.

translations.source: Jisikie huru kuandika kwa penseli alama zako, lakini kumbuka alama za kuinama zilizochapwa ziko kwa sababu ya kimziki, kwa hivyo yafaa ziheshimiwe.
translations.reference: Feel free to pencil in your own marks, but remember the printed bowing marks are there for a musical reason, so they should usually be respected.
translations.hypothesis: Feel free to mark your score with a pencil, but keep in mind that the printed rests are there for musical reasons, so they should be respected.

translations.source: Mfalme Louis XVI, Malkia Marie Antoinette, watoto wao wawili wadogo (Marie Therese mwenye umri wa miaka 11 na Louis Charles mwenye umri wa miaka minne) na dada ya mfalme Bibi Elizabeth waliojawa na hofu, mnamo Oktoba 6 1789 walilazimishwa kurudi Paris kutoka Versailles na umati wa wanawake wa sokoni.
translations.reference: The terrified King Louis XVI, Queen Marie Antoinette their two young children (11 year old Marie Therese and four year old Louis-Charles) and the King's sister, Madam Elizabeth, on the 6th October 1789 were forced back to Paris from Versailles by a mob of market women.
translations.hypothesis: King Louis XVI, Queen Marie Antoinette, their two young children (11-year-old Marie Therese and four-year-old Louis Charles) and the King's sister-in-law, the Princess de Lamballe, were forced to return to Paris from Versailles on October 6, 1789, by a mob of market women.

translations.source: Katika gari la kukokotwa, walisafiri kuelekea Paris wakiwa wamezungukwa na umati wa watu waliopiga nduru na kutoa vitisho kwa Mfalme na Malkia kwa sauti kubwa.
translations.reference: In a carriage, they traveled back to Paris surrounded by a mob of people screaming and shouting threats against the King and Queen.
translations.hypothesis: In the carriage, they headed towards Paris surrounded by a large crowd who shouted and hurled insults at the King and Queen.

translations.source: Umati wa watu uliwalazimisha Mfalme Na Malkia kufungua madirisha ya gari lao.
translations.reference: The mob of people forced the King And Queen to have their carriage windows wide open.
translations.hypothesis: The large crowd forced the King and Queen to open the windows of their car.

translations.source: Kwa wakati mmoja memba wa umati alipunga kichwa cha mlinzi mmoja wa kifalme aliyeuawa katika Versailles mbele ya Malkia aliyejawa na hofu.
translations.reference: At one point a member of the mob waved the head of a royal guard killed at Versailles in front of the terrified Queen.
translations.hypothesis: At one point a member of the mob held a severed head of one of the King's Guards up before the Queen in mock triumph.

translations.source: Matumizi ya kivita kwa ubeberu wa Marekani katika ushindi dhidi ya Ufilipino yaligharimiwa na watu wa Ufilipino wenyewe.
translations.reference: The war expenditures of U.S. imperialism in the conquest of the Philippines were paid for by the Filipino people themselves.
translations.hypothesis: The expense of the American war for the Philippines was paid for by the Filipino people.

translations.source: Walilazimishwa kulipa kodi kwa serikali ya wakoloni ya Amerika ili kugharamia sehemu kubwa ya matumizi na riba juu ya dhamana zilizowekwa kwa jina la serikali ya Ufilipino kupitia nyumba za benki za Wall Street.
translations.reference: They were compelled to pay taxes to the U.S. colonial regime to defray a major part of the expenditures and the interest on bonds floated in the name of the Philippine government through the Wall Street banking houses.
translations.hypothesis: They were forced to pay taxes to the American colonial government to fund a large portion of the expenses and interest on the debt guaranteed by the Philippine government through Wall Street banks.

translations.source: Bila shaka, faida kubwa kutokana na dhuluma za muda mrefu za watu wa Ufilipino ziliunda mapato ya msingi ya ubeberu wa Marekani.
translations.reference: Of course, the superprofits derived from the protracted exploitation of the Filipino people would constitute the basic gains of U.S. imperialism.
translations.hypothesis: Of course, the great benefit from the long oppression of the Filipino people accrued to American imperialism.

translations.source: Ili kuelewa templar ni lazima mtu aelewe muktadha ambao ulisababisha uundaji wa agizo.
translations.reference: To understand the Templars one must understand the context that prompted the creation of the order.
translations.hypothesis: To understand Templarism one must understand the context in which the order was founded.

translations.source: Kipindi ambacho matukio yalitokea kwa kawaida hujulikana kama Enzi za Juu za kati, kipindi katika historia ya Ulaya katika Karne za 11, 12, na 13 (1000-1300 Baada ya Kristo).
translations.reference: The age where the events took place is commonly referred as the High Middle Ages the period of European history in the 11th, 12th, and 13th centuries (AD 1000–1300).
translations.hypothesis: The period during which these events took place is commonly referred to as the High Middle Ages, a period in European history from the 11th to the 13th centuries (1000–1300 AD).

translations.source: Enzi za Juu za Kati zilitanguliwa na Enzi za Mapema za Kati na kufuatiwa na Enzi za Mwisho za Kati, ambazo kwa mapatano zinaishia karibu 1500.
translations.reference: The High Middle Ages were preceded by the Early Middle Ages and followed by the Late Middle Ages, which by convention ends around 1500.
translations.hypothesis: The High Middle Ages were preceded by the Early Middle Ages and followed by the Late Middle Ages, which conventionally end around 1500.

translations.source: Uainishaji wa kiufundi ni kishazi ambacho hujumuisha maoni anuai katika mazoezi, kutoka teknolojia shinikizi, au maendeleo ya kiteknolojia katika dhana kuwa hatma ya binadamu huendeshwa na mantiki ya msingi inayohusishwa na sheria za kisayansi na udhihirisho wake katika teknolojia.
translations.reference: Technological determinism is a term that encompasses a wide range of ideas in practice, from technology-push or the technological imperative to a strict sense that human destiny is driven by an underlying logic associated with scientific laws and their manifestation in technology.
translations.hypothesis: Technological determinism is a theory that holds that a society's technology is the primary driver of social change, or that technology is a socially neutral force whose development is determined by laws of science and whose impact on human life is a logical consequence of its material properties.

translations.source: Tafsiri nyingi za udhibitisho wa kiteknolojia zinashirikisha maoni mawili ya jumla: kwamba maendeleo ya teknolojia yenyewe hufuata njia zaidi ya ushawishi wa kitamaduni au kisiasa, na teknolojia hiyo kwa upande ina "athari" kwa jamii ambazo ni za asili, badala ya hali ya kijamii.
translations.reference: Most interpretations of technological determinism share two general ideas: that the development of technology itself follows a path largely beyond cultural or political influence, and that technology in turn has "effects" on societies that are inherent, rather than socially conditioned.
translations.hypothesis: Many definitions of technological determinism share two general ideas: that technological development follows its own momentum, independent of cultural or political influence, and that technology has an inherent “impact” on societies, regardless of social conditions.

translations.source: Kwa mfano, mtu anaweza kusema kwamba motokaa hupelekea ukuzaji wa barabara.
translations.reference: For example, one might say that the motor car necessarily leads to the development of roads.
translations.hypothesis: For example, one could say that the wheel led to the development of roads.

translations.source: Hata hivyo, mfumo wa kitaifa wa barabara hufai kiuchumi kwa magari machache tu, kwa hivyo mbinu mpya za uzalishaji zinakuzwa ili kupunguza gharama ya umiliki wa magari.
translations.reference: However, a nationwide road network is not economically viable for just a handful of cars, so new methods of production are developed to reduce the cost of car ownership.
translations.hypothesis: However, a national highway system is only economically viable for a few very busy routes, so alternative transport solutions are needed to reduce the cost of vehicle ownership.

translations.source: Umiliki wa magari kwa wingi pia hupelekea matukio mengi ya ajali za barabarani, ambazo hupelekea uvumbuzi wa mbinu mpya katika matibabu za kutengeneza miili iliyovunjika.
translations.reference: Mass car ownership also leads to a higher incidence of accidents on the roads, which leads to the invention of new techniques in healthcare for repairing damaged bodies.
translations.hypothesis: The increasing motorization has also led to a surge in traffic accidents, which in turn has led to new developments in the field of reconstructive surgery.

translations.source: Uroma ulikuwa na kipengele kikubwa cha maamuzi ya kitamaduni yaliyochochewa na waandishi kama vile Goethe, Fichte na Schlegel.
translations.reference: Romanticism had a large element of cultural determinism, drawn from writers such as Goethe, Fichte, and Schlegel.
translations.hypothesis: Romanticism was a major cultural movement that was influenced by writers such as Goethe, Fichte and Schlegel.

translations.source: Katika muktadha wa Uroma, jiografia ilifinyanga watu, na kwa mpito wa wakati mila na tamaduni zilizohusiana na jiografia zilizuka, na hizi, zikiwa zinapatana na hali ya jamii, zilikuwa bora kuliko sheria zilizolazimishwa kiholela.
translations.reference: In the context of Romanticism, the geography molded individuals, and over time customs and culture related to that geography arose, and these, being in harmony with the place of the society, were better than arbitrarily imposed laws.
translations.hypothesis: In the context of Rome, the geography influenced the people, and with the passing of time, the culture and the traditions associated with the land, and these, in turn, influenced the laws of the land.

translations.source: Jinsi Paris inavyojulikana kama mji mkuu wa mitindo wa ulimwengu wa kisasa, Konstantinople ilichukuliwa kuwa mji mkuu wa mitindo wa Uropa ya kikabaila.
translations.reference: In the manner that Paris is known as the fashion capital of the contemporary world, Constantinople was regarded as the fashion capital of feudal Europe.
translations.hypothesis: Just as Paris is known as the fashion capital of the modern world, Constantinople was considered the trendsetting capital of the medieval world.

translations.source: Inajulikana kwa kuwa kitovu cha anasa ilianza takribani 400 A.D. na ilidumu hadi karibu 1100 A.D.
translations.reference: Its renown for being an epicenter of luxury began in about 400 A.D. and lasted up until about 1100 A.D.
translations.hypothesis: Known to be the center of a great empire that began around 400 A.D. and lasted until about 1100 A.D.

translations.source: Hali yake ilizorota wakati wa karne ya kumi na mbili hasa kwa sababu ya ukweli kwamba Wapambanaji wa kidini walikuwa wamerejea na zawadi kama vile hariri na viungo vilivyokuwa na thamani ya juu kuliko vile vilivyotolewa na masoko ya Bizanti.
translations.reference: Its status declined during the twelfth century mainly due to the fact that Crusaders had returned bearing gifts such as silks and spices that were valued more than what Byzantine markets offered.
translations.hypothesis: Its condition worsened during the 12th century mainly because the Crusaders had returned with goods such as spices and silks that were of a higher quality than those provided by the Byzantine markets.

translations.source: Ilikuwa wakati huu ambapo uhamisho wa Jiji la Mtindo kutoka Konstantinopo hadi Parisi ulifanyika.
translations.reference: It was at this time that the transfer of the title of Fashion Capital from Constantinople to Paris was made.
translations.hypothesis: It was during this time that the transfer of the relics of Saint Denis from the city of Paris to the city of Saint-Denis took place.

translations.source: Staili ya Kigothi ilifikia kilele katika kipindi kati ya karne za 10-11 na karne ya 14.
translations.reference: Gothic style peaked in the period between the 10th - 11th centuries and the 14th century.
translations.hypothesis: Gothic style reached its peak in the 10-13th centuries.

translations.source: Hapo mwanzoni mavazi yaliathiriwa na tamaduni za Baizantini kutoka mashariki.
translations.reference: At the beginning dress was heavily influenced by the Byzantine culture in the east.
translations.hypothesis: Initially, the clothing was influenced by the Byzantine culture from the East.

translations.source: Hata hivyo, kwa sababu ya njia hafifu za mawasiliano, mitindo ya magharibi ilibakia nyuma kwa miaka 25 hadi 30.
translations.reference: However, due to the slow communication channels, styles in the west could lag behind by 25 to 30 year.
translations.hypothesis: However, due to the slower pace of communication, Western trends were always 25 to 30 years behind.

translations.source: Kuelekea mwishoni mwa Zama za Kati Uropa magharibi ilianza kuendeleza staili yao wenyewe. Mojawapo ya maendeleo makubwa zaidi ya wakati huo kama matokeo ya krusedi watu walianza kutumia vifungo kukazia nguo.
translations.reference: towards the end of the Middle Ages western Europe began to develop their own style. one of the biggest developments of the time as a result of the crusades people began to use buttons to fasten clothing.
translations.hypothesis: Towards the end of the Middle Ages the Western world began to develop its own styles. One of the most significant developments of the time as a result of the crusades was the introduction of buttons.

translations.source: Kilimo cha kujikimu ni kilimo ambacho hufanywa kwa uzalishaji wa chakula cha kutosha tu kukimu mahitaji ya mkulima na familia yake.
translations.reference: Subsistence agriculture is agriculture carried out for the production of enough food to meet just the needs of the agriculturalist and his/her family.
translations.hypothesis: Subsistence farming is when crops are grown only to provide enough food for the farmer's family and their own consumption.

translations.source: Kilimo cha kujikimu ni mfumo rahisi, aghalabu wa kikaboni, unaotumia mbegu zilizohifadhiwa na asilia kwa eneo husika, pamoja na mzunguko wa mimea au mbinu mbadala zilizo rahisi ili kuboresha mavuno.
translations.reference: Subsistence agriculture is a simple, often organic, system using saved seed native to the ecoregion combined with crop rotation or other relatively simple techniques to maximize yield.
translations.hypothesis: Permaculture is a simple, often organic, system that uses heirloom or locally adapted seeds and plants, and easy-to-maintain plant structures or techniques to improve production.

translations.source: Kihistoria, wakulima wengi walijihusisha na kilimo cha kujikimu na hii bado ndiyo hali katika mataifa mengi yanayoendelea.
translations.reference: Historically most farmers were engaged in subsistence agriculture and this is still the case in many developing nations.
translations.hypothesis: Historically, most farmers engaged in subsistence farming and this is still the case in many developing countries.

translations.source: Utamaduni mdogo huwaleta pamoja watu walio wa mafikira sawa na ambao wanahisi kuwa wametengwa na viwango vya kijamii na kuwaruhusu kuendeleza hisia za utambulisho.
translations.reference: Subcultures bring together like-minded individuals who feel neglected by societal standards and allow them to develop a sense of identity.
translations.hypothesis: Subcultures unite people with similar interests and those who feel alienated from mainstream society, allowing them to explore and develop their identity.

translations.source: Vikundi vidogo vya tamaduni vinaweza kuwa vya kipekee kwa sababu ya umri, kabila, daraja, eneo, na/au jinsia ya washiriki.
translations.reference: Subcultures can be distinctive because of the age, ethnicity, class, location, and/or gender of the members.
translations.hypothesis: Subcultures can be defined by age, race, ethnicity, class, region, gender, or any combination of these.

translations.source: Sifa zinazofanya utamaduni mdogo kuwa wa kipekee huenda zikawa za kilugha, kiurembo, kidini, kisiasa, kijiografia au mchanganyiko wa vipengele.
translations.reference: The qualities that determine a subculture as distinct may be linguistic, aesthetic, religious, political, sexual, geographical, or a combination of factors.
translations.hypothesis: The characteristics that make a culture unique may be linguistic, artistic, religious, political, geographic or a combination of these factors.

translations.source: Wanachama wa utamaduni mdogo mdogo kwa mara nyingi huashiria uanachama wao kupitia mitindo ya kipekee ambayo ni pamoja na mitindo ya kimavazi, tabia na lugha.
translations.reference: Members of a subculture often signal their membership through a distinctive and symbolic use of style, which includes fashions, mannerisms, and argot.
translations.hypothesis: Members of a subculture often signal their membership through distinctive patterns of behaviour, including distinctive styles of dress, speech, and body language.

translations.source: Mojawapo ya mbinu maarufu zinatozumiwa kuonyesha umuhimu wa kushirikiana ni kutumia mifano michache sikitishi ya watoto ambao, kupitia mapuuza, mikosi, kunyanyaswa kimakusudi, hawakushirikishwa na watu wazima walipokuwa wanapokua.
translations.reference: One of the most common methods used to illustrate the importance of socialization is to draw upon the few unfortunate cases of children who were, through neglect, misfortune, or wilful abuse, not socialized by adults while they were growing up.
translations.hypothesis: One of the most common approaches used to demonstrate the importance of engagement involves citing examples of children who, through neglect, abuse, and other adverse childhood experiences, were denied the support of adults during their formative years.

translations.source: Watoto kama hao huitwa "katili" au jeuri. Watoto wengine katili wamefungwa na watu (kwa kawaida wazazi wao wenyewe); katika hali nyingine huu kuachwa kwa watoto kulitokana na wazazi kukataa upungufu mkubwa wa kiakili au mwili kwa mtoto.
translations.reference: Such children are called "feral" or wild. Some feral children have been confined by people (usually their own parents); in some cases this child abandonment was due to the parents' rejection of a child's severe intellectual or physical impairment.
translations.hypothesis: Such children are referred to as “feral children” or “wild children”. Some feral children have been taken in by people (usually relatives); in other cases these abandoned children are raised by people who compensate for the lack of physical or mental capabilities of the child.

translations.source: Huenda watoto wasiotagusana walipitia unyanyasaji mkuu au kiwewe utotoni mwao kabla ya kuachiliwa au kutoroka.
translations.reference: Feral children may have experienced severe child abuse or trauma before being abandoned or running away.
translations.hypothesis: Some of the children had reportedly undergone torture or other grave abuses prior to their release or evacuation.

translations.source: Wengine wanadaiwa kulewa na wanyama; wengine wanasemekana kuishi porini kivyao.
translations.reference: Others are alleged to have been brought up by animals; some are said to have lived in the wild on their own.
translations.hypothesis: Some are said to be drunkards and gluttons; others are said to live in the wilds like beasts.
