translations.source: Anapolelewa kabisa na wanyama wasio wa kibinadamu, mtoto katili huonyesha tabia (ndani ya mipaka ya kimwili) karibu kabisa kama zile za mnyama mahsusi wa utunzaji, kama vile hofu au upurukushani wake kwa wanadamu.
translations.reference: When completely brought up by non-human animals, the feral child exhibits behaviors (within physical limits) almost entirely like those of the particular care-animal, such as its fear of or indifference to humans.
translations.hypothesis: When raised by non-human animals, a feral child will exhibit (within the limitations of their physical development) behaviours much like those of the particular animal they were raised by, such as a fear or curiosity towards humans.

translations.source: Wakati elimu ya msingi wa mradi kunapaswa kufanya elimu kuwa rahisi na ya kupendeza zaidi, udungu huenda hatua zaidi.
translations.reference: While project based learning should make learning easier and more interesting, scaffolding goes a step beyond.
translations.hypothesis: While the gamified nature of the project should make learning more fun and engaging, the token has more utility.

translations.source: Mbinu za mafunzo si njia ya kusoma lakini huduma ambayo hutoa usaidizi kwa watu ambao wanapitia hali mpya ya masomo kama vile kutumia programu mpya ya kompyuta au kuanza mradi mpya.
translations.reference: Scaffolding is not a method of learning but rather an aid that provides support to individuals whom are undergoing a new learning experience such as using a new computer program or beginning a new project.
translations.hypothesis: Learning methods are not just about the way we study but also the support we have while going through the learning process such as using a new software or starting a new project.

translations.source: Majukwaa yanaweza kuwa dhahiri na pia halisi, kwa maneno mengine, mwalimu ni aina ya jukwaa lakini pia ndivyo kilivyo kile kijitu cha karatasi katika Microsoft Office.
translations.reference: Scaffolds can be both virtual and real, in other words, a teacher is a form of scaffold but so is the little paperclip man in Microsoft Office.
translations.hypothesis: The platform can be physical and also virtual, in other words, a teacher is a platform but so is a spreadsheet in Microsoft Office.

translations.source: Majukwaa Pepe yamewekwa ndani ya programu kwa kusudi la kuhoji, kushawishi, na kuelezea taratibu ambazo huenda zilikuwa changamoto kubwa kwa mwanafunzi kushughulikia peke yake.
translations.reference: Virtual Scaffolds are internalized in the software and are meant to question, prompt, and explain procedures that may have been to challenging for the student to handle alone.
translations.hypothesis: The Pepe platform is designed to challenge, inspire, and guide students through processes that may otherwise be difficult for them to handle on their own.

translations.source: Watoto huwekwa kwenye Huduma ya Malezi kwa sababu nyingine nyingi ambazo huanzia kutelekezwa hadi kudhulumiwa na hata unyang’anyi.
translations.reference: Children are placed in Foster Care for a wide variety of reasons that range from neglect, to abuse, and even to extortion.
translations.hypothesis: Children are placed in foster care for many reasons including abandonment, abuse, and even theft.

translations.source: Hakuna mtoto anayepaswa kukua katika mazingira ambayo hayaelimishi, huyajali, hayafundishi, lakini wanafanya hivyo.
translations.reference: No child should ever have to grow up in an environment that is not nurturing, caring, and educational, but they do.
translations.hypothesis: No child should have to grow up in an environment that is devoid of education, of care, of nurture, but they do.

translations.source: Tunadhania Mfumo wa Huduma ya Kulea kuwa eneo la usalama kwa watoto hawa.
translations.reference: We perceive the Foster Care System to be a safety zone for these children.
translations.hypothesis: We believe the Foster Care System is the safest place for these children.

translations.source: Makazi ya watoto yanastahili kutoa makao salama, walezi wenye upendo, elimu imara, na mfumo wa afya unaoaminika.
translations.reference: Our foster care system is supposed to provide safe homes, loving caregivers, stable education, and reliable health care.
translations.hypothesis: A child’s home should provide safe shelter, a loving environment, opportunities for play, and a stable foundation for health and education.

translations.source: Makazi ya watoto yanastahili kutoa mahitaji haya yote ambayo yalikosekana nyumbani walikotolewa awali.
translations.reference: Foster care is supposed to provide all the necessities that were lacking in the home they were previously taken from.
translations.hypothesis: Children’s homes should aim to provide all the stimulation and support that is missing from their previous deprived home environment.

translations.source: Mtandao unachanganya vitu vya mawasiliano ya kundi la watu na ya kati ya mtu na mtu.
translations.reference: The Internet combines elements of both mass and interpersonal communication.
translations.hypothesis: The network combines group and one-on-one communication features.

translations.source: Tabia za kipekee za mtandao hupelekea vipimo zaidi kuhusu matumizi na mbinu za kuridhisha.
translations.reference: The distinct characteristics of the Internet lead to additional dimensions in terms of the uses and gratifications approach.
translations.hypothesis: The unique nature of online gambling leads to questions about its regulation and the legalization of betting.

translations.source: Kwa mfano, "kujifunza" na "ushirikiano" kunapendekezwa kama vichochezi muhimu kwa matumizi ya mtandao (James na wengine, 1995).
translations.reference: For example, “learning” and “socialization” are suggested as important motivations for Internet use (James et al., 1995).
translations.hypothesis: For example, “learning” and “networking” are cited as key motivations for attending conferences (James et al., 1995).

translations.source: Kushiriki kwa kibinafsi na "mahusiano endelezi" pia yalitambuliwa na Eighmey na McCord (1998) kama vipengele vipya vya motisha walipichunguza mjibizo wa hadhira katika tovuti.
translations.reference: “Personal involvement” and “continuing relationships” were also identified as new motivation aspects by Eighmey and McCord (1998) when they investigated audience reactions to websites.
translations.hypothesis: Personal involvement and "ongoing relationships" were also identified by Eighmey & McCord (1998) as key new elements of motivation when they studied audience response to websites.

translations.source: Matumizi ya video za kurekodi imesababisha uvumbuzi muhimu katika tafsiri ya sauti ndogo, kusongeshwa kwa uso ambao hudumu sekunde ndogo kadhaa.
translations.reference: The use of video recording has led to important discoveries in the interpretation of micro-expressions, facial movements which last a few milliseconds.
translations.hypothesis: The use of video recording has led to a breakthrough in the animation of lip-synchronized talking faces lasting only a few seconds.

translations.source: Hususan, inadaiwa kuwa mtu anaweza kutambua ikiwa mtu anadanganya kwa kufasiri ishara ndogondogo kwa njia sahihi.
translations.reference: In particular, it is claimed that one can detect whether a person is lying by interpreting micro-expressions correctly.
translations.hypothesis: In particular, it is argued that humans are able to tell when someone is lying by correctly interpreting micro-expressions.

translations.source: Oliver Sacks, katika gazeti lake Hotuba ya Rais, alionyesha namna watu ambao hawawezi kuelewa hotuba kutokana na uharibifu wa ubongo hata hivyo wana uwezo kwa kutathmini ukweli kwa usahihi.
translations.reference: Oliver Sacks, in his paper The President's Speech, indicated how people who are unable to understand speech because of brain damage are nevertheless able to assess sincerity accurately.
translations.hypothesis: Oliver Sacks, in his presidential address, showed how people who have lost the ability to understand speech through brain damage can still be able to detect the rhythm and intonation of speech.

translations.source: Hata anapendekeza kwamba uwezo kama huo wa kufasiri tabia za binadamu unaweza kushirikishwa wanyama kama vile mbwa wa kufugwa.
translations.reference: He even suggests that such abilities in interpreting human behavior may be shared by animals such as domestic dogs.
translations.hypothesis: He even speculates that such human-interpreting ability could be imparted to other animals like domesticated dogs.

translations.source: Utafiti wa karne ya ishirini umeonyesha kwamba kuna makundi mawili ya utofauti wa jeni: fiche na zilizoelezewa.
translations.reference: Twentieth century research has shown that there are two pools of genetic variation: hidden and expressed.
translations.hypothesis: Research in the 20th century showed that there are two types of genetic variation: discrete and continuous.

translations.source: Mabadiliko huongeza tofauti za kimaumbile, na uchaguzi huyaondoa katika mkusanyiko wa tofauti zilizoonyeshwa.
translations.reference: Mutation adds new genetic variation, and selection removes it from the pool of expressed variation.
translations.hypothesis: Mutations increase genetic variation, and selection acts on this variation.

translations.source: Mabadiliko ya uchangaji ya utengaji na uchanganyaji tena huku na huko kati ya vidimbwi hivyo viwili kwa kila kizazi.
translations.reference: Segregation and recombination shuffle variation back and forth between the two pools with each generation.
translations.hypothesis: The cumulative effect of these small changes over many generations can result in large differences between the two populations.

translations.source: Nje kwenye savana, ni vigumu kwa wanyama wakuu waliyo na mfumo wa kuyeyusha chakula tumboni kama wa binadamu kutoshelezeza mahitaji ya tindikali-za-amino zao kutoka kwa vifaa vya mimea vilivyomo
translations.reference: Out on the savanna, it is hard for a primate with a digestive system like that of humans to satisfy its amino-acid requirements from available plant resources.
translations.hypothesis: Out on the savanna, it is difficult for large herbivores that rely on digesting plant matter to get all the amino acids they need from the available vegetation.

translations.source: Waaidha, kukosa kufanya hivyo kuna matokeo mazito: udidimiaji wa ukuaji, utapiamlo, na hatimaye kifo.
translations.reference: Moreover, failure to do so has serious consequences: growth depression, malnutrition, and ultimately death.
translations.hypothesis: Failure to do so can have devastating consequences: growth stunting, malnutrition, and ultimately death.

translations.source: Rasilimali za mimea zinazofikiwa kwa urahisi zingekuwa protini zinazopatikana katika majani na kunde, lakini hizi ni ngumu kwa wale wa kundi la mammalia wa hali ya juu kama sisi kusaga isipokuwa kama zimepikwa.
translations.reference: The most readily accessible plant resources would have been the proteins accessible in leaves and legumes, but these are hard for primates like us to digest unless they are cooked.
translations.hypothesis: The most easily obtained plant foods are carbohydrates in the form of starch and sugars, but these are difficult for most mammals, including humans, to digest unless they are cooked.

translations.source: Kwa kulinganisha, vyakula vya wanyama (siafu, mchwa, mayai) si kwamba vinameng’enywa kwa urahisi tu, lakini pia hutoa protini zenye kiwango kikubwa ambazo zina asidi muhimu za amino.
translations.reference: In contrast, animal foods (ants, termites, eggs) not only are easily digestible, but they provide high-quantity proteins that contain all the essential amino acids.
translations.hypothesis: In comparison, animal products (meat, fish, eggs) are more easily digested, but also provide larger amounts of high-quality protein and essential amino acids.

translations.source: Mambo yote yakizingatiwa, hatupaswi kushangaa kama wahenga wetu walitatua “shida yao ya protini” kwa njia sawa na zile nyani wa savanna hufanya leo.
translations.reference: All things considered, we should not be surprised if our own ancestors solved their "protein problem" in somewhat the same way that chimps on the savanna do today.
translations.hypothesis: Given all the above, we should not be surprised if our ancestors solved their "protein problem" in much the same way as the savanna baboons do today.

translations.source: Ukatizaji wa usingizi ni mchakato wa kuamka kimakusudi wakati wa usingizi wako wa kawaida na kupatwa na usingizi muda mfupi baadaye (dakika 10-60).
translations.reference: Sleep interruption is the process of purposefully awakening during your normal sleep period and falling asleep a short time later (10–60 minutes).
translations.hypothesis: Sleep paralysis is the temporary inability to move or speak that occurs while falling asleep or upon waking up.

translations.source: Hili linaweza kufanywa kwa kutumia saa ya kengele isiyo na kelele kubwa sana ili kukufanya upate fahamu bila kukuamsha kabisa.
translations.reference: This can be easily done by using a relatively quiet alarm clock to bring you to consciousness without fully waking you.
translations.hypothesis: This can be done using a silent alarm clock to rouse you without startling you awake.

translations.source: Kama utajipata ukiweka upya saa ya kengele katika usingizi wako, inaweza kuwekwa upande mwingine wa chumba, ili kukulazimu kuondoka kitandani kuizima.
translations.reference: If you find yourself resetting the clock in your sleep, it can be placed on the other side of the room, forcing you to get out of bed to turn it off.
translations.hypothesis: If you find yourself hitting the snooze button repeatedly, place your alarm across the room so you have to get out of bed to turn it off.

translations.source: Chaguo zingine za midundobayolojia huhusisha unywaji mwingi (hususan wa maji au chai, dawa maarufu) kabla ya kulala, hali inayomlazimu mtu kuamka ili kwenda haja ndogo.
translations.reference: Other biorhythm-based options involve drinking lots of fluid (particularly water or tea, a known diuretic) prior to sleep, forcing one to get up to urinate.
translations.hypothesis: Other biological options involve drinking large quantities (particularly of water or herbal tea, a traditional treatment) just before going to bed, a practice which forces the person to urinate during the night.

translations.source: Kiwango cha amani ya ndani ambayo mtu humiliki huhusiana kinyume na kiwango cha mkazo ndani ya mwili na roho yake.
translations.reference: The amount of inner peace a person possesses correlates oppositely to the amount of tension in one’s body and spirit.
translations.hypothesis: The degree of inner peace that one experiences is directly related to the degree of tension within the body and mind.

translations.source: Kadiri mvuto ulivyo chini, ndivyo nguvu za maisha zilizoko zilivyo chanya. Kila mtu ana uwezo wa kupata amani na kuridhika zaidi.
translations.reference: The lower the tension, the more positive the life force present. Every person has the potential to find absolute peace and contentment.
translations.hypothesis: The lower the gravity, the more positive the life forces are. Everyone has the potential to experience more peace and happiness.

translations.source: Kila mtu anaweza kupata uelewa. Kitu kimoja kinachosimama njiani mwa lengo hili ni wasiwasi na uhasi wetu wenyewe.
translations.reference: Everyone can achieve enlightenment. The only thing standing in the way of this goal is our own tension and negativity.
translations.hypothesis: Everyone can gain from understanding. The only thing standing in the way of this goal is our own fears and insecurities.

translations.source: Ubuddha wa Tibetani una msingi wa mafundisho ya Buddha, lakini ulipanuliwa na njia ya mahayana ya upendo na mbinu nyingi za kutoka kwa Yoga ya India.
translations.reference: The Tibetan Buddhism is based on the teachings of Buddha, but were extended by the mahayana path of love and by a lot of techniques from Indian Yoga.
translations.hypothesis: Tibetan Buddhism is based on the teachings of the Buddha, but has also been influenced by the Mahayana Buddhist schools and by Tantric Buddhist practices from India.

translations.source: Katika kanuni, Ubudha wa Kitibeti ni rahisi sana. Una Yoga ya Kundalini, kutafakari na njia ya upendo unaokumbatia yote.
translations.reference: In principle the Tibetan Buddhism is very simple. It consists of Kundalini Yoga, meditation and the path of all-embracing love.
translations.hypothesis: In principle, Tibetan Buddhism is very simple. It has Kundalini Yoga, meditation and a path of loving-kindness.

translations.source: Kupitia Yoga ya Kundalini, nguvu za Kundalini (nguvu za mwangaza) huibushwa kupitia mkao wa yoga, mazoezi ya kupumua, urudiaji maneno au sauti na taswira.
translations.reference: With Kundalini Yoga the Kundalini energy (enlightenment energy) is awakened through yoga postures, breathing exercises, mantras and visualizations.
translations.hypothesis: Through Kundalini Yoga, Kundalini energy (the energy of pure consciousness) is awakened through a combination of yoga postures, breathing techniques, mantra (sound) and visualization.

translations.source: Kitovu cha fikira za Tibet ni Yoga ya Uungu. Kupitia taswira ya miungu mbalimbali njia za nishati zinasafishwa, chakra zinaamilishwa na fahamu ya wongofu inaamshwa.
translations.reference: The center of Tibetan meditation is the Deity Yoga. Through the visualization of various deities the energy channels are cleaned, the chakras are activated and the enlightenment consciousness is created.
translations.hypothesis: The core of Tibetan mysticism is the Yoga of the Great Seal. Through visualization of various deities the energy channels are cleaned, the chakras activated and the consciousness expanded.

translations.source: Ujerumani ilikuwa adui wa kawaida katika Vita vya Pili vya Dunia, hivyo kupelekea ushirikiano wa USSR na Marekani. Kwa kumalizika kwa vita mgongano wa mfumo, mchakato na utamaduni vilipelekea kutengana kwa nchi.
translations.reference: Germany was a common enemy in World War 2, leading to cooperation between the USSR and USA. With the end of the war the clashes of system, process and culture led to the countries falling out.
translations.hypothesis: Germany was the common enemy in World War II, so the USSR and the United States were natural allies. With the end of the war, the ideological, political, and cultural clashes led to the split of the country.

translations.source: Na miaka mbili ya kumalizika kwa vita, washirika wa zamani waligeuka kuwa maadui na Vita Baridi vikaanza.
translations.reference: With two years of the end of the war, the former allies were now enemies and the Cold War began.
translations.hypothesis: Two years after the end of the war, old alliances began to crumble and the Cold War began.

translations.source: Ilikuwa idumu kwa miaka 40 ijayo na ingepigwa kwa kweli na vikosi vya kiwakala, katika nyanja za vita toka Afrika hadi Asia, katika Afghanistani, Kuba na sehemu nyingine nyingi
translations.reference: It was to last for the next 40 years and would be fought for real, by proxy armies, on battlefields from Africa to Asia, in Afghanistan, Cuba and many other places.
translations.hypothesis: It would last for another 40 years and would be fought by proxy forces in battlefields from Africa to Asia, in Afghanistan, Cuba and many other places.

translations.source: Kufikia Septemba 17, 1939, ulinzi wa Kipolishi ulivunjwa, na tumaini la pekee lilikuwa kurudi na kujipanga tena kwa darajakuu la Kiromania.
translations.reference: By September 17, 1939, the Polish defense was already broken, and the only hope was to retreat and reorganise along the Romanian bridgehead.
translations.hypothesis: By September 17, 1939, the Polish defenses had been broken, and the only hope was to regroup and reorganize with the Romanian Army.

translations.source: Hata hivyo, mipango hii ilipitwa na wakati usiku mmoja, wakati zaidi ya askari 800,000 kutoka Jeshi Jekundu la Umoja wa Kisovyeti lilipoingia na kuunda mipaka ya Belarusiani na Ukreini baada ya kuvamia maeneo ya mashariki mwa Polandi kwa kukiuka Mkataba wa Amani wa Riga, Mapatano ya Kisovyeti-Polishi Yasiyo ya Uchokozi, na mikataba mingine ya kimataifa, pande mbili na pande nyingi.
translations.reference: However, these plans were rendered obsolete nearly overnight, when over 800,000 soldiers from the Soviet's Union Red Army entered and created the Belarussian and Ukrainian fronts after invading the eastern regions of Poland in violation of the Riga Peace Treaty, the Soviet-Polish Non-Aggression Pact, and other international treaties, both bilateral and multilateral.
translations.hypothesis: However, these plans were overtaken by events overnight, when over 800,000 troops of the Soviet Red Army entered and deployed along the Belarusian–Ukrainian border after invading eastern Poland in violation of the Riga Peace Treaty, the Soviet–Polish Non-Aggression Pact, and other international, bilateral, and multilateral agreements.

translations.source: Kutumia meli kusafirisha bidhaa kwa kiasi kikubwa ilikuwa njia bora zaidi ya kusafirisha halaiki ya watu na bidhaa nyingi baharini.
translations.reference: Using ships to transport goods is by far the most efficient way to move large amounts of people and goods across oceans.
translations.hypothesis: Using ships to transport goods was the most efficient way to move large numbers of people and goods across large bodies of water.

translations.source: Kazi ya Jeshi la wanamaji kwa kiasili imekuwa ni kuhakikisha kuwa nchi yako ina uwezo wa kusafirisha watu na bidhaa zako, wakati huo huo, kuzuia uwezo wa adui wako wa kuhamisha watu wake na bidhaa.
translations.reference: The job of navies has traditionally been to ensure that your country maintains the ability to move your people and goods, while at the same time, interfering with your enemy's ability to move his people and goods.
translations.hypothesis: The Navy's job has always been to ensure that your country is able to move its people and its goods, while at the same time, preventing an adversary from moving their people and their goods.

translations.source: Mojawapo ya mifano maarufu ya hivi karibuni ni kampeni ya Kaskazini mwa Atlantiki ya Vita Vikuu vya Pili vya Dunia. Wamarekani walikuwa wakijaribu kusafirisha watu na vifaa kupitia Bahari ya Atlantiki ili kuwasaidia Waingereza.
translations.reference: One of the most noteworthy recent examples of this was the North Atlantic campaign of WWII. The Americans were trying to move men and materials across the Atlantic Ocean to help Britain.
translations.hypothesis: One of the most famous cases is the campaign in the North Atlantic during World War II. The Americans were trying to transport troops and supplies across the Atlantic Ocean to help the British.

translations.source: Wakati huo huo, askari wa majeshi ya Ujerumani, kwa kutumia nyambizi, yalikuwa yakijaribu kuzuia trafiki hii.
translations.reference: At the same time, the German navy, using mainly U-boats, was trying to stop this traffic.
translations.hypothesis: At the same time, German motorized infantry was attempting to block this traffic.

translations.source: Ikiwa Muungano ungeshindwa, pengine Ujerumani ingeweza kushinda Uingereza kama vile ilivyokuwa imeshinda Uropa.
translations.reference: Had the Allies failed, Germany probably would have been able to conquer Britain as it had the rest of Europe.
translations.hypothesis: If the Union had failed, Germany could have won the war as decisively as it had won the battle for Europe.

translations.source: Yaelekea mbuzi walianza kufugwa takriban miaka 10,000 iliyopita katika Milima ya Zagrosi ya Irani.
translations.reference: Goats seem to have been first domesticated roughly 10,000 years ago in the Zagros Mountains of Iran.
translations.hypothesis: Goats were probably first domesticated around 10,000 years ago in the Zagros Mountains of Iran.

translations.source: Tamaduni na makabila ya kale yalianza kuwafuga kwa ufikiaji rahisi wa maziwa, nywele, nyama, na ngozi.
translations.reference: Ancient cultures and tribes began to keep them for easy access to milk, hair, meat, and skins.
translations.hypothesis: Ancient cultures and tribes began domesticating them for easy access to milk, hair, meat, and skin.

translations.source: Kijumla, mbuzi wa nyumbani walianza kufugwa kwa makundi yaliyotangatanga milimani au maeneo mengine ya malisho, huku yakisimamiwa na walinzi ambao mara nyingi walikuwa watoto au vijana wachanga, sawia na wachungaji wanaofahamika sana. Mbinu hizi za ufugaji bado zinatumika hata leo.
translations.reference: Domestic goats were generally kept in herds that wandered on hills or other grazing areas, often tended by goatherds who were frequently children or adolescents, similar to the more widely known shepherd. These methods of herding are still used today.
translations.hypothesis: In general, domestic goats are herded, usually in mountainous or hilly grazing areas, and guarded by shepherds, who are often children or young adults, just like the shepherds of old. These nomadic pastoral practices are still followed today.

translations.source: Magari yanayosukokotwana farasi yalijengwa huko Uingereza mapema kama karne ya 16.
translations.reference: Wagonways were built in England as early as the 16th Century.
translations.hypothesis: The first carriages were built in England around the 16th century.

translations.source: Ingawa njia za magari zilisheheni magogo sambamba ya miti, zilihuruhusu farasi kuzivuta kwa kasi zaidi na kuvuta mizigo mikubwa kiasi kwa barabara mbaya za siku.
translations.reference: Although wagonways merely consisted of parallel planks of wood, they allowed horses pulling them to achieve greater speeds and pull larger loads than on the slightly more rough roads of the day.
translations.hypothesis: Although the roads were rutted and muddy, the carriages allowed the horses to pull heavier loads over the rough roads of the day.

translations.source: Nguzomlalo zilianzishwa mapema kiasi ili kushikilia reli mahali pake. Hata hivyo, kadiri muda ulivyoendelea iligunduliwa kwamba reli hizo zingefanya kazi bora zaidi ikiwa kipande cha chuma kingewekelewa juu.
translations.reference: Crossties were introduced fairly early to hold the tracks in place. Gradually, however, it was realised that tracks would be more efficient if they had a stip of iron on the top.
translations.hypothesis: The earliest flanged wheels were designed to keep the wheel from moving sideways on the track. However, as time went on it was discovered that the flange would work better if the wheel was made of steel.

translations.source: Hii ilikuja kuwa desturi, lakini chuma kilisababisha kuharibika kwa magurudumu ya mbao ya magari ya kukokotwa.
translations.reference: This became common practice, but the iron caused more wear on the wooden wheels of the wagons.
translations.hypothesis: This was a common sight, but the iron caused the wooden wheels of the carriages to break.

translations.source: Hatimaye, magurudumu ya mbao yalibadilishwa na magurudumu ya vyuma. Mnamo 1767, reli za kwanza za vyuma kamili zilianzishwa.
translations.reference: Eventually, wooden wheels were replaced by iron wheels. In 1767, the first full-iron rails were introduced.
translations.hypothesis: Eventually, wooden wheels were replaced by steel ones. In 1767, the first steel rails were introduced.

translations.source: Namna yak kwanza ya uchukuzi iliyofahamika ni kutembea, binadaum walianza kutembea wima miaka milioni mbili iliyopita, baada ya kuibuka kwa wanadamu wima.
translations.reference: The first known transportation was walking, humans began walking upright two million years ago with the emergence of Homo Erectus (meaning upright man).
translations.hypothesis: The first known mode of transportation was walking, humans have been walking upright for about 2 million years, after the evolution of bipedalism.

translations.source: Watangulizi wao, Australopithecus hawakutembea wima kama kawaida.
translations.reference: Their predecessors, the Australopithecus did not walk upright as habitually.
translations.hypothesis: Their ancestors, the australopithecines, were not fully upright walkers.

translations.source: Utaalamu wa bipedali unapatikana katika visukuku vya Australopithekasi kuanzia miaka milion 4.2 hadi 3.9 iliyopita, ingawa inawezekana kuwa Sahelanthropasi walitembea kwa miguu miwili takriban miaka milioni saba iliyopita.
translations.reference: Bipedal specializations are found in Australopithecus fossils from 4.2-3.9 million years ago, although Sahelanthropus may have walked on two legs as early as seven million years ago.
translations.hypothesis: The bipedalism is known from Australopithecus fossils from 4.2 to 3.9 million years ago, though it is possible that Sahelanthropus was bipedal around 7 million years ago.

translations.source: Tunaweza kuanza kuishi kama marafiki wazuri wa mazingira, tunaweza kujiunga na harakati za mazingira, na hata pia tunaweza kuwa wanaharakati ili kupunguza dhiki ya baadaye kwa kiwango fulani.
translations.reference: We can start living more friendly to the environment, we can join to the environmental movement, and we can even be activists in order to reduce the future suffering in some degree.
translations.hypothesis: We can start living as good friends of the environment, we can join environmental movements, and we can also be activists to reduce the pressure on the planet.

translations.source: Hii ni sawa na matibabu ya dalili katika hali nyingi. Hata hivyo, ikiwa hatutaki tu suluhisho la muda mfupi, basi tunastahili kupata shina la matatizo, nasi tupate kuizima.
translations.reference: This is just like symptomatic treatment in many cases. However, if we do not only want a temporary solution, then we should find the root of the problems, and we should deactivate them.
translations.hypothesis: This is equivalent to treating the symptoms in most cases. However, if we do not want temporary solutions, then we should get to the bottom of the problems, and stop them from happening in the first place.

translations.source: Ni wazi kabisa kuwa ulimwengu umebadilika sana kwa sababu ya maendeleo ya kibinadamu katika sayansi na teknolojia, nayo matatizo yameongezeka kwa sababu ya watu kuwa wengi kupita kiasi na mitindo ya ubadhirifu ya maisha ya wanadamu.
translations.reference: It is obvious enough that the world has changed much because of humankind's scientific and technological advancements, and problems have become greater because of overpopulation and mankind's extravagant lifestyle.
translations.hypothesis: It is obvious that the world has changed dramatically because of the rapid progress in science and technology, and the problems have increased in parallel with the increase in the number of humans and the complexity of human life.

translations.source: Baada ya kukubaliwa na Kongresi mnamo Julai 4, rasimu iliyoandikwa kwa hati ya mkono na kutiwa sahihi na Rais wa Kongresi John Hancock na Katibu Charles Thomson ilitumwa vitalu vichache kwa duka la uchapishaji la John Dunlap.
translations.reference: After its adoption by Congress on July 4, a handwritten draft signed by the President of Congress John Hancock and the Secretary Charles Thomson was then sent a few blocks away to the printing shop of John Dunlap.
translations.hypothesis: After being approved by Congress on July 4, the handwritten draft was signed by President of the Congress John Hancock and Secretary Charles Thomson and then dispatched to the printer John Dunlap.

translations.source: Usiku kucha kati ya nakala 150 na 200 zilitengenezwa, ambazo sasa zinajulikana kama “Vikaratasi vya Dunlop”.
translations.reference: Through the night between 150 and 200 copies were made, now known as "Dunlap broadsides".
translations.hypothesis: Overnight, between 150 and 200 copies were produced, which were quickly dubbed "The Dunlop Letters".

translations.source: Usomaji wa kwanza kwa umma wa hati hiyo ulifanywa na John Nixon katika yadi ya Ukumbi wa Uhuru mnamo Julai 8.
translations.reference: The first public reading of the document was by John Nixon in the yard of Independence Hall on July 8.
translations.hypothesis: The first public reading of the document was done by John Nixon in the yard of the State House on July 8.

translations.source: Moja ilitumwa kwa George Washington mnamo Julai 6, ambaye aliifanya isomewe vikosi vyake katika New York mnamo Julai 9. Nakala ilifika London mnamo Agosti 10.
translations.reference: One was sent to George Washington on July 6, who had it read to his troops in New York on July 9. A copy reached London on August 10.
translations.hypothesis: One was sent to George Washington on July 6, who ordered it to be published to his troops on July 9. The document arrived in London on August 10.

translations.source: Nakala 25 za Dunlap zenye cheche za mashambulizi zinazojulikana kuwahi kuwepo ndizo nakala kongwe zaidi za hati hiyo zinazopatikana. Nakala asili iliyoandikwa kwa mkono haipo.
translations.reference: The 25 Dunlap broadsides still known to exist are the oldest surviving copies of the document. The original handwritten copy has not survived.
translations.hypothesis: The 25 known surviving Dunlap copies are the earliest extant copies of the document. The original handwritten copy has not survived.

translations.source: Wanapaleontolojia wengi leo hii wanaamini kuwa kikundi kimoja cha dinosau kiliponea na kingali hai hata sasa. Tunawaita ndege.
translations.reference: Many paleontologists today believe that one group of dinosaurs survived and is alive today. We call them birds.
translations.hypothesis: Many paleontologists today believe that one group of dinosaurs never became extinct and survives to this day. We call them birds.

translations.source: Watu wengi hawawachukuliii kuwa dinosau kwa sababu wana manyoya na wanaweza kupaa.
translations.reference: Many people don't think about them as dinosaurs because they have feathers and can fly.
translations.hypothesis: Many people do not think of them as dinosaurs because they have feathers and can fly.

translations.source: Lakini kuna mambo mengi juu ya ndege ambao bado wanaonekana kama dinosau.
translations.reference: But there are a lot of things about birds that still look like a dinosaur.
translations.hypothesis: But there are many things about birds that still look like they came from the dinosaurs.

translations.source: Wana miguu yenye magamba na makucha, hutaga mayai na hutembea kwa miguu yake miwili ya nyuma kama T-Rex.
translations.reference: They have feet with scales and claws, they lay eggs, and they walk on their two back legs like a T-Rex.
translations.hypothesis: They have clawed feet and nails, lay eggs and walk upright on two legs like a T-Rex.

translations.source: Karibu kompyuta zote zinazotumika leo zimekitwa katika kuendeshwa kwa habari ambayo imewekwa katika msimbo ulio katika hali ya nambari za bainari.
translations.reference: Virtually all computers in use today are based on the manipulation of information which is coded in the form of binary numbers.
translations.hypothesis: Almost all computers used today are based on the concept of a stored-program computer, which is a computer that stores and executes instructions in the form of binary numbers.

translations.source: Nambari ya bainari yaweza tu kuwa na thamani moja kati ya mbili, yaani 0 au 1, na hizi nambari zinajulikana kama takwimu jozi, au biti, katika msamiati wa kompyuta.
translations.reference: A binary number can have only one of two values, i.e. 0 or 1, and these numbers are referred to as binary digits - or bits, to use computer jargon.
translations.hypothesis: A binary number can only have one of two values, namely 0 or 1, and these numbers are referred to as bits in computer terminology.

translations.source: Sumu ya ndani inaweza kukosa kuwa dhahiri papo hapo. Dalili, kama vile kutapika ni jumla kiasi kwamba utambuzi wa mara moja hauwezi kufanywa.
translations.reference: Internal poisoning may not be immediately apparent. Symptoms, such as vomiting are sufficiently general that an immediate diagnosis cannot be made.
translations.hypothesis: The onset of internal toxicity may be insidious. Symptoms, such as vomiting, are so general that immediate diagnosis is often impossible.

translations.source: Dalili bora ya sumu ya ndani inaweza kuwa kuwepo kwa chombo wazi cha dawa ama kemikali za kaya zenye sumu.
translations.reference: The best indication of internal poisoning may be the presence of an open container of medication or toxic household chemicals.
translations.hypothesis: The only real indicator of an organophosphorus pesticide or other chemical poisoning may be the presence of an empty container of the poison in the home or workplace.

translations.source: Angalia lebo kwa maagizo maalum ya huduma ya kwanza ya sumu hiyo.
translations.reference: Check the label for specific first aid instructions for that specific poison.
translations.hypothesis: Check the label for specific first aid instructions for that poison.

translations.source: Neno mdudu hutumiwa na wanaentomolojia katika matumizi rasmi ya kikundi hiki cha wadudu.
translations.reference: The term bug is used by entomologists in a formal sense for this group of insects.
translations.hypothesis: The word insect is used by entomologists in formal reference to this group of animals.

translations.source: Nenohili limetoka kwenye kufahamiana kwa kale na Kunguni, ambao wana ustadi mkubwa wa kumelea binadamu.
translations.reference: This term derives from ancient familiarity with Bed-bugs, which are insects highly adapted to parasitize humans.
translations.hypothesis: The Nenohili are said to have originated from the ancient race of the Kunguni, who were supposedly the first humanoid species to have mastered the art of metalworking.

translations.source: Wadudu Assasin-bugs na Kunguni wana uzoefu wa kuishi katika kiota ama makazi ya mwenyeji wao.
translations.reference: Both Assassin-bugs and Bed-bugs are nidicolous, adapted to living in nest or housing of their host.
translations.hypothesis: Assassin bugs and tsetse flies have a propensity to live in or near human dwellings.

translations.source: Katika Amerika yote, kuna takribani kesi 400,000 zinazojulikana za Sklerosisi ya Sehemu Nyingi (MS), na kuuwacha kuwa ugonjwa wa neva unaoongoza katika vijana na watu wazima wenye umri wa kati.
translations.reference: Across the United States of America, there are approximately 400,000 known cases of Multiple Sclerosis (MS), leaving it as the leading neurological disease in younger and middle aged adults.
translations.hypothesis: In the Americas, there are nearly 400,000 known cases of multiple sclerosis (MS), making it the second most common neurological disease after stroke in young adults.

translations.source: Selerosisiwingi ni ugonjwa unaoathiri mfumo mkuu wa neva, ambao unajumuisha ubongo, uti wa mgongo na neva ya macho.
translations.reference: MS is a disease that affects the central nervous system, which is made up of the brain, the spinal cord and the optic nerve.
translations.hypothesis: Neurocysticercosis is a disease affecting the central nervous system, which includes the brain, spinal cord and optic nerve.

translations.source: Utafiti umebainisha kuwa wanawake wana uwezekano maradufu wa kuugua selerosisiwingi kuliko wanaume.
translations.reference: Research has found that females are two times more likely to have MS then males.
translations.hypothesis: Studies have found that women are more than twice as likely to develop epilepsy as men.

translations.source: Wenzi wawili huenda wakaamua si kwa masilahi yao bora, au masilahi ya mtoto wao, kumlea mtoto.
translations.reference: A couple may decide it is not in their best interest, or in the interest of their child, to raise a baby.
translations.hypothesis: The two parents may decide that it is not in their best interest, or the best interest of their child, to raise the child together.

translations.source: Wanandoa hawa wanaweza kuchagua kutengeneza mpango wa ulezi wa mtoto wao.
translations.reference: These couples may choose to make an adoption plan for their baby.
translations.hypothesis: These couples may opt to make their own arrangements for the child's upbringing.

translations.source: Katika kuchukua ulezi, wazazi wa kuzaa hukomesha haki zao za mzazi ili wazazi wengine waweze kumlea mtoto huyo.
translations.reference: In an adoption, the birth parents terminate their parental rights so that another couple may parent the child.
translations.hypothesis: In adoption, biological parents relinquish their parental rights so that another party can raise a child.

translations.source: Lengo kuu la Sayansi ni kubaini njia ambayo ulimwengu utaendeshwa kwa mbinu za kisayansi. Kwa kweli, mbinu hii huongoza tafiti nyingi za kisayansi.
translations.reference: Science’s main goal is to figure out the way the world works through the scientific method. This method in fact guides most scientific research.
translations.hypothesis: The main goal of science is to find out how the universe works through scientific methods. In fact, this approach guides much of modern scientific research.

translations.source: Haiko peke yake hata hivyo, majaribio, na jaribio ni upimaji ambao hutumiwa kuondoa nadharia moja au mbili zinazowezekana, kuuliza maswali, na kufanya uchunguzi pia huongoza utafiti wa kisayansi.
translations.reference: It isn’t alone though, experimentation, and an experiment is a test that is used to eliminate one or more of the possible hypotheses, asking questions, and making observations also guide scientific research.
translations.hypothesis: It is not alone, however, as trial and error—the process of trying out one or more possible solutions, asking questions, and gathering data—also leads to scientific discovery.

translations.source: Wataalam wa asili na wanafalsafa waliangazia matini za jadi, na hususan, Biblia ya Kilatini.
translations.reference: Naturalists and philosophers focused on classical texts and, in particular, on the Bible in Latin.
translations.hypothesis: Scholars and philosophers highlighted the traditional texts, and in particular, the Latin Bible.

translations.source: Maoni ya Aristotle juu ya mambo yote ya sayansiyalikubalika, ikiwemo saikolojia.
translations.reference: Accepted were Aristotle's views on all matters of science, including psychology.
translations.hypothesis: Aristotle's views on all aspects of science, including psychology, are considered acceptable.

translations.source: Jinsi maarifa ya Wagiriki yalivyopungua, Magharibi ilijikuta ikikatwa kutoka kwa asili za kifalsafa na kisayansi ya Kigiriki.
translations.reference: As knowledge of Greek declined, the West found itself cut off from its Greek philosophical and scientific roots.
translations.hypothesis: As Greek learning declined, the West became isolated from its Greek philosophical and scientific heritage.

translations.source: Wengi walifuata mtindo katika fiziolojia na tabia ambazo mara nyingi hutegemea uwepo wa vipindi vya kiasili na uzalishaji wao kupitia mida za kibiolojia.
translations.reference: Many observed rhythms in physiology and behavior often crucially depend on the presence of endogenous cycles and their production through biological clocks.
translations.hypothesis: Many followed patterns in physiology and behaviour that were often dependent on the presence of natural rhythms and their production through biological clocks.

translations.source: Midundo ya mara kwa mara, ambayo si jibu tu kwa ishara za nje za mara kwa mara, imerekodiwa kwa viumbe wengi wenye uhai, zikiwemo bakteria, kuvu, mimea na wanyama,
translations.reference: Periodic rhythms, which are not simply responses to external periodic cues, have been documented for most living beings, including bacteria, fungi, plants, and animals.
translations.hypothesis: Circadian rhythms, which are not just a response to external light-dark cycles, have been recorded in a wide range of organisms, including bacteria, fungi, plants, and animals.

translations.source: Saa za kibiolojia ni osileta zinazojimudu ambazo zitaendeleza kipindi cha ujiendeshaji wa mzunguko hata pasipo na vidokezo vya nje.
translations.reference: Biological clocks are self sustaining oscillators which will continue a period of free-running cycling even in the absence of external cues.
translations.hypothesis: Biological clocks are self-sustained systems that continue to produce a cycle of activity even in the absence of external cues.

translations.source: Jaribio la Hershey na Chase lilikuwa mojawapo ya mapendekezo kwamba DNA ilikuwa nyenzo za nasaba.
translations.reference: The Hershey and Chase experiment was one of the leading suggestions that DNA was a genetic material.
translations.hypothesis: Hershey and Chase's experiment was one of the experiments that proved that DNA was the genetic material.

translations.source: Hershey na Chase walitumia virusi kuchomeka DNA yao wenyewe ndani ya bakteria.
translations.reference: Hershey and Chase used phages, or viruses, to implant their own DNA into a bacterium.
translations.hypothesis: Hershey and Chase used viruses to infect bacteria with their DNA.

translations.source: Walifanya majaribio mawili kuashiria DNA kwenye virusi kwa fosforasi nururifuau protini ya virusi kwa salfa nururishi.
translations.reference: They did two experiments marking either the DNA in the phage with a radioactive phosphorus or the protein of the phage with radioactive sulfur.
translations.hypothesis: They performed two tests to identify viral DNA: a rapid test and a more accurate polymerase chain reaction (PCR) test.

translations.source: Mabadiliko yanaweza kuwa na athari tofauti kutegemea aina ya mabadiliko, umuhimu wa kifaa cha maumbile kilichoathiriwa na ikiwa seli zilizoathiriwa ni seli za vijidudu.
translations.reference: Mutations can have a variety of different effects depending on the type of mutation, the significance of the piece of genetic material affected and whether the cells affected are germ-line cells.
translations.hypothesis: The effects can be diverse depending on the type of radiation, the dose, the rate of exposure, the individual response and whether the cells affected are stem cells.

translations.source: Ni mabadiliko ya seli za vijidudu tu ambayo yanaweza kusambazwa kwa watoto, huku mabadiliko kwingineko yakiweza kusababisha seli za kifo au saratani.
translations.reference: Only mutations in germ-line cells can be passed on to children, while mutations elsewhere can cause cell-death or cancer.
translations.hypothesis: Only the bacterial cell wall can be transferred to children, while other bacterial products can lead to cell death or cancer.

translations.source: Utalii wa asili huvutia watu walio na nia ya kutembelea maeneo ya asili kwa sababu ya kuburudishwa na maadhari, pamoja na mimea na wanyama.
translations.reference: Nature-based tourism attracts people interested in visiting natural areas for the purpose of enjoying the scenery, including plant and animal wildlife.
translations.hypothesis: Nature tourism attracts people with an interest in visiting natural settings for recreation and inspiration, as well as for observing flora and fauna.

translations.source: Mifano ya shughuli za eneoni ni pamoja na uwindaji, uvuvi, upigaji picha, kutazama ndege, na kutembelea mbuga na kusoma habari za mfumo wa ikolojia.
translations.reference: Examples of on-site activities include hunting, fishing, photography, bird watching, and visiting parks and studying information about the ecosystem.
translations.hypothesis: Examples of outdoor activities include hiking, fishing, photography, birdwatching, and camping, as well as reading about the local flora and fauna.

translations.source: Mfano ni kutembelea, kupiga picha, na kujifunza juu ya nyani wakubwa huko Borneo.
translations.reference: An example is visiting, photographing, and learning about organgatuangs in Borneo.
translations.hypothesis: An example is visiting, photographing, and learning about the orangutans in Borneo.

translations.source: Kila asubuhi, watu huondoka miji midogo mashambani ndani ya magari wakielekea kazini wakipitana na wengine ambao wanaelekea kazini walikotoka wao.
translations.reference: Every morning, people leave small country towns in cars to go their workplace and are passed by others whose work destination is the place they have just left.
translations.hypothesis: Every morning, people from smaller rural towns commute to the city for work, passing by others who are headed in the opposite direction to their workplaces.

translations.source: Katika chombo hiki imara cha usafiri, kila mtu kwa njia fulani ameunganishwa na, na kuunga mkono, mfumo wa usafiri unaotegemea magari ya kibinafsi.
translations.reference: In this dynamic transport shuttle everyone is somehow connected with, and supporting, a transport system based on private cars.
translations.hypothesis: In this intricate web of mobility, everyone is connected to, and reliant on, a car-dependent transportation system.

translations.source: Sayansi sasa inaashiria kuwa uchumi huu mkubwa wa kaboni umeondoa nyanjahai ya dunia kutoka mojawapo ya hali zake imara ambayo ilipaswa kushikilia mageuzi ya mwanadamu kwa miaka milioni mbili iliyopita.
translations.reference: Science now indicates that this massive carbon economy has dislodged the biosphere from one of its stable states that has supported human evolution for the past two million years.
translations.hypothesis: Science now indicates that this massive carbon reservoir has overridden a planetary thermostat that once maintained the Earth in a stable state for two million years of evolution.

translations.source: Kila mtu hushiriki katika jamii na kutumia mifumo ya uchukuzi. Karibu kila mtu hulalamika kuhusu mifumo ya uchukuzi.
translations.reference: Everyone participates in society and uses transportation systems. Almost everyone complains about transportation systems.
translations.hypothesis: Everyone participates in a community and uses transportation systems. Almost everyone complains about the transportation systems.

translations.source: Katika nchi zilizostawi ni nadra kusikia viwango sawa vya malalamiko kuhusu ubora wa maji au uporomokaji wa madaraja.
translations.reference: In developed countries you seldom hear similar levels of complaints about water quality or bridges falling down.
translations.hypothesis: In developed countries it is rare to hear complaints about the quality of the water or the taste of the water.

translations.source: Ni kwa nini mifumo ya usafiri huweka hisia kwenye malalamiko kama hayo, kwa nini wao hufeli kila siku? Ni kwamba wahandisi wa usafiri hawajiwezi? Au kuna kitu cha msingi zaidi kinachoendelea?
translations.reference: Why do transportation systems engender such complaints, why do they fail on a daily basis? Are transportation engineers just incompetent? Or is something more fundamental going on?
translations.hypothesis: Why does the transport system have a problem with complaints like these, why does it fail every single day? Is it that the engineers are not good enough? Or is there something more fundamental going on?

translations.source: Mtiririko wa Trafiki ni utafiti wa mwondoko wa madereva binafsi na magari kati ya sehemu mbili na mwingiliano wanaofanya na wenzao.
translations.reference: Traffic Flow is the study of the movement of individual drivers and vehicles between two points and the interactions they make with one another.
translations.hypothesis: Traffic flow is the study of the movement of individual vehicles and drivers between two points and their interaction with each other.

translations.source: Kwa bahati mbaya, kutafiti mtiririko wa trafiki ni vigumu kwa sababu tabia ya dereva haiwezi kutabiriwa kwa uhakika wa asilimia mia moja.
translations.reference: Unfortunately, studying traffic flow is difficult because driver behavior cannot be predicted with one-hundred percent certainty.
translations.hypothesis: Unfortunately, predicting traffic flow is difficult because human driving behavior is inherently unpredictable.

translations.source: Kwa bahati, madereva huwa na mazoea kwa upatano fulani; kwa hivyo, misongamano ya trafiki huwa na uthabiti fulani na inaweza kuwakilishwa haswa kitakwimu.
translations.reference: Fortunately, drivers tend to behave within a reasonably consistent range; thus, traffic streams tend to have some reasonable consistency and can be roughly represented mathematically.
translations.hypothesis: Fortunately, drivers tend to behave in a predictable way; therefore, traffic jams are a relatively stable phenomenon and can be predicted with some accuracy.

translations.source: Ili kuwakilisha mtiririko wa trafiki vizuri, uhusiano umeanzishwa kati ya hali tatu kuu: (1) mtiririko, (2) uzito, (3) kasimwelekeo.
translations.reference: To better represent traffic flow, relationships have been established between the three main characteristics: (1) flow, (2) density, and (3) velocity.
translations.hypothesis: To better represent traffic flow, a link is established between the three main factors: (1) speed, (2) density, (3) headway.

translations.source: Mahusiano haya husaidia katika upangaji, kubuni, na uendeshaji wa welekevu barabarani.
translations.reference: These relationships help in planning, design, and operations of roadway facilities.
translations.hypothesis: These relationships help in the planning, design, and operation of traffic control devices.

translations.source: Wadudu ndio waliokuwa wanyama wa kwanza kupaa angani. Uwezo wao wa kupaa uliwasaidia kuwakwepa maadui kwa urahisi na kupata chakula na wenzi wao kwa urahisi.
translations.reference: Insects were the first animals to take to the air. Their ability to fly helped them evade enemies more easily and find food and mates more efficiently.
translations.hypothesis: Insects were the first animals to take to the air. Their ability to fly helped them to avoid predators and to find food and mates more easily.

translations.source: Wadudu wengi wana bahati ya kuweza kufunga mbawa zao mwilini.
translations.reference: Most insects have the advantage of being able to fold their wings back along the body.
translations.hypothesis: Many insects have the ability to fold their wings flat against their bodies.

translations.source: Hii huwapa fursa pana ya sehemu ndogondogo za kujificha na adui wao.
translations.reference: This gives them a wider range of small places to hide from predators.
translations.hypothesis: This gives them a greater ability to hide from their enemies.

translations.source: Siku hizi, wadudu pekee ambao hawawezi kukunja mabawa yao kwenda nyuma ni kerengende na kipupe.
translations.reference: Today, the only insects that cannot fold back their wings are dragon flies and mayflies.
translations.hypothesis: Nowadays, the only insects that can not fold their wings back are the mayfly and the water boatman.

translations.source: Maelfu ya miaka iliyopita, mwanamume aliyeitwa Aristarchus alisema kwamba Mfumo wa Jua ulizunguka Jua.
translations.reference: Thousands of years ago, a man called Aristarchus said that the Solar System moved around the Sun.
translations.hypothesis: Thousands of years ago, a man named Aristarchus said that the planets go around the Sun.

translations.source: Baadhi ya watu walidhani alikuwa sahihi lakini watu wengi waliamini kinyume chake; kwamba Mfumo wa Jua huzunguuka Dunia, pamoja na Jua (na hat nyota nyinginezo).
translations.reference: Some people thought he was right but many people believed the opposite; that the Solar System moved around the Earth, including the Sun (and even the other stars).
translations.hypothesis: Some people thought he was right but most people believed otherwise; that the Sun goes around the Earth, along with the other stars.

translations.source: Hii inaonekana kuwa busara, kwa sababu Dunia haionekani kana kwamba inasonga, au sivyo?
translations.reference: This seems sensible, because the Earth doesn't feel as if it's moving, does it?
translations.hypothesis: This sounds intuitive, because the Earth does not seem to be moving, right?

translations.source: Mto wa Amazon ndiyo mto wa pili kwa urefu na kubwa zaidi Duniani. Inachukua maji zaidi ya mara 8 kama mto wa pili mkubwa.
translations.reference: The Amazon River is the second longest and the biggest river on Earth. It carries more than 8 times as much water as the second biggest river.
translations.hypothesis: The Amazon River is the second-longest and second-largest river in the world. It is about eight times larger than the second-longest river.

translations.source: Amazon pia ni mto mpana zaidi Duniani, wakati mwingine maili sita kwa upana.
translations.reference: The Amazon is also the widest river on Earth, at times six miles wide.
translations.hypothesis: The Amazon is also the widest river in the world, at times six miles across.

translations.source: Asilimia 20 kamili ya maji ambayo yanatoka kwenye mito ya sayari kuenda ndani ya bahari hutoka kwenye Amazoni.
translations.reference: A full 20 percent of the water that pours out of the planet's rivers into the oceans comes from the Amazon.
translations.hypothesis: Twenty percent of the water that flows into the Earth's oceans comes from the Amazon.

translations.source: Mto mkuu wa Amazon una kilomita 6,387 (maili 3,980). Hukusanya maji kutoka maelfu ya mito midogo.
translations.reference: The main Amazon River is 6,387 km (3,980 miles). It collects water from thousands of smaller rivers.
translations.hypothesis: The Amazon River is 6,387 km (3,980 mi) long. It collects waters from thousands of smaller rivers.

translations.source: Ingawa ujenzi wa piramidi kwa mawe uliendelea hadi mwishoni mwa Ufalme Mzee, piramidi za Giza hazikuwahi kupitwa katika saizi yazo na ubora wa kiufundi wa ujenzi wazo.
translations.reference: Although pyramid-building in stone continued until the end of the Old Kingdom, the pyramids of Giza were never surpassed in their size and the technical excellence of their construction.
translations.hypothesis: Although stone pyramid construction continued well into the Old Kingdom, the Giza pyramids were never surpassed in size and technical expertise of their construction.

translations.source: Wamisri wa kale wa Ufalme mpya walishangazwa na minara ya watangulizi wao, ambayo ilikuwa wakati huo na zaidi ya miaka elfu.
translations.reference: New Kingdom ancient Egyptians marvelled at their predecessors monuments, which were then well over a thousand year old.
translations.hypothesis: The ancient Egyptians of the New Kingdom were amazed by the longevity of their pyramids, which had been standing for more than a thousand years.

translations.source: Idadi ya watu Jijini Vatican ni takriban 800. Ndio taifa ndogo kabisa duniani lililo huru na nchi yenye idadi ndogo kabisa ya watu.
translations.reference: Vatican City's population is around 800. It is the smallest independent country in the world and the country with the lowest population.
translations.hypothesis: The population of Vatican City is about 800. It is the smallest independent state in the world by both area and population.

translations.source: Jiji la Vatikani hutumia Kiitaliano katika sheria zake na mawasiliano rasmi.
translations.reference: Vatican City uses Italian in its legislation and official communications.
translations.hypothesis: The Vatican City uses Italian in its civil law and in official communications.

translations.source: Kiitaliano pia ni lugha ya kila siku inayotumika na wengi wa wale wanaofanya kazi katika serikali huku Kilatini mara nyingi kikitumika katika sherehe za kidini.
translations.reference: Italian is also the everyday language used by most of those who work in the state while Latin is often used in religious ceremonies.
translations.hypothesis: Italian is also the language of daily use by most of those working in the government, while Latin is often used in religious contexts.

translations.source: Wananchi wote wa Mji wa Vatican ni Wakatoliki ya Kiroma.
translations.reference: All citizens of Vatican City are Roman Catholic.
translations.hypothesis: All citizens of Vatican City are Roman Catholics.

translations.source: Watu wameshajua kuhusu elementi za kimsingi za kemikali kama vile dhahabu, fedha, na shaba kutoka zamani, kwani hizi zote zinaweza kugunduliwa kwa maumbile katika hali ya asili na ni rahisi kuchimbuliwa kwa kutumia zana za zamani.
translations.reference: People have known about basic chemical elements such as gold, silver, and copper from antiquity, as these can all be discovered in nature in native form and are relatively simple to mine with primitive tools.
translations.hypothesis: Humans have known about elements such as gold, silver, and copper since ancient times, because these elements can be found in their native form and are easy to work with using simple tools.

translations.source: Aristotle, mwanafalsafa, alitoa dhana kuwa kila kitu kimetengenezwa kwa mchanganyiko wa kitu kimoja au zaidi kati ya vitu vinne. Vitu hivyo ni ardhi, maji, hewa na moto.
translations.reference: Aristotle, a philosopher, theorised that everything is made up of a mixture of one or more of four elements. They were earth, water, air, and fire.
translations.hypothesis: Aristotle, a Greek philosopher, proposed that everything is made up of a combination of one or more of four elements. These elements are earth, water, air, and fire.

translations.source: Hii ilikuwa kama hali nne za mata (kwa mpangilio huohuo): mango, uoevu, gesi na utegili, ingawa pia alitoa nadharia kwamba hugeuka kuwa vitu vipya ili kuunda tunachoona.
translations.reference: This was more like the four states of matter (in the same order): solid, liquid, gas, and plasma, though he also theorised that they change into new substances to form what we see.
translations.hypothesis: This was like the four elements (in order): earth, water, air and fire, although he also proposed that they could turn into a fifth element to create everything else we see.

translations.source: Aloi kimsingi ni mchanganyiko wa metali mbili au zaidi. Usisahau kwamba kuna elementi nyingi kwenye jedwali la elementi.
translations.reference: Alloys are basically a mixture of two or more metals. Don't forget that there are many elements on the periodic table.
translations.hypothesis: An alloy is basically a combination of two or more metals. Keep in mind that there are many elements on the periodic table.

translations.source: Elementi kama Kalsiamu na Potasiamu huwa zinachukuliwa kama vyuma. kwa kweli kuna vyuma vingine kama fedha na dhahabu .
translations.reference: Elements like calcium and potassium are considered metals. Of course, there are also metals like silver and gold.
translations.hypothesis: Elements like calcium and potassium are metals. Other metals include silver and gold.

translations.source: Pia unaweza kuwa na alo ambazo zinajumuisha viwango vidogo vya vipengele visivyo vya chuma kamavile kaboni.
translations.reference: You can also have alloys that include small amounts of non-metallic elements like carbon.
translations.hypothesis: You may also have alloys which are mixtures of metals with a small proportion of other elements, such as carbon.

translations.source: Kila kitu katika ulimwengu kimeundwa kutokana na dutu. Dutu zote zimeundwa kutokana na chembe ndogo ndogo zinazoitwa atomi.
translations.reference: Everything in the Universe is made of matter. All matter is made of tiny particles called atoms.
translations.hypothesis: Everything in the world is made up of matter. All matter is made up of tiny particles called atoms.

translations.source: Atomu huwa ndogo ajabu kiasi kwamba trilioni nyingi zaweza kutoshea katika kipindicha mwisho wa sentensi hii.
translations.reference: Atoms are so incredibly tiny that trillions of them could fit into the period at the end of this sentence.
translations.hypothesis: Atoms are so small that trillions of them could fit on the head of a pin.

translations.source: Kwa hivyo hiyo penseli ilikua rafiki mzuri kwa watu wengi wakati ilitokea.
translations.reference: Thus, the pencil was a good friend to many people when it came out.
translations.hypothesis: So that pencil was a very handy thing to have around.

translations.source: Kwa huzuni, kadiri mbinu mpya za kuandika zinavyotokea, ndivyo penseli inavyoshushwa kwenye hadhi na matumizi duni.
translations.reference: Sadly, as newer methods of writing have emerged, the pencil has been relegated to lesser status and uses.
translations.hypothesis: Sadly, as new methods of writing have come into existence, the pencil has been demoted and fallen into disuse.

translations.source: Watu sasa wanaandika jumbe kwenye skrini za kompyuta, kamwe bila haja ya kutumia kichongeo.
translations.reference: People now write messages on computer screens, never having to come close to a sharpener.
translations.hypothesis: People now type messages on computer screens, never needing to use a typewriter.

translations.source: Mtu anaweza kujiuliza kibodi itakuwa nini wakati kitu kipya kitakapokuja.
translations.reference: One can only wonder what the keyboard will become when something newer comes along.
translations.hypothesis: One might wonder what the hold-up has been all these years.

translations.source: Bomu hii gawanyiki hufanya kazi kwa kanuni kwamba nguvu huhitajika katika uundaji wa viini vyenye protoni na nutroni nyingi.
translations.reference: The fission bomb works on the principle that it takes energy to put together a nucleus with many protons and neutrons.
translations.hypothesis: These fission bombs work on the principle that energy is released when heavy nuclei split into smaller ones.

translations.source: Kama vile kuviringisha rukwama nzito kuelekea mlimani. Kugawanya nyuklia mara nyingine tena kisha kutoa baadhi ya nishati hiyo.
translations.reference: Sort of like rolling a heavy cart up a hill. Splitting the nucleus up again then releases some of that energy.
translations.hypothesis: Like rolling a heavy stone up a hill. The nucleus then splits again, releasing some energy.

translations.source: Atomu zingine huwa na viini visivyo imara kwa maana kwamba huwa na mazoea ya kuachana hata kwa mguso kidogo tu.
translations.reference: Some atoms have unstable nuclei which means that they tend to break apart with little or no nudging.
translations.hypothesis: Some atoms are more loosely bound than others, meaning that they are more likely to be lost with even a little bit of energy.

translations.source: Uso wa mwezi umeundwa kwa mawe na vumbi. Safu ya nje ya mwezi hujulikana kama ganda.
translations.reference: The surface of the Moon is made of rocks and dust. The outer layer of the Moon is called the crust.
translations.hypothesis: The moon's surface is made out of rock and dust. The moon's outer layer is called the crust.

translations.source: Uso wa dunia una upana wa karibu kilomita 70 kwa ukaribu na upana wa kilomita100 kwa umbali.
translations.reference: The crust is about 70 km thick on the near side and 100 km thick on the far side.
translations.hypothesis: The Earth's surface is about 70 percent water and 30 percent land.

translations.source: Chini ya maria huwa nyembamba lakini nzito chini ya nyanda za juu.
translations.reference: It is thinner under the maria and thicker under the highlands.
translations.hypothesis: Underneath the sea they are thin and light, but under the continents they are thick and heavy.

translations.source: Kunaweza kuwa na maria zaidi upande wa karibu kwa sababu ganda huwa jembamba. Ilikuwa rahisi kwa lava kupanda juu hadi usoni.
translations.reference: There may be more maria on the near side because the crust is thinner. It was easier for lava to rise up to the surface.
translations.hypothesis: There may be more lava on the lower slopes because the crust becomes weaker. It was easy for the lava to ooze out on the surface.

translations.source: Nadharia za maudhui hulenga kupata kinachowafanya watu waendelee au kinachowavutia.
translations.reference: Content theories are centered on finding what makes people tick or appeals to them.
translations.hypothesis: Content theories aim to find out what motivates people.

translations.source: Nadharia hizi zinapendekeza kwamba watu wana mahitaji fulani na/au tamaa ambazo zimekita mizizi jinsi wanavyokomaa katika utu uzima.
translations.reference: These theories suggest that people have certain needs and/or desires which have been internalized as they mature to adulthood.
translations.hypothesis: These theories propose that people have certain needs and/or drives that are the basis of their psychological development.

translations.source: Nadharia hizi huangalia ni nini kinachowahusu watu fulani ambacho huwafanya watake vitu wanavyofanya na ni mambo gani katika mazingira yao yanayowafanya kufanya au kutofanya mambo fulani.
translations.reference: These theories look at what it is about certain people that make them want the things that they do and what things in their environment will make them do or not do certain things.
translations.hypothesis: These theories look at what motivates people and the environmental factors that enable or disable certain behaviours.

translations.source: Nadharia mbili maarufu za maudhui ni Udadisi wa Maslow wa Mahitaji na Nadharia ya Vipengele Viwili ya Hertzberg.
translations.reference: Two popular content theories are Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs Theory and Hertzberg's Two Factor Theory.
translations.hypothesis: Two well-known content theories are Maslow's hierarchy of needs and Herzberg's two-factor theory.

translations.source: Kwa ujumla, tabia mbili zinaweza kuibuka wakati wasimamizi wanaanza kuwaongoza wenzao wa awali. Kwa upande mmoja watajaribu kujinasibisha kama ‘‘mmojawapo wa wanaume’’ (au wanawake).
translations.reference: Generally speaking, two behaviors can emerge as managers begin to lead their former peers. One end of the spectrum is trying to remain “one of the guys” (or gals).
translations.hypothesis: In general, two patterns can be observed when managers start to lead their former peers. On the one hand they will try to identify as “one of the guys” (or gals).

translations.source: Aina hii ya meneja huwa na ugumu kufanya maamuzi yasiyopendeza wengi, kuchukua hatua za kinidhamu, kutathmini utendakazi, kuwatwika watu majukumu, na kuwajibisha watu.
translations.reference: This type of manager has difficulty making unpopular decisions, performing disciplinary action, performance evaluations, assigning responsibility, and holding people accountable.
translations.hypothesis: This type of manager is unlikely to make unpopular decisions, take disciplinary action, evaluate performance, delegate responsibility, or hold people accountable.

translations.source: Katika mwisho mwingine wa upinde, mtu hubadilika kuwa mtu asiyetambulika ambaye huhisi kwamba ni lazima abadilishe kila kitu ambacho timu imekuwa ikifanya na kukifanya kuwa chake.
translations.reference: At the other end of the spectrum, one morphs into an unrecognizable individual that feels he or she must change everything the team has been doing and make it their own.
translations.hypothesis: At the other end of the spectrum is the person who is so eager to please that they will agree with everything the team has done and promise to do even better.

translations.source: Baada ya yote, ni kiongozi ndiye huwajibika mwishoni kwa ufanisi au kuanguka kwa timu.
translations.reference: After all, the leader is ultimately responsible for the success and failure of the team.
translations.hypothesis: After all, the buck stops with the leader when it comes to a team's success or failure.

translations.source: Tabia hiyo mara nyingi husababisha migawanyiko kati ya viongozi na timu nzima.
translations.reference: This behavior oftentimes results in rifts between the leaders and the rest of the team.
translations.hypothesis: This behaviour often leads to a divide between leaders and the rest of the team.

translations.source: Timu za kawaida zinashikiliwa kwa viwango sawa vya ubora kama timu za kawaida lakini kuna tofauti hila.
translations.reference: Virtual teams are held to the same standards of excellence as conventional teams, but there are subtle differences.
translations.hypothesis: Regular teams are held to the same quality standards as normal teams but there are some key differences.

translations.source: Memba pepe wa timu mara nyingi hutumika kama mahali pa mawasiliano kwa kikundi chao cha kimwili cha wakati huo.
translations.reference: Virtual team members often function as the point of contact for their immediate physical group.
translations.hypothesis: The team's online member directory often serves as the go-to resource for their in-person group.

translations.source: Mara nyingi wao huwa na uhuru zaidi kuliko wanachama wa kawaida wa timu kwani timu zao zinaweza kukutana kulingana na maeneo ya wakati yanayotofautiana na inaweza kutoeleweka kwa usimamizi wao.
translations.reference: They often have more autonomy than conventional team members as their teams may meet according to varying time zones which may not be understood by their local management.
translations.hypothesis: They are often more flexible than formal teams as their team members can meet at different times and locations and are less dependent on their supervisors.

translations.source: Uwepo wa “timu isiyoonekana” ya kweli (Larson na LaFasto, 1989, uk109) ni kipengele cha kipekee cha timu pepe.
translations.reference: The presence of a true “invisible team” (Larson and LaFasto, 1989, p109) is also a unique component of a virtual team.
translations.hypothesis: The existence of a “real” (Larson & LaFasto, 1989, p. 109) invisible team is a unique aspect of virtual teams.

translations.source: “Timu isiyoonekana” ni timu ya usimamizi ambapo kila memba huripoti. Timu isiyoonekana huweka viwango kwa kila memba.
translations.reference: The “invisible team” is the management team to which each of the members report. The invisible team sets the standards for each member.
translations.hypothesis: An "invisible team" is a team of executives to whom each team member reports. The invisible team sets the tone for every team member.

translations.source: Kwa nini shirika lipitie mchakato wa muda mrefu ili kuanzisha shirika la mafunzo? Lengo moja la kuanzisha dhana za shirika la mafunzo katika matendo ni uvumbuzi.
translations.reference: Why would an organization want to go through the time consuming process of establishing a learning organization? One goal for putting organizational learning concepts into practice is innovation.
translations.hypothesis: Why did the startup go through the lengthy process of incorporating a training institute? One of the startup’s goals for incorporating the training institute is innovation.

translations.source: Wakati rasilimali zote zinazopatikana zinatumiwa kwa ufanisi katika idara zenye utendaji za shirika, ubunifu na ustadi unaweza kutokea.
translations.reference: When all available resources are effectively used across the functional departments of an organization, creativity and ingenuity can transpire.
translations.hypothesis: When all resources are efficiently deployed across the organization's functional areas, innovation and excellence can flourish.

translations.source: Kama matokeo, mchakato wa shirika kufanya kazi pamoja kushinda kizuizi unaweza kupelekea mchakato mpya mbunifu wa kuhudumia mahitaji ya wateja.
translations.reference: As a result, the process of an organization working together to overcome an obstacle can lead to a new innovative process to serve the customer's need.
translations.hypothesis: As a result, the process of organizations working together to overcome barriers can lead to new innovations in service delivery to meet customer needs.

translations.source: Kabla ya shirika kuwa bunifu, ni lazima uongozi uunde utamaduni wa ubunifu vilevile maarifa yaliyoshirikishwa na mafunzo ya kishirika.
translations.reference: Before an organization can be innovative, leadership must create a culture of innovation as well as shared knowledge and organizational learning.
translations.hypothesis: Before an organization can innovate, leadership must intentionally develop a culture of innovation as well as knowledge sharing and learning.

translations.source: Angel (2006), anaeleza mbinu ya Msururu kama njia inayotumika kusaidia mashirika kufikia kiwango cha juu cha utenda kazi.
translations.reference: Angel (2006), explains the Continuum approach as a method being used to help organizations reach a higher level of performance.
translations.hypothesis: Angel (2006), explains the Balanced Scorecard as a performance management tool that helps organizations to achieve high performance.

translations.source: Data ya neurobayolojia inatoa ushahidi wa mwili kwa mtazamo wa kinadharia kuhusu uchunguzi wa utambuzi. Kwa hivyo, inapunguza eneo la utafiti na kulifanya liwe maalum zaidi.
translations.reference: Neurobiological data provide physical evidence for a theoretical approach to the investigation of cognition. Therefore it narrows the research area and makes it much more exact.
translations.hypothesis: Neurobiological data provide physiological evidence for theoretical perspectives on cognitive processing. Thus, it reduces the scope of research and makes it more specific.

translations.source: Mshabaha uliopo kati ya patholojia ya ubongo na tabia inaunga mkono wanasayansi katika utafiti wao.
translations.reference: The correlation between brain pathology and behaviour supports scientists in their research.
translations.hypothesis: The correlation between brain pathology and behaviour supported the scientists' hypothesis.

translations.source: Imejulikana kwa muda mrefu kwamba aina tofauti za uharibifu wa ubongo, majeraha, vidonda, na uvimbe huathiri tabia na kusababisha mabadiliko katika baadhi ya kazi za kiakili.
translations.reference: It has been known for a long time that different types of brain damage, traumas, lesions, and tumours affect behaviour and cause changes in some mental functions.
translations.hypothesis: It is well established that different forms of brain damage, injuries, infections and neurodegenerative diseases affect behaviour and result in changes in some aspects of mental functioning.

translations.source: Uibukaji wa teknolojia mpya hutuwezesha kuona na kuchunguza miundo na michakato ya ubongo ambayo haijawahi kuonekana awali.
translations.reference: The rise of new technologies allows us to see and investigate brain structures and processes never seen before.
translations.hypothesis: The emergence of new technologies allows us to visualize and investigate the brain’s structures and processes in unprecedented detail.

translations.source: Hii inatupa habari na nyenzo nyingi za kujenga mifano ya kuiga ambayo hutusaidia kuelewa michakato katika akili zetu.
translations.reference: This provides us with a lot of information and material to build simulation models which help us to understand processes in our mind.
translations.hypothesis: This gives us a lot of information and material to build models that help us to understand processes in our brains.

translations.source: Ingawa Akili Bandia inahusishwa sana na tungo za kisayansi, Akili Bandia huunda sehemu muhimu sana ya tawi la sayansi ya kompyuta, kushughulikia tabia, mafunzo na marekebisho ya akili kwa mashine.
