translations.reference: Although AI has a strong connotation of science fiction, AI forms a very important branch of computer science, dealing with behavior, learning and intelligent adaptation in a machine.
translations.hypothesis: While AI is closely associated with science fiction, AI forms a very real part of computer science, concerned with the design, training and evaluation of computational models of intelligence.

translations.source: Utafiti katika Al unajumuisha kutengeneza mashine za kufanya kazi zinazohitaji tabia za busara kuwa otomatiki.
translations.reference: Research in AI involves making machines to automate tasks that require intelligent behavior.
translations.hypothesis: Research in AI involves developing computing machines that can mimic human intelligence.

translations.source: Mfano ni pamoja na kudhibiti, kupanga na kuratibu, uwezo wa kujibu utambuzi na maswali ya wateja, pamoja na utambuzi wa maandishi, sauti na uso.
translations.reference: Examples include control, planning and scheduling, the ability to answer customer diagnoses and questions, as well as handwriting recognition, voice and face.
translations.hypothesis: The example includes speech, text, and face recognition; automated customer service; and speech and text analysis.

translations.source: Mambo kama hayo yamekuwa taaluma tofauti, zinazotazamia kutoa suluhu kwa shida za maisha.
translations.reference: Such things have become separate disciplines, which focus on providing solutions to real life problems.
translations.hypothesis: Such subjects have become disciplines in their own right, seeking to provide solutions to life's problems.

translations.source: Mfumo wa AI sasa hutumiwa mara nyingi katika nyanja za uchumi, dawa, uhandisi na jeshi, kama ulivyojengwa katika programu kadhaa za kompyuta za nyumbani na michezo ya video.
translations.reference: The AI ​​system is now often used in the fields of economics, medicine, engineering and the military, as has been built in several home computer and video game software applications.
translations.hypothesis: AI systems are now commonplace in commercial, medical, engineering and military applications, as well as in many home appliances and video games.

translations.source: Safari za nje ya shule ni sehemu kubwa ya darasa lolote. Mara nyingi mwalimu hupenda kuwapeleka wanafunzi wake mahali ambapo safari ya basi si chaguo.
translations.reference: Field trips are a large part of any classroom. Quite often a teacher would love to take her students places to which a bus trip is not an option.
translations.hypothesis: Field trips are a big part of any class. Often the teacher likes to take their students somewhere that is not within walking distance.

translations.source: Teknolojia hutoa suluhu kwa njia ya ziara za nyanjani zisizo bayana. Wanafunzi wanaweza kutazama vifaa ghushi katika majumba ya makumbusho, watembelee tangisamaki, au wafurahie sanaa maridadi huku wameketi darasani mwao.
translations.reference: Technology offers the solution with virtual field trips. Students can look at museum artifacts, visit an aquarium, or admire beautiful art while sitting with their class.
translations.hypothesis: The technology provides solutions to bring the world into the classroom without the expense of physical visits. Students can virtually visit a museum, take a walk through a rainforest, or closely examine a painting while sitting in their classroom.

translations.source: Kushiriki pamoja katika safari ya shamba kwa njia bandia pia ni njia nzuri ya kutafakari safari na kushirikisha uzoefu na watakaosafiri siku zijazo.
translations.reference: Sharing a field trip virtually is also a great way to reflect a on a trip and share experiences with future classes.
translations.hypothesis: Sharing your journey through blog posts or social media is a great way to reflect on your experience and inspire others to travel.

translations.source: Kwa mfano, kila mwaka wanafunzi kutoka Shule ya Bennet katika Karolina Kaskazini hubuni tovuti kuhusu safari yao katika Mji Mkuu wa Jimbo, kila mwaka tovuti hiyo hurekebishwa, lakini matoleo ya zamani hubaki mtandaoni kutumika kama kitabu chakavu.
translations.reference: For example, each year students from Bennet School in North Carolina design a website about their trip to the State Capital, each year the website gets remodeled, but old versions are kept online to serve as a scrapbook.
translations.hypothesis: For example, each year students from Bennett College in North Carolina create a website about their spring break trip to the nation's capital, each year the website is updated, but the old versions are preserved online as a historical record.

translations.source: Blogi pia zinaweza kuimarisha uandishi wa mwanafunzi. Huku wanafunzi wakianza tajriba yao ya blogi na matatizo ya sarufi na herufi, uwepo wa hadhira kijumla hubadilisha hilo.
translations.reference: Blogs can also help improve student writing. While students often begin their blog experience with sloppy grammar and spelling, the presence of an audience generally changes that.
translations.hypothesis: Blogs can also improve a student’s writing. With students starting their blogs with all sorts of grammatical and typographical errors, the presence of a general audience changes that.

translations.source: Kwa kuwa wanafunzi ndio hadhira muhimu zaidi, mwandishi wa blogu huanza kujitahidi kuboresha uandishi ili kuzuia kukosolewa.
translations.reference: Since students are often the most critical audience, the blog writer begins to strive to improve writing to avoid criticism.
translations.hypothesis: With students as the primary target, the blogger begins to work on improving his writing to avoid being trolled.

translations.source: Uandishi blogi pia "hulazimisha wanafunzi kuwa wajuzi wa ulimwengu unaowazunguka." Hitaji la kutosheleza ari ya hadhira huwachochea wanafunzi kuwa werevu na wenye kuvutia (Toto, 2004).
translations.reference: Also blogging "forces students to become more savvy about the world around them." The need to feed the interest of the audience inspires students to be clever and interesting (Toto, 2004).
translations.hypothesis: Blogging also "forces students to become aware of the world around them." The need to satisfy an audience encourages students to be creative and original (Toto, 2004).

translations.source: Uandishi blogi ni kifaa kinachochochea ushirikiano, na kuhimiza wanafunzi kupanua usomaji zaidi ya siku ya kawaida ya masomo shuleni.
translations.reference: Blogging is a tool that inspires collaboration, and encourages students to extend learning well beyond the traditional school day.
translations.hypothesis: Blogging is a skill-building tool, and encourages students to expand their reading beyond the textbook and the four walls of the classroom.

translations.source: Utumiaji mwafaka wa blogu “unaweza kuwawezesha wanafunzi kuwa wachambuzi na wa kushutumu zaidi; kupitia kujibu nyenzo za Intaneti kiamilifu, wanafunzi wanaweza kuaini nafasi zao katika muktadha wa maandiko ya wengine vilevile kuelezea mitazamo yao wenyewe kuhusu masuala maalum (Oravec, 2002).
translations.reference: Appropriate use of blogs "can empower students to become more analytical and critical; through actively responding to Internet materials, students can define their positions in the context of others' writings as well as outline their own perspectives on particular issues (Oravec, 2002).
translations.hypothesis: Effective use of blogs can enable students to become more reflective and critical; through active engagement with online material, students can position their own ideas within the context of other published works as well as articulate their own perspectives on specific issues (Oravec, 2002).

translations.source: Ottawa na jij la Kanada linalovutia na la jozilugha, na huwa na msururu wa vyumba vya sanaa na nyumba za maonyesho zinazosheheni historia ya Kanada ya zamani na ya sasa.
translations.reference: Ottawa is Canada's charming, bilingual capital and features an array of art galleries and museums that showcase Canada's past and present.
translations.hypothesis: Ottawa is the capital of Canada and a city of many languages, and it is home to a series of museums and art galleries that explore the history of Canada from ancient to modern times.

translations.source: Mbali zaidi upande wa kusini ni Maporomoko ya Maji ya Niagara na upande wa kaskazini ni kiini cha urembo usiyofichwa cha Muskoka na zaidi.
translations.reference: Farther south is Niagara Falls and the north is home to the untapped natural beauty of the Muskoka and beyond.
translations.hypothesis: Further south are the Niagara Falls and to the north the rugged, unspoiled beauty of Muskoka and beyond.

translations.source: Mambo haya yote na mengi zaidi huonyesha Ontario kama inavyochukuliwa kiasili kama Kikanada na watu wa nje.
translations.reference: All these things and more highlight Ontario as what is considered quintessentially Canadian by outsiders.
translations.hypothesis: All these and more contribute to painting Ontario as the true Canadian mosaic.

translations.source: Maeneo mapana upande wa juu wa kaskazini hayana idadi kubwa ya watu na baadhi yake nyika isiyokuwa na watu.
translations.reference: Large areas further north are quite sparsely populated and some is nearly uninhabited wilderness.
translations.hypothesis: The far north is mostly uninhabited with some desolate, empty landscapes.

translations.source: Kwa ulinganisho wa idadi ya watu unaowaajabisha wengi: kuna Waafrika Wamarekani wengi wanaoishi Marekani kuliko raia wa Kanada.
translations.reference: For a comparison of population that surprises many: There are more African Americans living in the US than there are Canadian citizens.
translations.hypothesis: For the sake of comparison with a population that is more familiar: there are more African Americans living in the United States than there are citizens of Canada.

translations.source: Visiwa vya Afrika Mashariki vimo katika Bahari ya Hindi karibu na pwani ya mashariki ya Afrika.
translations.reference: The East African Islands are in the Indian Ocean off the eastern coast of Africa.
translations.hypothesis: The East African islands are in the Indian Ocean off the eastern coast of Africa.

translations.source: Madagaska ndiyo kubwa tena kwa mbali, na bara lilojisimamia, ikifikia ni suala la wanyamapori.
translations.reference: Madagascar is by far the biggest, and a continent on its own when it comes to wildlife.
translations.hypothesis: Madagascar is the largest and most isolated, a true continent in miniature.

translations.source: Vingi vya visiwa vidogo ni mataifa huru, au vinahusishwa na Ufaransa, na vinajulikana kama vituo vya mapumziko vya pwani.
translations.reference: Most of the smaller islands are independent nations, or associated with France, and known as luxury beach resorts.
translations.hypothesis: Most of the islands are independent nations or associated with France, and are known as French Polynesia.

translations.source: Waarabu pia walileta Uislamu katika maeneo, na iliathiri sana Komoros na Mayote.
translations.reference: The Arabs also brought Islam to the lands, and it took in a big way in the Comoros and Mayotte.
translations.hypothesis: Arabs also brought Islam to the islands, which has greatly influenced the Comoros and Mayotte.

translations.source: Ushawishi wa Ulaya na ukoloni ulianza katika karne ya 15, wakati mvumbuzi wa Ureno Vasco da Gama alipopata njia Cape kutoka Ulaya kwenda India.
translations.reference: European influence and colonialism began in the 15th century, as Portuguese explorer Vasco da Gama found the Cape Route from Europe to India.
translations.hypothesis: European influence and colonialism began in the 15th century, when the Portuguese explorer Vasco da Gama found a sea route from Europe to India around the Cape of Good Hope.

translations.source: Mkoa huo umefungwa na Saheli katika upande wa kaskazini, na umefungwa na Bahari ya Atlantiki katika upande wa kusini na magharibi.
translations.reference: In the north the region is bounded by the Sahel, and in the south and west by the Atlantic Ocean.
translations.hypothesis: The region is closed to the north by the Sahel, and to the south and west by the Atlantic Ocean.

translations.source: Wanawake: inapendekezwa kuwa wasafiri wowote wa kike waseme kwamba wameolewa, licha ya hali yao halisi ya ndoa.
translations.reference: Women: It is recommended that any women travellers say that they are married, regardless of actual marital status.
translations.hypothesis: Women: It is advised that any female travellers state they are married, regardless of their actual marital status.

translations.source: Ni muhimu pia kuvalia pete (wala si inayoonekana ghali sana).
translations.reference: It is helpful to also wear a ring (just not one that looks too expensive.
translations.hypothesis: It is also necessary to wear a hat (not necessarily an expensive one).

translations.source: Wanawake wanapaswa kutambua kuwa tofauti za kitamaduni zinaweza kusababisha kile wangechukulia kama unyanyasaji na ni sio jambo lisilo la kawaida kufuatwa, kunyakuliwa kwa mkono, nk.
translations.reference: Women should realize that cultural differences may result in what they would consider harassment and it is not uncommon to be followed, grabbed by the arm, etc.
translations.hypothesis: Women should be aware that cultural differences can lead to what they perceive as harassment and unwanted attention, and it is not uncommon to be followed, stared at, or offered drinks.

translations.source: Kuwa imara katika kuwakatalia watu, na usiogope kushikilia msimamo wako (tofauti za kitamaduni au la, hazilifanyi kuwa sawa!).
translations.reference: Be firm in turning down men, and don't be afraid to stand your ground (cultural differences or not, it doesn't make it ok!).
translations.hypothesis: Be confident in saying no, and don't be afraid to stand your ground (cultural differences or not, they don't make it right!).

translations.source: Jiji la sasa la Kasablanka lilianzishwa na wavuvi wa Berber katika karne ya 10 kabla ya Masihi, na lilitumiwa na Wafoenisi, Warumi, na Wamerenidi kama bandari ya mikakati iliyojulikana kama Anfa.
translations.reference: The modern city of Casablanca was founded by Berber fishermen in the 10th century BCE, and was used by the Phoenicians, Romans, and the Merenids as a strategic port called Anfa.
translations.hypothesis: The present city of Casablanca was founded by Berbers fishermen in the 10th century BC, and was used by the Phoenicians, Romans, and Merinids as a strategic port known as Anfa.

translations.source: Wareno waliiharibu na kuijenga tena chini ya jina Casa Branca, lakini wakaiacha baada ya tetemeko la ardhi mnamo 1755.
translations.reference: The Portuguese destroyed it and rebuilt it under the name Casa Branca, only to abandon it after an earthquake in 1755.
translations.hypothesis: The Moors destroyed it and the Christians rebuilt it under the name of Casa Branca, but they abandoned it after the earthquake of 1755.

translations.source: Sultani wa Moroko alijenga mji upya kama Daru I-Badya na ukapewa jina la Kasablanka na wafanyabiashara wa Kihispani ambao walianzisha vituo vya biashara huko.
translations.reference: The Moroccan sultan rebuilt the city as Daru l-Badya and it was given the name Casablanca by Spanish traders who established trading bases there.
translations.hypothesis: The Moroccan sultan built a new city called Dar al-Badia and the Spanish merchants renamed it Casablanca after they established a trading post there.

translations.source: Kasablanka ni mojawapo ya mahali pa kuvutia kidogo zaidi kununua vitu katika Moroko yote.
translations.reference: Casablanca is one of the least interesting places to shop in all of Morocco.
translations.hypothesis: Casablanca is one of the best places to buy souvenirs in all of Morocco.

translations.source: Karibu na Madina ya zamani ni rahisi kupata sehemu zinazouza bidhaa za kitamaduni za Moroko, kama vile tagines, ufinyanzi, bidhaa za ngozi, ndoano, na wigo mzima wa geegaws, lakini yote ni kwa ajili ya watalii.
translations.reference: Around the old Medina it's easy to find places selling traditional Moroccan goods, such as tagines, pottery, leather goods, hookahs, and a whole spectrum of geegaws, but it's all for the tourists.
translations.hypothesis: Around the Medina are a number of shops selling traditional Moroccan goods, such as tagines, babouches, leather goods, kaftans, and a wide array of carpets, but geared mostly towards tourists.

translations.source: Goma ni mji wa kitalii wa Jamburi ya Kidemokrasia ya Congo ulioko mashariki uliokithiri karibu na Rwanda.
translations.reference: Goma is a tourist city of the Democratic Republic of Congo in the extreme east near Rwanda.
translations.hypothesis: Goma is a city in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, close to the Rwandan border.

translations.source: Mnamo 2002, Goma iliharibiwa na lava kutoka kwa volkano ya Nyiragongo iliyofunika mingi ya mitaa ya mji, hususan katikati ya mji.
translations.reference: In 2002 Goma was destroyed by lava from the Nyiragongo volcano which buried most of the town’s streets, particularly the town centre.
translations.hypothesis: In 2002, Goma was devastated by lava from the nearby Nyiragongo volcano, which buried much of the city's southern districts, including the city center.

translations.source: Japo kwa kiwango kizuri Goma ni salama, ziara zozote nje ya Goma zinapaswa kuchunguzwa ili kufahamu hali ya mapigano yanayoendelea katika jimbo la Kaskazini mwa Kivu.
translations.reference: While Goma is reasonably safe, any visits outside of Goma should be researched to understand the state of the fighting that persists in the North Kivu province.
translations.hypothesis: While Goma town is relatively secure, any travel outside of Goma should be carefully considered in light of the ongoing conflict in North Kivu.

translations.source: Jiji hilo pia ndio msingi wa kukwea volkano ya Nyiragongo pamoja na njia rahisi kabisa za kufuatilia Gorilla wa Milimani barani Afrika.
translations.reference: The city is also the base to climb the Nyiragongo volcano along with some of the cheapest Mountain Gorilla tracking in Africa.
translations.hypothesis: The city is also a base for climbing the volcanoes of Virunga and for tracking mountain gorillas in Rwanda.

translations.source: Unaweza kutumia boda-boda (teksi ya pikipiki) kuzunguka Goma. Nauli ya kawaida kwa wenyeji ni Franki 500 za Kongo kwa safari fupi.
translations.reference: You can use boda-boda (motorcycle taxi) to get around Goma. The normal (local) price is ~500 Congolese Francs for the short ride.
translations.hypothesis: You can use moto-taxis (motorbike taxis) to get around Goma. The normal rate for a local is 500 Congolese francs for a short ride.

translations.source: Pamoja na kutofikika kwake kwa wastani, “Timbuktu” imekuja kutumika kama sitiari ya nchi za kigeni zilizo mbali sana.
translations.reference: Combined with its relative inaccessibility, "Timbuktu" has come to be used as a metaphor for exotic, distant lands.
translations.hypothesis: As a result of its inaccessibility, "Timbuktu" has come to symbolize a faraway place.

translations.source: Leo hii, Timbuktu ni mji maskini, ingawa sifa zake huufanya kivutio cha watalii, na pia kuna uwanja wa ndege.
translations.reference: Today, Timbuktu is an impoverished town, although its reputation makes it a tourist attraction, and it has an airport.
translations.hypothesis: Today, Timbuktu is a poor town, though its fame makes it a tourist attraction, and it has an airport.

translations.source: Mnamo 1990, uliongezwa katika orodha ya maeneo ya urithi duniani yaliyo hatarini, kwa sababu ya tishio la mchanga wa jangwani.
translations.reference: In 1990, it was added to the list of world heritage sites in danger, due to the threat of desert sands.
translations.hypothesis: In 1990, it was added to the List of World Heritage in Danger, due to the threat of desertification.

translations.source: Ilikuwa mojawapo ya vituo vikuu wakati wa Maajabu ya Dunia ya Kiafrika spesheli ya PBS ya Henry Louis Gates..
translations.reference: It was one of the major stops during Henry Louis Gates' PBS special Wonders of the African World.
translations.hypothesis: It was one of the featured locations in the PBS African American Lives special by Henry Louis Gates.

translations.source: Jiji hilo liko katika ulinganishi mgumu na miji mingine ya nchi, kwa sababu lina wangavu zaidi wa Kiarabu kuliko ule wa Kiafrika.
translations.reference: The city is in stark contrast to the rest of the country's cities, because it has more of an Arabic flair than of an African.
translations.hypothesis: The city is in a difficult position compared to other cities in the country, because it has more Arab than African roots.

translations.source: Mbuga ya Kitaifa ya Kruger (KNP) iko kaskazini-mashariki mwa Afrika Kusini na inapakana na Msumbiji upande wa mashariki, Zimbabwe upande wa kaskazini, na Mto wa Mamba upande wa kusini.
translations.reference: The Kruger National Park (KNP) lies in the north-east of South Africa and runs along the border of Mozambique in the east, Zimbabwe in the north, and the southern border is the Crocodile River.
translations.hypothesis: Kruger National Park (KNP) is in the northeast of South Africa and borders Mozambique to the east, Zimbabwe to the north, and Eswatini to the south.

translations.source: Mbuga hiyo inachukua kilomita 19,500 mraba na imegawanywa katika maeneo 14 tofauti ya ekolojia , kila moja ikisaidia wanyama tofauti wa porini.
translations.reference: The park covers 19,500 km² and is divided in 14 different ecozones, each supporting different wildlife.
translations.hypothesis: The park covers 19,500 square kilometres and is divided into 14 different ecological zones, each supporting a variety of wildlife.

translations.source: Ni mojawapo ya vivutio vya Afrika Kusini na huzingatiwa kuwa kuu kati ya Mbuga za Kitaifa za Afrika Kusini (SANParks).
translations.reference: It is one of the main attractions of South Africa and it is considered the flagship of South African National Parks (SANParks).
translations.hypothesis: It is one of South Africa's most popular tourist attractions and is considered to be one of the greatest of South Africa's National Parks (SANParks).

translations.source: Kama ilivyo na Mbuga zote za Wanyama za Kitaifa Kusini mwa Afrika, kuna malipo ya kila siku ya uhifadhi na kiingilio.
translations.reference: As with all South African National Parks, there are daily conservation and entry fees for the park.
translations.hypothesis: Like all other National Parks in Southern Africa, there are daily conservation and entrance fees.

translations.source: Inaweza kuwa manufaa kwa mtu kununua Kadi Mbugani, ambayo hutoa kiingilio kwa baadhi ya mbuga za Afrika Kusini au Mbuga zote za Kitaifa za Afrika Kusini.
translations.reference: It may also be beneficial for one to buy a Wild Card, which provides entry to either selections of parks in South Africa or all of the South African National Parks.
translations.hypothesis: It may be advantageous for a person to buy a Wild Card, which provides entry to some or all of the National Parks of South Africa.

translations.source: Kisiwa cha Hong Kong hulipatia eneo la Hong Kong jina lake na ni mahali ambapo watalii wengi huangazia sana.
translations.reference: Hong Kong Island gives the territory of Hong Kong its name and is the place that many tourists regard as the main focus.
translations.hypothesis: Hong Kong Island gives its name to the Hong Kong region and is where most of the tourist action takes place.

translations.source: Msururu wa majengo yanayojenga wingu la Hong Kong umeoanishwa na chati ya baa inayopendeza na ambayo yamkini imeundwa kwa uwepo wa maji ya Bandari ya Viktoria.
translations.reference: The parade of buildings that make the Hong Kong skyline has been likened to a glittering bar chart that is made apparent by the presence of the waters of Victoria Harbour.
translations.hypothesis: The series of buildings that make up Hong Kong's skyline are matched by the harbour's lovely and functional piers.

translations.source: Ili kujionea Hong Kong vizuri zaidi, ondoka kiswani kisha uelekee upande wa mwambao wa Kowloon ulio mkabala.
translations.reference: To get the best views of Hong Kong, leave the island and head for the Kowloon waterfront opposite.
translations.hypothesis: For a better view of Hong Kong, leave the harbour and head towards Kowloon's waterfront.

translations.source: Mengi ya maendeleo ya mji ya Visiwa vya Hong Kong yamesongamana katika ardhi iliyorejeshwa katika ufuo wa kaskazini.
translations.reference: The great majority of Hong Kong Island's urban development is densely packed on reclaimed land along the northern shore.
translations.hypothesis: Much of Hong Kong's urban development is constrained by steep terrain, and is focused on a relatively small amount of reclaimed land along the northern coast.

translations.source: Hapa ndipo mahali wakoloni wa Kiingereza walichukulia kuwa pao na kwa hivyo kama unatafuta ushahidi wa zama za kikoloni wa eneo, hapa ni mahali pazuri pa kuanza.
translations.reference: This is the place the British colonisers took as their own and so if you are looking for evidence of the territory's colonial past, this is a good place to start.
translations.hypothesis: This is where the British colonials took their leisure and so if you are looking for a reminder of the colonial past this is a good place to start.

translations.source: Sandabani ndizo mikoko mikubwa zaidi ya ukanda wa pwani duniani, yenye urefu wa kilomita 80 (maili 50) ndani ya Bangladeshi na bara ya Indi kutoka pwani.
translations.reference: The Sundarbans are the largest littoral mangrove belt in the world, stretching 80 km (50 mi) into the Bangladeshi and Indian hinterland from the coast.
translations.hypothesis: The Sundarbans are the largest mangrove forest in the world, extending about 80 km (50 mi) inland from the Bay of Bengal in Bangladesh and India.

translations.source: Sandarbans imetangazwa kuwa Eneo la Urithi wa Dunia la UNESCO. Sehemu ya msitu ndani ya wilaya ya India inaitwa Mbuga ya Kitaifa ya Sandarbans.
translations.reference: The Sundarbans has been declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The part of the forest within Indian territory is called Sundarbans National Park.
translations.hypothesis: The Sundarbans is declared as a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The forested area within the Indian part of the delta is known as the Sundarbans National Park.

translations.source: Misitu hiyo si mikoko ya mabwawa tu - inajumuisha baadhi ya misitu mikuu iliyosalia ambayo kwa wakati mmoja ilikuwa imefunikwa na tambarare ya Gaengitiki.
translations.reference: The forests aren't just mangrove swamps though — they include some of the last remaining stands of the mighty jungles which once covered the Gangetic plain.
translations.hypothesis: The forest is not just mangroves - it includes some of the last remaining lowland rainforests that once covered the Gangetic plain.

translations.source: Sundarban zimo katika eneo la kilomita 3,850 mraba, ambapo theluthi moja imefunikwa kwa maji/kinamasi.
translations.reference: The Sundarbans cover an area of 3,850 km², of which about one-third is covered in water/marsh areas.
translations.hypothesis: The Sundarbans lie in the delta of the Ganges, Brahmaputra and Meghna rivers, in an area of 3,850 square miles (6,197 km2), of which about one-third is flooded.

translations.source: Tangu mwaka wa 1966 Sandabani zimekuwa mbuga za wanyama pori, na inakadiriwa kuwa sasa kuna chui 400 wa Royal Bengal na kulungu takribani 30,000 katika eneo hilo.
translations.reference: Since 1966 the Sundarbans have been a wildlife sanctuary, and it is estimated that there are now 400 Royal Bengal tigers and about 30,000 spotted deer in the area.
translations.hypothesis: Since 1966 the Sundarbans has been a wildlife reserve, and now is home to an estimated 400 Royal Bengal tigers and 30,000 spotted deer.

translations.source: Mabasi huondoka kituo cha basi cha kati ya mawilaya (upande mwingine wa mto) siku nzima, ingawa mengi, haswa yale yanaoelekea mashariki na Jakar / Bumthang huondoka kati ya saa 6 na dakika 30 na saa 7 na dakika 30.
translations.reference: Buses depart the inter-district bus station (across the river) throughout the day, though most, especially those heading to the east and Jakar/Bumthang leave between 06:30 and 07:30.
translations.hypothesis: Buses depart from the central bus station (on the other side of the river) throughout the day, though most, especially those heading east towards Jakar/Bumthang, leave between 6:30 and 7:30.

translations.source: Kwa kuwa mara nyingi mabasi yanayounganisha wilaya huwa yamejaa, inashauriwa kununua tikiti siku kadhaa mapema.
translations.reference: As the inter-district buses are often full, it is advisable to purchase a ticket a few days in advance.
translations.hypothesis: Since the inter-regional buses are often full, it is recommended to book your seat a few days in advance.

translations.source: Wilaya nyingi huhudumiwa na Mabasi madogo ya Pwani ya Kijapani, ambayo ni ya starehe na imara.
translations.reference: Most districts are served by small Japanese Coaster Buses, which are comfortable and sturdy.
translations.hypothesis: Most districts are served by Japan's famous Shinkansen (bullet) trains, which are both punctual and comfortable.

translations.source: Teksi zilizoshirikiwa ni aina haraka na starehe ya kusafiri katika maeneo ya karibu, kama vile Paro (Nu 150) na Punakha (Nu 200).
translations.reference: Shared taxis are a quick and comfortable means to travel to nearby places, such as Paro (Nu 150) and Punakha (Nu 200).
translations.hypothesis: Shared taxis are a fast and convenient way to get around to nearby towns, such as Paro (Nu 150) and Punakha (Nu 200).

translations.source: Daraja la Mto wa Oyapock ni daraja lililokaa kwa waya. Linatoka Mto Oyapock na kuunganisha miji ya Oiapoque nchini Brazil na Saint-Georges de I’Oyapock iliyo Guiana ya Ufaransa.
translations.reference: The Oyapock River Bridge is a cable-stayed bridge. It spans the Oyapock River to link the cities of Oiapoque in Brazil and Saint-Georges de l'Oyapock in French Guiana.
translations.hypothesis: The Oyapock River Bridge is a cable-stayed bridge. It spans the Oyapock River and connects the town of Oiapoque in Brazil with Saint-Georges-de-l'Oyapock in French Guiana.

translations.source: Minara hiyo miwili inainuka hadi urefu wa mita 83, ina urefu wa mita 378 na ina leni mbili zenye upana wa mita 3.50.
translations.reference: The two towers rise to a height of 83 meters, it's 378 meters long and it has two lanes of 3.50 m wide.
translations.hypothesis: The two towers rise to a height of 83 meters, have a wingspan of 378 meters and two decks with a 3.50-meter-wide pedestrian lane.

translations.source: Kibali cha wima chini ya daraja ni mita 15. Ujenzi ulikamilika mnamo Agosti 2011, haikufunguliwa kwa trafiki hadi Machi 2017.
translations.reference: The vertical clearance under the bridge is 15 meters. Construction was completed in August 2011, it didn't open to traffic until March 2017.
translations.hypothesis: The vertical clearance below the bridge is 15 metres. Construction was completed in August 2011, but it wasn't opened to traffic until March 2017.

translations.source: Daraja limeratibiwa kufanya kazi kikamilifu mnamo Septemba 2017, wakati vituo vya ukaguzi wa forodha vya Kibrazili vinatarajiwa kukamilishwa.
translations.reference: The bridge is scheduled to be fully operational in September 2017, when the Brazilian customs checkpoints are expected to be finished.
translations.hypothesis: The bridge is set to open fully in September 2017, when customs inspection facilities on the Brazilian side are due to be completed.

translations.source: Waguaraní walikuwa kundi lenye maana zaidi ambalo linakaa kule ambako sasa kunaitwa Paragwai Mashariki, wakiishi kama wawindaji wahamahama ambao pia walikuwa wakilima mazao ya kujikimu.
translations.reference: The Guaraní were the most significant indigenous group inhabiting what is now Eastern Paraguay, living as semi-nomadic hunters who also practised subsistence agriculture.
translations.hypothesis: The Guaraní were the most significant group living there, in what is now eastern Paraguay, living as nomadic hunter-gatherers who also practiced some agriculture to sustain themselves.

translations.source: Eneo la Chako lilikuwa nyumbani mwa vikundi vingine vya kienyeji kama vile Guaycurú na Payaguá, ambao waliishi kwa uwindaji, ukusanyaji na uvuvi.
translations.reference: The Chaco region was home to other groups of indigenous tribes such as the Guaycurú and Payaguá, who survived by hunting, gathering and fishing.
translations.hypothesis: The Chaco region was home to other indigenous groups like the Guaycurú and Payaguá, who lived off the land by hunting, gathering, and fishing.

translations.source: Katika karne ya 16, Parague, iliyojulikana awali kama "Jitu la Mkoa wa Indi", ilizaliwa kufuatia makabiliano kati ya washindi wa Kihispania na makundi asilia.
translations.reference: In the 16th century Paraguay, formerly called "The Giant Province of the Indies", was born as a result of the encounter of Spanish conquerors with the native indigenous groups.
translations.hypothesis: In the 16th century, Paraguay, previously known as the "Province of the Indies", was born following a clash between Spanish conquerors and the native groups.

translations.source: Wahispania walianza kipindi cha ukoloni ambacho kilidumu kwa karne tatu.
translations.reference: The Spaniards started the colonization period which lasted for three centuries.
translations.hypothesis: The Spanish began a three-century-long colonial period.

translations.source: Tangu msingi wa Asuncion mnamo 1537, Paraguai imeweza kudumisha sifa na utambulisho wake wa kienyeji.
translations.reference: Since the foundation of Asunción in 1537, Paraguay has managed to keep a lot of its indigenous character and identity.
translations.hypothesis: Since its founding as Asuncion in 1537, Paraguay has managed to maintain its indigenous character and identity.

translations.source: Ajentina inajulikana vizuri kwa kuwa na mojawapo ya timu na wachezaji bora wa polo ulimweguni.
translations.reference: Argentina is well known for having one of the best polo teams and players in the world.
translations.hypothesis: Argentina is well known for having one of the best polo teams and players in the world.

translations.source: Mchuano mkubwa zaidi wa mwaka utafanyika mnamo Desemba kwenye nyanja za polo katika Las Kanitas.
translations.reference: The largest tournament of the year takes place in December at the polo fields in Las Cañitas.
translations.hypothesis: The biggest event of the year will be held in December at the polo fields in Las Canitas.

translations.source: Michuano na mechi ndogo zinaweza pia kuonekana kutoka hapa katika nyakati nyingine za mwaka.
translations.reference: Smaller tournaments and matches can also be seen here at other times of the year.
translations.hypothesis: Races and regattas can also be seen from here at other times of the year.

translations.source: Kwa habari kuhusu michuano na mahali pa kununua tikiti za mechi za polo, angalia Asociacion Argentina de Polo.
translations.reference: For news on tournaments and where to buy tickets for polo matches, check Asociacion Argentina de Polo.
translations.hypothesis: For information on the tournament and where to buy tickets to the polo matches, visit the Asociacion Argentina de Polo website.

translations.source: Sarafu rasmi ya Falkilandi ni pauni ya Falkilandi (FKP) ambayo thamani yake inakadiriwa kuwa sawa na ile pauni moja ya Uingereza (GBP).
translations.reference: The official Falklands currency is the Falkland pound (FKP) whose value is set equivalent to that of one British pound (GBP).
translations.hypothesis: The official currency of the Falkland Islands is the Falkland Pound (FKP) which is nominally equal in value to the one British pound (GBP).

translations.source: Pesa zinaweza kubadilishwa katika benki ya pekee visiwani ambayo inapatikana Stanley mkabala na duka la FIC West.
translations.reference: Money can be exchanged at the only bank in the islands which is located in Stanley across from the FIC West store.
translations.hypothesis: Money can be exchanged at the island's only bank, located opposite the Stanley FIC Post Office.

translations.source: Kwa jumla pauni za Uingereza zitakubaliwa mahali popote katika visiwa, na ndani ya Stanley kadi za mikopo na dola za Marekani pia hukubaliwa mara nyingi.
translations.reference: British pounds will generally be accepted anywhere in the islands and within Stanley credit cards and United States dollars are also often accepted.
translations.hypothesis: British pounds are widely accepted throughout the islands, and in Stanley credit cards and US dollars are also often accepted.

translations.source: Katika visiwa vya nje kadi za mkopo huenda zisikubalike, ingawa pesa za Uingereza na Amerika zinaweza kuchukuliwa; angalia na wamiliki mapema ili kujua ni njia gani ya malipo inayokubalika.
translations.reference: On the outlying islands credit cards will probably not be accepted, although British and United States currency may be taken; check with the owners in advance to determine what is an acceptable payment method.
translations.hypothesis: In the Outer Hebrides credit cards are unlikely to be accepted, although UK and US dollars are sometimes taken; check with your hosts in advance to find out what payment methods they accept.

translations.source: Haiwezekani kubadilishana sarafu ya Falkland nje ya visiwa, kwa hivyo badilisha pesa kabla ya kuondoka kwenye visiwa.
translations.reference: It is nearly impossible to exchange Falklands currency outside of the islands, so exchange money prior to leaving the islands.
translations.hypothesis: It is not possible to exchange currency for Falkland Pounds off-island, so exchange money for Pounds before leaving the islands.

translations.source: Kwa kuwa Montevideo imo kusini mwa Ikweta, huko huwa ni msimu wa kiangazi wakati Nyanda ya Kaskazini ni baridi na kinyume chake.
translations.reference: Since Montevideo is south of the Equator, it is summer there when it's winter in the Northern Hemisphere and vice versa.
translations.hypothesis: Since Montevideo is in the Southern Hemisphere, summer there is in December, when the Northern Hemisphere is in winter and vice versa.

translations.source: Montevideo iko upande wa sabutropiki; katika miezi ya kiangazi, hali ya joto zaidi ya +30ºC ni hali ya kawaida.
translations.reference: Montevideo is in the subtropics; in the summer months, temperatures above +30°C are common.
translations.hypothesis: Montevideo is subtropical; in summer the temperature is usually above +30ºC.

translations.source: Msimu wa baridi unaweza kuwa baridi kidanganyifu: kadiri ya joto kwa mara chache sana huenda chini ya kiwango cha kugandisha, lakini upepo na unyevu huchanganyika na kufanya kuwe na baridi zaidi kuliko ile ambayo kipimajoto kinasema.
translations.reference: The winter can be deceptively chilly: temperatures rarely go below freezing, but the wind and humidity combine to make it feel colder than what the thermometer says.
translations.hypothesis: Winter can be a deceptive season: the temperature is seldom far below the freezing point, but the wind and the moisture combine to make it feel much colder than the thermometer indicates.

translations.source: Hakuna vipindi maalum vya “mvua” au “ukavu”: kiwango cha mvua hubaki takribani sawa mwaka mzima.
translations.reference: There are no particular "rainy" and "dry" seasons: the amount of rain stays roughly the same throughout the year.
translations.hypothesis: There are no rainy or dry seasons: the rainfall is fairly constant throughout the year.

translations.source: Ingawa wanyama wengi mbugani wamezoea kuwaona wanadamu, kwa vyovyote wanyapori ni wa mwituni, wala hawastahili kulishwa au kusumbuliwa.
translations.reference: Though many of the animals in the park are used to seeing humans, the wildlife is nonetheless wild and should not be fed or disturbed.
translations.hypothesis: While many animals in the park are used to seeing humans, they are still wild animals and should not be fed or bothered.

translations.source: Kwa mujibu wa usimamizi wa mbuga, kaa walau yadi/mita 100 mbali na dubu na mbwa mwitu na yadi/mita 25 kutoka kwa wanyama mwitu wengine wote!
translations.reference: According to park authorities, stay at least 100 yards/meters away from bears and wolves and 25 yards/meters from all other wild animals!
translations.hypothesis: According to park management, stay at least 100 yards (91 m) away from bears and wolves and 25 yards (23 m) from all other wildlife!

translations.source: Haijalishi jinsi watulivu wanavyokaa, baisani, elki, kongoni, dubu, na karibu wanyama wote wakubwa wanaweza kushambulia.
translations.reference: No matter how docile they may look, bison, elk, moose, bears, and nearly all large animals can attack.
translations.hypothesis: Regardless of how docile they may seem, bears, elk, moose, bison, and even deer can be unpredictable and aggressive.

translations.source: Kila mwaka, dazeni za wageni huumia kwa sababu hawakuzingatia umbali unaofaa. Wanyama hawa ni wakubwa, wa mwitu, na uwezekano wa kuwa hatari, kwa hivyo wape nafasi yao.
translations.reference: Each year, dozens of visitors are injured because they didn't keep a proper distance. These animals are large, wild, and potentially dangerous, so give them their space.
translations.hypothesis: Every year, dozens of tourists get hurt because they didn't keep a safe distance. These are large, wild, and potentially dangerous animals, so give them their space.

translations.source: Kwa kuongezea, fahamu kuwa harufu huwavutia dubu na wanyama wengine mwitu, kwa hivyo epuka kubeba au kupika vyakula vyenye harufu na utunze usafi kwenye kambi.
translations.reference: In addition, be aware that odors attract bears and other wildlife, so avoid carrying or cooking odorous foods and keep a clean camp.
translations.hypothesis: Also, be aware that smells attract bears and other wildlife, so avoid bringing or cooking smelly foods and keep a clean campsite.

translations.source: Apia ni mji mkuu wa Samoa. Mji huo uko kwenye kisiwa cha Upolu na lina watu chini ya 40,000.
translations.reference: Apia is the capital of Samoa. The town is on the island of Upolu and has a population of just under 40,000.
translations.hypothesis: Apia is the capital city of Samoa. The city is on the island of Upolu and has a population of under 40,000.

translations.source: Apia ilianzishwa miaka ya 1850 na imekuwa mji mkuu rasmi wa Samoa tangu 1959.
translations.reference: Apia was founded in the 1850s and has been the official capital of Samoa since 1959.
translations.hypothesis: Apia was founded in the 1850s and has been the official capital of Samoa since 1959.

translations.source: Bandari ilikuwa sehemu ya kutokabiliana maarufu kwa nevi mnamo 1889 wakati meli saba kutoka Ujerumani, Marekani na Uingereza zilikataa kuondoka kwenye bandari.
translations.reference: The harbor was the site of an infamous naval standoff in 1889 when seven ships from Germany, the US, and Britain refused to leave the harbor.
translations.hypothesis: The port was the focal point of a famous confrontation in 1889 when seven ships from Germany, the United States, and Great Britain refused to leave the port.

translations.source: Meli zote zilizamishwa, isipokuwa meli moja ya Uingereza. Karibu maisha 200 ya Wamarekani na Wajerumani yalipotea.
translations.reference: All the ships were sunk, except for one British cruiser. Nearly 200 American and German lives were lost.
translations.hypothesis: All but one of the German ships were sunk, the exception being the Deutschland. About 200 American and German lives were lost.

translations.source: Wakati wa mapambano ya uhuru yaliyoandaliwa na harakati ya Mau, mkutano wa amani mjini ulisababisha mauaji ya chifu mkuu Tupua Tamasese Lealofi III.
translations.reference: During the struggle for independence organised by the Mau movement, a peaceful gathering in the town resulted in the killing of the paramount chief Tupua Tamasese Lealofi III.
translations.hypothesis: During the armed struggle for independence led by the Mau Mau movement, a peaceful protest in the city led to the death of chief Kamau Ndung'u.

translations.source: Kuna fukwe nyingi, kutokana na kukaliwa magamaga kwa kwa bandari mbili na Auckland. Maarufu zaidi ziko katika sehemu tatu.
translations.reference: There are many beaches, due to Auckland's straddling of two harbours. The most popular ones are in three areas.
translations.hypothesis: There are many beaches, thanks to the isthmus between two harbours and Auckland's volcanic landscape. The most popular are located in the three harbours.

translations.source: Fukwe za pwani ya Kaskazini (katika wilaya ya Kaskazini mwa Bandari) ziko kwenye Bahari ya Pasifiki na zinyooka kutoka Long Bay kaskazini hadi Devonport kusini.
translations.reference: North Shore beaches (in North Harbour district) are on the Pacific Ocean and stretch from Long Bay in the north to Devonport in the south.
translations.hypothesis: The North Shore beaches (in the North Shore region of Auckland) face the Pacific Ocean and stretch from Long Bay in the north to Devonport in the south.

translations.source: Karibu fukwe zote ni za mchanga na uogeleaji salama na nyingi yake huwa na kivuli chini ya miti ya pohutukawa.
translations.reference: They are almost all sandy beaches with safe swimming, and most have shade provided by pohutukawa trees.
translations.hypothesis: Most of the beaches are sandy and safe for swimming and many of them are backed by Pohutukawa trees providing shade.

translations.source: Pwani za Tamaki Drive ziko katika Bandari ya Waitemata, kwenye maeneo ya kifahari ya Mission Bay na St. Heliers katika Auckland ya Kati.
translations.reference: Tamaki Drive beaches are on the Waitemata Harbour, in the upmarket suburbs of Mission Bay and St Heliers in Central Auckland.
translations.hypothesis: The beaches along Tamaki Drive are located in the Waitemata Harbour, on the exclusive bays of Mission Bay and St Heliers in Central Auckland.

translations.source: Hizi ni pwani za kifamilia ambazo wakati mwingine hujaa watu, zilizo na masafa ya maduka katika ufuo. Uogeleaji ni salama.
translations.reference: These are sometimes-crowded family beaches with a good range of shops lining the shore. Swimming is safe.
translations.hypothesis: These are family beaches that can get crowded, with a range of shops and restaurants along the beachfront. Swimming is safe.

translations.source: Bia kuu katika eneo ni ‘Number One’, sio bia tata, ila ni zuri na hufariji. Hio bia nyingine ya mtaa huitwa ‘Manta’.
translations.reference: The main local beer is 'Number One', it is not a complex beer, but pleasant and refreshing. The other local beer is called "Manta".
translations.hypothesis: The main beer around is "Number One", not a bad lager, though a bit watery. Another local beer is called "Manta".

translations.source: Kuna aina nyingi za mvinyo wa Kifaransa inavyopatikana, lakini mvinyo wa New Zealand na Australia waweza safiri bora.
translations.reference: There are many French wines to be had, but the New Zealand and Australian wines might travel better.
translations.hypothesis: There are many different kinds of French wines available, but the New Zealand and Australian wines may travel better.

translations.source: Maji ya ndani ya bomba ni salama kabisa kwa kunywa, lakini maji ya chupa ni rahisi kupata iwapo una hofu.
translations.reference: The local tap water is perfectly safe to drink, but bottled water is easy to find if you are fearful.
translations.hypothesis: Tap water is generally safe to drink, but bottled water is readily available if you are concerned.

translations.source: Kwa Waaustralia, wazo la kahawa ‘nyeupe’ ni la kigeni. Nyeusi fupi ni ’espresso’, cappuccino inakuja imerundikwa zaidi na malai (si povu) na chai inaandaliwa bila maziwa.
translations.reference: For Australians, the idea of 'flat white' coffee is foreign. A short black is 'espresso', cappuccino comes heaped high with cream (not froth), and tea is served without milk.
translations.hypothesis: For Australians, the concept of a 'white' coffee is a foreign one. Short blacks are 'espresso', cappuccinos come with extra foamed milk (not froth) and tea is usually served without milk.

translations.source: Kinywaji moto cha chokoleti kinafikia viwango vya Ubelgiji. Sharubati za matunda ni bei ghali lakini ni bora.
translations.reference: The hot chocolate is up to Belgian standards. Fruit juices are pricey but excellent.
translations.hypothesis: Hot chocolate drinks reach Belgian standards. Fruit juices are a bit more expensive but of good quality.

translations.source: Safari nyingi kwenye mwamba hufanywa mwaka mzima, na majeraha kutokana na sababu yoyote baina ya hizi katika mwamba ni nadra.
translations.reference: Many trips to the reef are made all year around, and injuries due to any of these causes on the reef are rare.
translations.hypothesis: Most rock climbing is done year-round, and injuries from any cause other than falls are rare.

translations.source: Bado, chukua ushauri kutoka kwa mamlaka, utii ishara zote, na umakinikie maonyo ya usalama.
translations.reference: Still, take advice from authorities, obey all signs, and pay close attention to safety warnings.
translations.hypothesis: Still, take advice from authorities, obey all signs, and pay attention to safety warnings.

translations.source: Viwavi wa baharini hutokea karibu na pwani na karibu na midomo ya mto kuanzia Oktoba hadi Aprili kaskazini mwa 1770. Wakati mwingine huenda wakapatikana nje ya nyakati hizi.
translations.reference: Box jellyfish occur near beaches and near river estuaries from October to April north of 1770. They can occasionally be found outside these times.
translations.hypothesis: Sea turtles nest on beaches and near river mouths from October to April in the north of 1770. They are sometimes seen outside these seasons.

translations.source: Papa wapo, ingawa ni nadra kwao kuwashambulia binadamu. Papa wengi huwaogopa wanadamu na huogelea mbali.
translations.reference: Sharks do exist, however they rarely attack humans. Most sharks are scared of humans and would swim away.
translations.hypothesis: Sharks are around, though attacks on humans are rare. Most sharks are wary of humans and swim away.

translations.source: Mamba wa majichumvi hawaishi sana baharini, kwani makazi yao ya kimsingi ni milango ya mito kaskazini mwa Rokihamptoni.
translations.reference: Saltwater Crocodiles do not actively live in the ocean, their primary habitat is in river estuaries north from Rockhampton.
translations.hypothesis: Saltwater crocodiles are not very common along the open coast, as their primary habitat is the estuaries and river mouths north of Rockhampton.

translations.source: Kuhifadhi mapema humpatia msafiri amani ya akili kwamba atapata mahali pa kulala atakapofika.
translations.reference: Booking in advance gives the traveller peace of mind that they will have somewhere to sleep once they arrive at their destination.
translations.hypothesis: Booking ahead of time gives the traveller peace of mind that he will have a place to sleep when he arrives.

translations.source: Kampuni za uwakala wa usafiri mara nyingi huwa na ofa na hoteli maalum, ingawa unaweza kupata uwezekano wa kuhifadhi aina nyingine za malazi, kama mahali pa kupiga kambi, kupitia wakala wa usafiri.
translations.reference: Travel agents often have deals with specific hotels, although you may find it possible to book other forms of accommodation, like camping grounds, through a travel agent.
translations.hypothesis: Travel agencies often have special offers and packages with particular hotels, though you may be able to book other types of accommodation, such as a bed in a hostel, through a travel agent.

translations.source: Kampuni za wakala wa usafiri kwa kawaida hutoa vifurushi vya ofa ambavyo hujumuisha kiamshakinywa, mipango ya uchukuzi kwenda/kutoka kwenye uwanja wa ndege au hata vifurushi vya ndege na hoteli vilivyochanganywa.
translations.reference: Travel agents usually offer packages that include breakfast, transportation arrangements to/from the airport or even combined flight and hotel packages.
translations.hypothesis: Travel agencies often provide package deals which include hotel, airport transfers and even combined flight and hotel deals.

translations.source: Pia wanaweza kukuwekea uhifadhi iwapo unahitaji muda wa kufikiria kuhusu ofa hiyo au kupata hati nyingine za mahali unapokwenda (k.m. visa).
translations.reference: They can also hold the reservation for you if you need time to think about the offer or procure other documents for your destination (e.g. visa).
translations.hypothesis: They can also help you secure reservations if you need more time to consider an offer or if you require additional documentation from the country where you intend to go (e.g. visas).

translations.source: Marekebisho au maombi yoyote lazima yafuatwe kupitia wakala wa kusafiri kwanza na si moja kwa moja na hoteli.
translations.reference: Any amendments or requests though should be coursed through the travel agent first and not directly with the hotel.
translations.hypothesis: Any changes or requests must be made through your travel agent and not directly with the hotel.

translations.source: Kwa baadhi ya tamasha, idadi kubwa ya wanaohudhuria tamasha za muziki huamua kukita kambi kwenye eneo, na wengi wao hukuchukulia kuwa sehemu muhimu ya tajriba hiyo.
translations.reference: For some festivals, the vast majority of the attendants to music festivals decide to camp on site, and most attendants consider it a vital part of the experience.
translations.hypothesis: For some festivals, a significant portion of the attendees choose to camp on-site, and for many of them, it is an integral part of the festival experience.

translations.source: Ikiwa ungetaka kuwa karibu na matukio utahitajika kurauka mapema ili upate eneo la kukita kambi karibu na muziki.
translations.reference: If you want to be close to the action you're going to have to get in early to get a camping site close to the music.
translations.hypothesis: If you want to be close to the action you will need to book early to get a camping spot close to the music.

translations.source: Kumbuka kuwa hata muziki kwenye jukwaa kuu ukimalizika, kunaweza kuwa na sehemu za tamasha ambazo zitaendelea kucheza muziki hadi usiku wa manane.
translations.reference: Remember that even though music on the main stages may have finished, there may be sections of the festival that will keep playing music until late into the night.
translations.hypothesis: Note that even though the music on the main stage ends, there are usually other stages that go on until midnight.

translations.source: Tamasha kadhaa zina maeneo maalumu ya kukita kambi kwa familia zenye watoto wadogo.
translations.reference: Some festivals have special camping areas for families with young children.
translations.hypothesis: Some festivals have special camping areas for families with small children.

translations.source: Kama unavuka Northern Baltic katika msimu wa baridi, kagua eneo la kibanda, kwani kupita katika theluji husababisha kelele mbaya kwa wale wanaoathirika zaidi.
translations.reference: If crossing the Northern Baltic in winter, check the cabin location, as going through ice causes quite horrible noise for those most affected.
translations.hypothesis: If you are crossing the northern Baltic in winter, check the ice conditions, as thin ice can be deadly for those who fall through.

translations.source: Safari za baharini za Mtakatifu Petersburge hujumuisha muda wa mjini. Abiria hawa wameepushwa na mahitaji ya visa (angalia masharti).
translations.reference: Saint Petersburg cruises include time in town. Cruise passengers are exempted from visa requirements (check the terms).
translations.hypothesis: St. Petersburg cruises generally include time in the city. Passengers are responsible for their own visa requirements (see requirements).

translations.source: Makasino kwa kawaida hufanya juhudi nyingi ili kuongeza pesa na muda unaotumika na wacheza kamari. Madirisha na saa kwa kawaida huwa hazipo na mlango wa kutoka huwa mgumu kupata.
translations.reference: Casinos typically make many efforts to maximize time and money spent by guests. Windows and clocks are usually absent, and exits can be hard to find.
translations.hypothesis: Casinos usually go to great lengths to maximize the amount of money and time that players spend on the premises. Clocks and windows are often absent and the exit is often hidden.

translations.source: Aghalabu huwa na chakula cha kipekee, vinywaji na matoleo ya burdani, ili kuwatumbuiza wageni na kuwatunza katika majengo yao.
translations.reference: They usually have special food, drink and entertainment offers, to keep guests in a good mood, and keep them at the premise.
translations.hypothesis: They often have special menus, drinks and entertainment, to pamper and please their guests.

translations.source: Baadhi ya kumbi hutoa vileo ndani ya nyumba. Hata hivyo, ulevi hutatiza maamuzi, na wacheza kamari wote wazuri wanajua umuhimu wa kuwa watulivu.
translations.reference: Some venues offer alcoholic beverages on the house. However, drunkenness impairs judgement, and all good gamblers know the importance of staying sober.
translations.hypothesis: Some casinos provide alcohol for free. However, alcohol impairs judgment, and all good players know the importance of staying as clear-headed as possible.

translations.source: Yeyote ambaye atakuwa akiendesha gari maeneo yaliyoinuka au vijia vya milimani anastahili kuzingatia uwezekano wa theluji, barafu, na baridi kali.
translations.reference: Anyone who's going to drive at high latitudes or over mountain passes should consider the possibility of snow, ice, or freezing temperatures.
translations.hypothesis: Anyone driving in mountainous or hilly areas should be alert to the possibility of snow, ice, and freezing rain.

translations.source: Katika barabara zenye barafu na theluji, msuguano uko chini na huwezi kuendesha gari kana kwamba uko katika lami tupu.
translations.reference: On icy and snowy roadways, friction is low and you cannot drive as if you were on bare asphalt.
translations.hypothesis: On roads with ice and snow, friction is reduced and you can't drive the same way you would on dry pavement.

translations.source: Wakati wa barafu nyingi, barafu ya kutosha kukufanya ukwame inaweza kuanguka kwa muda mfupi.
translations.reference: During blizzards, enough snow to get you stuck can fall in very little time.
translations.hypothesis: During heavy snows, enough snow to bury you can fall in a short amount of time.

translations.source: Mwonekano unaweza pia kuzuiliwa kupitia kwa kuanguka au kuvumisha theluji au kwa mtonesho au barafu kwenye madirisha ya magari.
translations.reference: Visibility may also be restricted by falling or blowing snow or by condensation or ice on vehicle windows.
translations.hypothesis: Visibility can also be reduced by falling or blowing snow, or by ice or frost on vehicle windows.

translations.source: Kwa upande mwingine, mazingira ya theluji na barafu ni ya kawaida katika mataifa mengi, na uchukuzi huendelea mwaka mzima bila kutatizwa.
translations.reference: On the other hand, icy and snowy conditions are normal in many countries, and traffic goes on mostly uninterrupted all year round.
translations.hypothesis: On the other hand, snowy and icy conditions are normal in many countries, and transport continues normally despite the weather.

translations.source: Pengine safari ndizo kivutio kikubwa zaidi cha watalii katika Afrika na angazio la wageni wengi.
translations.reference: Safaris are perhaps the greatest tourism draw in Africa and the highlight for many visitors.
translations.hypothesis: Wildlife safaris are perhaps Africa's biggest tourist attraction and a major revenue generator.

translations.source: Neno safari linamaanisha kusafiri kuona Wanyama wa pori wa Afrika wanaoshangaza, haswa kwenye savanna
translations.reference: The term safari in popular use refers to overland travel to view the stunning African wildlife, particularly on savanna.
translations.hypothesis: The word safari means “journey” or “voyage” in Swahili, and evokes images of traveling across the African savanna in search of wildlife.

translations.source: Baadhi ya wanyama, kama vile ndovu na twiga, huelekea kusogea kukaribia magari na vifaa vya kawaida vitaruhusu utazamaji mwema.
translations.reference: Some animals, such as elephants and giraffes, tend to approach closely to cars and standard equipment will allow good viewing.
translations.hypothesis: Some animals, such as elephants and giraffes, may approach vehicles closely and normal vehicle-window viewing allows for excellent observation.

translations.source: Simba, duma na chui wakati mwingine huwa na aibu na utawaona bora na darubini.
translations.reference: Lions, cheetahs and leopards are sometimes shy and you will see them better with binoculars.
translations.hypothesis: Lions, cheetahs and leopards are sometimes seen but are best looked for with binoculars.

translations.source: Safari ya miguu (ijulikanayo kama "matembezi kichakani", "safari ya kukwea", au kwenda "kwa miguu") hujumuisha ukweaji, iwe kwa saa chache au siku kadhaa.
translations.reference: A walking safari (also called a "bush walk", "hiking safari", or going "footing") consists of hiking, either for a few hours or several days.
translations.hypothesis: Hiking (also known as "bushwalking", "trekking", or "hill walking") involves walking in natural environments, typically for several hours or several days.

translations.source: Mbio za Walemavu zitaanza mnamo Agosti 24 hadi Septemba 5, 2021. Baadhi ya mashindano yatafanyika katika maeneo tofauti tofauti kote Japani.
translations.reference: The Paralympics will take place from 24 August to 5 September 2021. Some events will be held in other locations throughout Japan.
translations.hypothesis: The Paralympic Games will be held from 24 August to 5 September 2021. Some of the events will be held at different locations across Japan.

translations.source: Tokyo itakuwa mji wa kipekee wa Asia kuwahi kuwa mwenyeji wa Olimpiki mbili za kiangazi, kwani ilikuwa mwenyeji wa michezo hiyo mnamo 1964.
translations.reference: Tokyo will be the only Asian city to have hosted two summer Olympics, having hosted the games in 1964.
translations.hypothesis: Tokyo will be the first Asian city to have hosted the Olympic Games on two occasions, as it was the host city in 1964.

translations.source: Ikiwa ulihifadhi nafasi ya ndege na malazi yako 2020 kabla ya uahirisho kutangazwa, unaweza kuwa na hali ya hila.
translations.reference: If you booked your flights and accommodation for 2020 before the postponement was announced, you may have a tricky situation.
translations.hypothesis: If you had already booked your flights and accommodation for 2020 before the cancellation was announced, you may be in a difficult situation.

translations.source: Sera za kufuta zinatofautiana, lakini kufikia mwishoni mwa mwezi Machi sera nyingi za ughairi kwa sababu ya virusi vya korona hazifiki hadi Julai 2020, wakati Olimpiki ilikuwa imeratibiwa.
translations.reference: Cancellation policies vary, but as of late March most coronavirus-based cancellation policies don't extend to July 2020, when the Olympics had been scheduled.
translations.hypothesis: Cancellation policies varied, but by the end of March most cancellation policies for events through to July 2020—when the Olympics were scheduled—had been amended to account for the coronavirus.

translations.source: Inatarajiwa kwamba tiketi nyingi za hafla zitagharimu kati ya Yeni 2,500 na Yeni 130,000, na tiketi za kawaida zikigharimu takriban Yeni 7,000.
translations.reference: It's expected that most event tickets will cost between ¥2,500 and ¥130,000, with typical tickets costing around ¥7,000.
translations.hypothesis: Expectedly, most event tickets will range from ₦2,500 to ₦130,000, with general tickets going for around ₦7,000.

translations.source: Kupiga pasi nguo zilizo na maji kunaweza kuzisaidia kukauka. Hoteli nyingi zina pasi na bodi za kupigia pasi za kukodisha, hata kama mtu hayuko ndani ya chumba hicho.
translations.reference: Ironing damp clothes can help them dry. Many hotels have an iron and ironing board available for loan, even if one is not present in the room.
translations.hypothesis: Hanging wet clothes on a clothesline will help them to dry. Many hotels have clotheslines and clothes drying boards available, even if the room does not have a balcony.

translations.source: Ikiwa pasi haipatikani, au ikiwa hupendii kuvaa soksi zilizopasiwa, basi unaweza kujaribu kutumia kikaushi nywele, ikiwa kinapatikana.
translations.reference: If an iron isn't available, or if you don't fancy wearing ironed socks, then you can try using a hairdryer, if available.
translations.hypothesis: If you don't have a passport, or if you prefer not to carry a passport-sized photo with you, you can try using a hair clip, if available.

translations.source: Uwe mwangalifu kitambaa kisiwe moto sana (kwani inaweza kusababisha urukaji, au katika hali mbaya zaidi, kuchoma).
translations.reference: Be careful not to allow fabric to become too hot (which can cause shrinkage, or in extreme cases, scorch).
translations.hypothesis: Be careful the cloth doesn't get too hot (as it can cause burns, or in more extreme cases, fire).

translations.source: Kuna njia tofauti za kusafisha maji, baadhi zikiwa na mafanikio dhidi ya vitishio maalum.
translations.reference: There are different ways of purifying water, some more effective against specific threats.
translations.hypothesis: There are different methods to purify water, some more effective than others at removing particular threats.

translations.source: Katika baadhi ya maeneo mengine kuchemsha maji kwa dakika moja kunatosha, kwingineko dakika kadhaa zitahitajika.
translations.reference: In some areas boiling water for a minute is enough, in others several minutes are needed.
translations.hypothesis: In some areas a rolling boil for one minute is sufficient, elsewhere several minutes may be needed.

translations.source: Vichujio hutofautiana katika utendaji, na iwapo utapatwa na wasiwasi, basi unafaa kufikiria kununua maji yako katika chupa iliyofungwa kabisa kutoka kwa kampuni tajika.
translations.reference: Filters vary in effectiveness, and should you have a concern, then you should consider buying your water in a sealed bottle from a reputable company.
translations.hypothesis: Filters vary in effectiveness, and if you are concerned, then it is best to buy bottled water from a reputable brand.

translations.source: Wasafiri wanaweza kukutana na wadudu wa wanyama ambao hawawatambui kutoka maeneo yao ya nyumbani.
translations.reference: Travellers may encounter animal pests that they are not familiar with in their home regions.
translations.hypothesis: Travellers may be exposed to insect vectors and unfamiliar pathogens from their home areas.

translations.source: Wadudu waharibifu wanaweza kuharibu chakula, kusababisha maudhi, au katika hali mbaya kusababisha athari za mzio, kueneza sumu au kusambaza maambukizi.
translations.reference: Pests can spoil food, cause irritation, or in a worse case cause allergic reactions, spread venom, or transmit infections.
translations.hypothesis: Harmful insects can damage crops, cause injury or, in severe cases, result in allergic reactions, envenoming or secondary infections.

translations.source: Maradhi yenyewe ya kuambukiza, au wanyama hatari ambao wanaweza kujeruhi au kuua watu kwa nguvu, kwa kawaida hawahitimu kama wanyama-vipenzi.
translations.reference: Infectious diseases themselves, or dangerous animals that can injure or kill people by force, do not usually qualify as pests.
translations.hypothesis: Truly infectious diseases, or animals that can cause harm or death to humans through their natural behaviour, are unlikely to be considered companion animals.

translations.source: Ununuzi bila ushuru ni nafasi ya kununua bidhaa zisizo na ushuru na kodi katika maeneo fulani.
translations.reference: Duty free shopping is the opportunity to buy goods exempted from taxes and excises at certain locations.
translations.hypothesis: A duty-free shop is a retail shop located in a specific geographic area where goods can be purchased without payment of duties and taxes.

translations.source: Wasafiri katika nchi zinazotoza ushuru wa juu wakati mwingine wanaweza kuokoa kiwango kikubwa cha pesa, hasa kwa bidhaa kama vinywaji vyenye vileo na tumbaku.
translations.reference: Travellers bound for countries with heavy taxation can sometimes save a considerable amount of money, especially on products such as alcoholic beverages and tobacco.
translations.hypothesis: Travellers in countries with high taxes can sometimes save a significant amount of money, especially on goods such as alcoholic beverages and tobacco.

translations.source: Eneo katikati mwa Point Marion na Fairmont hutoa hali za uendeshaji gari zenye changamoto zaidi katika Barabara Kuu ya Buffalo-Pittsburgh, inayopitia mara kwa mara kwenye maeneo ya ardhi yaliyo katika misitu iliyotengwa.
translations.reference: The stretch between Point Marion and Fairmont presents the most challenging driving conditions on the Buffalo-Pittsburgh Highway, passing frequently through isolated backwoods terrain.
translations.hypothesis: The area between Point Marion and Fairmont provides the most challenging driving conditions on the National Road, with steep grades and sharp turns through heavily wooded areas.

translations.source: Kama hujazoea kuendesha gari katika barabara za mashambani, kaa chonjo: miinuko mikali, njia nyembamba, na na pembe kali zimejaa.
translations.reference: If you're not used to driving on country roads, keep your wits about you: steep grades, narrow lanes, and sharp curves predominate.
translations.hypothesis: If you're not used to driving on rural roads, be careful: steep slopes, narrow roads, and sharp turns are common.

translations.source: Viwango vya kasi vilivyotumwa viko chini kabisa kuliko vya sehemu za zamani na zilizofuata — kawaida maili 35-40 kwa saa (kilomita 56-64 kwa saa) — na utii mkali kwavyo ni muhimu zaidi kuliko vinginevyo.
translations.reference: Posted speed limits are noticeably lower than in previous and subsequent sections — commonly 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) — and strict obedience to them is even more important than otherwise.
translations.hypothesis: Speeds are lower than on the old and new courses—typically 35–40 mph (56–64 km/h)—and adherence to them is more critical than ever.

translations.source: Cha kushangaza hata hivyo, huduma ya simu ya rununu ina nguvu sana hapa kuliko tandaa zingine za njia kama Pennsylvania Wilds.
translations.reference: Curiously, though, mobile phone service is much stronger here than along many other stretches of the route, e.g. the Pennsylvania Wilds.
translations.hypothesis: Interestingly, mobile coverage is better here than in other areas such as the Pennsylvania Wilds.

translations.source: Mikate ya Kijerumani ni mizuri mno, na huko Bavaria, ni bora zaidi na tofauti, sawasawa na ile ya jirani yao wa kusini, Austria.
translations.reference: German pastries are quite good, and in Bavaria, are quite rich and varied, similar to those of their southern neighbor, Austria.
translations.hypothesis: German breads are generally very good, and in Bavaria they are often better and more varied than in their neighbour to the south, Austria.

translations.source: Vinyunga vya matunda ni za kawaida, na tufaa zilizopikwa kuwa vinyunga mwaka mzima, na cheri na plamu zikionekana wakati wa msimu wa joto.
translations.reference: Fruit pastries are common, with apples cooked into pastries year round, and cherries and plums making their appearances during the summer.
translations.hypothesis: Fruit bats are common, and cooked fruit is available throughout the year, with cherries and plums in season in the summer.

translations.source: Nyingi ya bidhaa za kuokwa kutoka Ujerumani huwa lozi, na karanga. Keki zilizo maarufu mara nyingi huambatana vizuri na kikombe cha kahawa kali.
translations.reference: Many German baked goods also feature almonds, hazelnuts, and other tree nuts. Popular cakes often pair particularly well with a cup of strong coffee.
translations.hypothesis: Most of the exported German goods are cars and machines. The popular cakes are often accompanied by a strong cup of coffee.

translations.source: Ikiwa unataka vitumbua vidogo ingawa bora, jaribu kile ambacho kutegemea eneo kinaitwa Berliner, Pfannkuchen au Krapfen.
translations.reference: If you want some small though rich pastries, try what depending on region are called Berliner, Pfannkuchen or Krapfen.
translations.hypothesis: If you want a smaller, but still substantial, version, try what in the Berlin area is called a Berliner, in Bavaria a Pfannkuchen or elsewhere a Krapfen.

translations.source: Bizari ni chakula kilichoundwa kwa mimea na viungo, pamoja na nyama au mboga.
translations.reference: A curry is a dish based on herbs and spices, together with either meat or vegetables.
translations.hypothesis: A casserole is a dish prepared in a casserole, which is a sort of deep oven-safe dish.

translations.source: Bizari inaweza kuwa "kavu" au "yenye unyevunyevu" kulingana na kiasi cha kioevu.
translations.reference: A curry can be either "dry" or "wet" depending on the amount of liquid.
translations.hypothesis: The slurry can be "dry" or "wet" depending on the liquid content.

translations.source: katika maeneo ya bara la Kaskazini mwa India na Pakistani, mtindi kwa kawaida hutumiwa katika mchuzi wenye viungo; Katika Kusini mwa India na mikoa mingine ya pwani ya bara ndogo, maziwa ya nazi hutumiwa sana.
translations.reference: In inland regions of Northern India and Pakistan, yogurt is commonly used in curries; in Southern India and some other coastal regions of the subcontinent, coconut milk is commonly used.
translations.hypothesis: In the north Indian and Pakistani regions, the nut is often used in curries; in southern India and other coastal regions, coconut milk is used more.

translations.source: Kukiwa na visiwa 17,000 vya kuchagua, chakula cha Indonesia ni jina la kijumla linalosimamia aina kubwa ya vyakula vinavyopatikana kote nchini.
translations.reference: With 17,000 islands to choose from, Indonesian food is an umbrella term covering a vast variety of regional cuisines found across the nation.
translations.hypothesis: With 17,000 islands to choose from, Indonesian cuisine is an umbrella term for the diverse culinary offerings of the archipelago.

translations.source: Lakini, llikitumiwa bila vivumishi zaidi, neno hilo huelekea kumaanisha chakula ambacho mwanzoni kilitoka sehemu za kati na mashariki mwa kisiwa kikuu cha Java.
translations.reference: But, if used without further qualifiers, the term tends to mean the food originally from the central and eastern parts of the main island Java.
translations.hypothesis: But when used without further clarification, the word usually refers to a dish that originated from the Central and East Java regions of the island of Java.

translations.source: Chakula kinachopatikana sana katika maeneo mapana ya funguvisiwa, ni vyakula vya Kijavanese vilivyotayarishwa kwa ustadi sahili, ladha yake ya kimsingi ikiwa ni njugu karanga, pilipili, sukari (hususan sukari ya nazi ya Javanese) na viungo tofauti vinavyonukia.
translations.reference: Now widely available throughout the archipelago, Javanese cuisine features an array of simply seasoned dishes, the predominant flavorings the Javanese favor being peanuts, chillies, sugar (especially Javanese coconut sugar) and various aromatic spices.
translations.hypothesis: Commonly available in most parts of the archipelago, it is a Javanese-influenced snack food whose basic taste is a combination of peanuts, chili, salt, sugar (particularly Javanese palm sugar), and various spices.

translations.source: Vikuku ni nguzo zinazoshikilia miguu ya mwendeshaji ambazo huning’inia chini katika pande zote mbili za matandiko.
translations.reference: Stirrups are supports for the rider's feet that hang down on either side of the saddle.
translations.hypothesis: The skids are the bars which hold the driver's feet and which hang down on either side of the sled.

translations.source: Zinampa mpanda farasi utulivu mkubwa lakini zinaweza kuwa na wasiwasi wa kiusalama kwa sababu ya uwezo wa miguu ya mpanda farasi kukwama ndani yake.
translations.reference: They provide greater stability for the rider but can have safety concerns due to the potential for a rider's feet to get stuck in them.
translations.hypothesis: They give the rider a greater sense of security but can be a safety concern because the rider's feet can get trapped in the pedals.

translations.source: Ikiwa mwendeshaji farasi atatupwa kuotka kwa farasi lakini mguu wake ufungiwe kwenye tandiko, wanaweza kukokotwa ikiwa farasi atatoroka. Ili kupunguza hatari hii, hatua kadhaa za usalama zinaweza kuchukuliwa.
translations.reference: If a rider is thrown from a horse but has a foot caught in the stirrup, they could be dragged if the horse runs away. To minimize this risk, a number of safety precautions can be taken.
translations.hypothesis: If a rider is thrown from a horse but their foot is caught in the stirrup, they can be dragged along the ground if the horse bolts. To reduce this risk, a number of safety precautions can be taken.

translations.source: Kwanza, waendeshaji wengi huvaa kiatu cha buti kilicho juu na laini, chembamba kabisa, soli.
translations.reference: First, most riders wear riding boots with a heel and a smooth, quite narrow, sole.
translations.hypothesis: First, many drivers wear high-top, soft-soled shoes with very thin, smooth soles.

translations.source: Kisha, matandiko mengine, hasa matandiko ya Kiingereza yana fito za kiusalama ambzo huruhusu ngozi ya kuvutwa kuangukia tandiko kama kama itavutwa nyuma na mpanda farasi anayeanguka.
translations.reference: Next, some saddles, particularly English saddles, have safety bars that allow a stirrup leather to fall off the saddle if pulled backwards by a falling rider.
translations.hypothesis: Then, some saddles, especially English saddles, have a safety pommel which allows the rider's foot to slip through in case the rider is thrown backwards.

translations.source: Bonde la Cochamo – eneo kuu la makusudio ya ukweaji nchini Chile, lijulikanalo kama Yosemite ya Marekani Kusini, na kuta kubwa anuwai za matale na majabali.
translations.reference: Cochamó Valley - Chile's premier climbing destination, known as the Yosemite of South America, with a variety of granite big walls and crags.
translations.hypothesis: The Cochamo Valley – the main attraction of the area, also known as the Yosemite of Southern Chile, and its steep walls and hanging glaciers.

translations.source: Mikutano huwa na mandhari za kusisimua kutoka vileleni. Wapanda mlima kutoka pande zote za ulimwengu wanaendelea kuanzisha njia mpya kati ya uwezo wake wa kuta.
