translations.reference: Summits include breath-taking views from peaks. Climbers from all parts of the world are continually establishing new routes amongst its endless potential of walls.
translations.hypothesis: The meetings are held at the top of the mountain. Mountaineers from all over the world continue to establish new routes among its rocky walls.

translations.source: Michezo ya theluji ya kuteremka, ambayo ni pamoja na mchezo wa kuteleza juu ya theluji na mchezo wa kupanda theluji, ni michezo maarufu inayohusisha kuteleza chini ya ardhi iliyofunikwa na theluji kwa ubaos au bao za theluji zilizofungiwa kwenye miguu yako.
translations.reference: Downhill snowsports, which include skiing and snowboarding, are popular sports involving sliding down snow-covered terrain with skis or a snowboard attached to your feet.
translations.hypothesis: Snow sports, which include skiing and snowboarding, are popular activities that involve descending a snow-covered slope on skis or a snowboard.

translations.source: Kuteleza juu ya theluji ni shughuli kubwa huku washiriki wengi, ambao mara kwa mara hujulikana kama "ski bums," wakipanga likizo nzima kwa kuteleza juu ya theluji katika eneo fulani.
translations.reference: Skiing is a major travelling activity with many enthusiasts, occasionally known as "ski bums," planning entire vacations around skiing at a particular location.
translations.hypothesis: Skiing is a popular activity with many enthusiasts, some of whom, often referred to as "ski bums", dedicate themselves to skiing full-time.

translations.source: Wazo la uendeshaji ubao kwenye theluji ni la zamani sana - michoro ya pango inaonyesha waendeshaji wa ubao kwenye theluji wa miaka ya zamani ya hadi 5000 KK!
translations.reference: The idea of skiing is very old — cave paintings depicting skiers date back as far as 5000 BC!
translations.hypothesis: The concept of snowboarding has ancient roots - cave paintings depict snowboarders from 5000 B.C.!

translations.source: Mchezo wa kuteleza kwa kasi kwenye mteremko wenye theluji ulianza angalau karne ya 17, na mnamo 1861 kilabu cha kwanza cha burudani cha utelezaji kwenye barafu kilifunguliwa na watu wa Norwegi huko Australia.
translations.reference: Downhill skiing as a sport goes back to at least the 17th century, and in 1861 the first recreational ski club was opened by Norwegians in Australia.
translations.hypothesis: The sport of skiing began at least several thousand years ago, and in 1861 the first ski jumping club was founded by Norwegians in Australia.

translations.source: Kuteleza kwa kubeba shanta: Shughuli hii pia huitwa kuteleza mashambani, kutalii kwa kuteleza au matembezi ya kuteleza.
translations.reference: Backpacking by ski: This activity is also called backcountry ski, ski touring or ski hiking.
translations.hypothesis: Sledding: This activity is also called tobogganing, sliding or sledging.

translations.source: Inahusiana na lakini kawaida haishirikiani na ziara za utelezaji kwenye theluji ya milima mirefu au upandaji wa milima, hilo la mwisho hufanywa katika eneo lenye mteremko na linahitaji bao na buti ngumu.
translations.reference: It is related to but usually not involving alpine style ski touring or mountaineering, the latter ones done in steep terrain and requiring much stiffer skis and boots.
translations.hypothesis: Related to but usually separate from mountaineering and rock climbing, the latter being done in a canyon or other steep area and requiring ropes and specialized boots.

translations.source: Fikiria kuhusu njia ya utelezaji kwa theluji kama njia mfanano ya kukwea.
translations.reference: Think of the skiing route as of a similar hiking route.
translations.hypothesis: Think of the way a glacier moves as a model for how to go about climbing it.

translations.source: Katika hali nzuri utaweza kufikia umbali mkubwa kiasi kuliko kutembea – lakini ni mara chache sana utapata kasi za kuteleza sehemu za mashambani bila shanta nzito katika njia zilizopitiwa awali.
translations.reference: In good conditions you will be able to cover somewhat greater distances than walking – but only very seldom you will get the speeds of cross country skiing without a heavy backpack in groomed tracks.
translations.hypothesis: In good conditions you'll be able to go farther than by foot – but you'll rarely find any serious off-road riding without a heavy duty bike on established trails.

translations.source: Uropa ni bara ambalo ni dogo kiasi lakini lina nchi nyingi huru. Katika hali ya kawaida, kusafiri kupitia nchi nyingi kungemaanisha kulazimika kufanya maombi ya visa na udhibiti wa pasipoti mara nyingi.
translations.reference: Europe is a continent that is relatively small but with many independent countries. Under normal circumstances, travelling through multiple countries would mean having to go through visa applications and passport control multiple times.
translations.hypothesis: Europe is a continent made up of many small countries, many of which are independent. In general, traveling across many of these countries means having to deal with multiple visa requirements and passport controls.

translations.source: Eneo la Schengen, hata hivyo, hufanya kazi kiasi kama nchi moja kuhusiana na jambo hili.
translations.reference: The Schengen zone, however, works somewhat like one country in this respect.
translations.hypothesis: The Schengen Area, however, functions as one single area in this regard.

translations.source: Bora ubakie katika eneo hili, unaweza kuvuka mipaka bila kupitia maeneo ya ukaguzi wa pasipoti tena.
translations.reference: As long as you stay in this zone, you can generally cross borders without going through passport control checkpoints again.
translations.hypothesis: The best thing to do is to stay in the Schengen area, you can cross the borders without any passport control.

translations.source: Vilevile, kwa kuwa na visa ya Schengen, huhitaji kutoa maombi ya visa kwa kila nchi iliyo memba wa Schengen kivyake, hivyo kuokoa muda, pesa na nyaraka.
translations.reference: Similarly, by having a Schengen visa, you do not need to apply for visas to each of the Schengen member countries separately, hence saving time, money and paperwork.
translations.hypothesis: Also, because you only need one visa for the Schengen area, you don't have to apply for a visa from each of the member countries individually, saving you time, money, and paperwork.

translations.source: Hakuna ufafanuzi wa kijumla kuhusu ni bidhaa zipi za viwandani ni za kale. Baadhi ya mashirika ya ushuru hufafanua bidhaa zenye zaidi ya miaka 100 kuwa za kale.
translations.reference: There is no universal definition for which manufactured items are antiques. Some tax agencies define goods older than 100 years as antiques.
translations.hypothesis: There is no universal definition of what constitutes an antique. Some taxing authorities define an antique as an item over 100 years old.

translations.source: Ufafanuzi una tofauti za kijiografia, ambapo kikomo cha umri kinaweza kuwa kifupi katika maeneo kama Marekani ya Kaskazini kuliko Ulaya.
translations.reference: The definition has geographic variations, where the age limit might be shorter in places such as North America than in Europe.
translations.hypothesis: The definition varies by geographic region, with the minimum age limit being lower in some regions, such as North America, than in others, such as Europe.

translations.source: Bidhaa za sanaa zinaweza kufafanuliwa kama bidhaa za kale, ingawa ni changa kuliko bidhaa sawa zinazotengenezwa kwa wingi.
translations.reference: Handicraft products might be defined as antiques, though they are younger than similar mass-produced goods.
translations.hypothesis: Artwork can be defined as an antique, though it is younger than other antiques.

translations.source: Ukulima wa kulungu aktiki ni riziki muhimu miongoni mwa watu wa Sámi na utamaduni unaozunguka biashara hiyo ni muhimu pia kwa wengi walio na taaluma nyingine.
translations.reference: Reindeer husbandry is an important livelihood among the Sámi and the culture surrounding the trade is important also for many with other professions.
translations.hypothesis: Reindeer herding is an important economic base among the Sami people and a culture associated with the practice is also important to many non-Sami.

translations.source: Hata hivyo tangu jadi, sio Sami wote wamekuwa wakijihusisha na ufugaji mkubwa wa kulungu aktiki, lakini waliishi kutoka kwa uvuvi, uwindaji na nyingine kama hizo, na kufuga kulungu aktiki sana sana kama wanyama wa kufanya kazi.
translations.reference: Even traditionally, though, not all Sámi have been involved in big scale reindeer husbandry, but lived from fishing, hunting and similar, having reindeer mostly as draft animals.
translations.hypothesis: However, traditionally not all Sami were involved in reindeer herding, but rather lived by fishing, hunting and other means, and herding reindeer was just one of their activities.

translations.source: Leo Wasámi wengi hufanya kazi katika biashara za kisasa. Utalii ni wa mapato muhimu katika Sápmi, eneo la Sámi.
translations.reference: Today many Sámi work in modern trades. Tourism is an important income in Sápmi, the Sámi area.
translations.hypothesis: Many Sámi today work in the modern service sector. Tourism is a significant revenue generator in Sápmi, the Sámi region.

translations.source: Ingawa inatumika sana, na hususana miongoni mwa watu wasio Waromani, neno "Jipsi" mara nyingi huchukuliwa kama la kukera kwa sababu linahusishwa na ubaguzi hasi na mitazamo isiyo sahihi ya watu wa Romani.
translations.reference: Though it is widely used, especially among non-Romani, the word "Gypsy" is often considered offensive because of its associations with negative stereotypes and inaccurate perceptions of Romani people.
translations.hypothesis: Although widely used, and especially among non-Roma people, the word "Gypsy" is often considered pejorative due to its association with negative stereotypes and prejudices against Roma people.

translations.source: Kama nchi utakayozuru itakua ni somo kwa ushauri wa kusafiri, bima ya afya yako au bima ya kufuta usafiri wako huenda ikaathirika.
translations.reference: If the country you will be visiting becomes subject to a travel advisory, your travel health insurance or your trip cancellation insurance may be affected.
translations.hypothesis: Depending on the country you visit, your health insurance or travel insurance may be affected.

translations.source: Pia pengine ungetaka kushauriana na ushauri wa serikali bali na yako, lakini ushauri wao umeundiwa raia wao.
translations.reference: You may also wish to consult the advice of governments other than your own, but their advice is designed for their citizens.
translations.hypothesis: You would also want to consult your government's travel advisory, though their advice is tailored to their citizens.

translations.source: Kama mfano mmoja, raia wa Marekani katika Mashariki ya Kati huenda wakakumbwa na hali tofauti kutoka kwa Wazungu na Waarabu.
translations.reference: As one example, American citizens in the Middle East might face different situations from Europeans or Arabs.
translations.hypothesis: As one example, the experience of Americans in the Middle East may be different from that of Europeans or Arabs.

translations.source: Ushauri ni muhtasari mfupi tu wa hali ya kisiasa katika nchi moja.
translations.reference: Advisories are merely a brief summary of the political situation in one country.
translations.hypothesis: Advice is only a brief summary of the political situation in a country.

translations.source: Maoni yanayowasilishwa mara nyingi huwa ni ya haraka, ya kijumla na yaliyosahilishwa sana yakilinganishwa na habari za kina zinazopatikana kwingineko.
translations.reference: The views presented are often cursory, general and oversimplified compared to the more detailed information available elsewhere.
translations.hypothesis: The views presented are often more immediate, general and less detailed in comparison to the in-depth information available elsewhere.

translations.source: Hali kali ya hewa ni neno la kawaida kwa hali yoyote hatari ya hali ya hewa na ina uwezo wa kusababisha uharibifu, usumbufu mkubwa wa kijamii, au kupotea kwa maisha ya mwanadamu.
translations.reference: Severe weather is the generic term for any dangerous weather phenomenon with the potential to cause damage, serious social disruption, or loss of human life.
translations.hypothesis: Extreme weather events is an umbrella term for any dangerous meteorological phenomenon that has the potential to cause damage, social disruption, or loss of life.

translations.source: Hali kali ya hewa inawezakuwa popote duniani, na kuna aina nyingi ambazo zinaweza kutegemea jiografia, sura ya nchi, na hali ya anga.
translations.reference: Severe weather can occur anywhere in the world, and there are different types of it, which can depend on geography, topography, and atmospheric conditions.
translations.hypothesis: Extreme weather events can occur anywhere in the world, and there are many different types that can depend on the region's geography, climate, and landscape.

translations.source: Upepo mkubwa,mvua ya mawe, ukaukaji, na mioto ya msitu ni maumbo na athari za hali kali za hewa, vilevile dhoruba, , tufani, mifereji ya maji na vimbunga.
translations.reference: High winds, hail, excessive precipitation, and wildfires are forms and effects of severe weather, as are thunderstorms, tornadoes, waterspouts, and cyclones.
translations.hypothesis: Strong winds, heavy rains, flooding, and wildfires are all extreme weather events, as are heatwaves, droughts, cyclones and tornadoes.

translations.source: Matukio ya hali kali ya hewa ya kieneo na kimsimu yanatia ndani dhoruba kali za theluji, dhoruba za theluji, dhoruba za barafu, na dhoruba za vumbi.
translations.reference: Regional and seasonal severe weather phenomena include blizzards, snowstorms, ice storms, and dust storms.
translations.hypothesis: Localized and seasonal extreme weather events include tropical cyclones, hurricanes, typhoons, blizzards, avalanches, and dust storms.

translations.source: Wasafiri wanashauriwa kwa dhati kujua kuhusu hatari yoyote ya anga mbaya inayoathiri eneo lao kwani huenda ikaathiri mipango yoyote ya usafiri.
translations.reference: Travellers are strongly advised to be aware of any risk of severe weather affecting their area as they may affect any travel plans.
translations.hypothesis: Travellers are strongly advised to be aware of any potential adverse weather conditions that may affect their area as this may impact any travel plans.

translations.source: Mtu yeyote anayepanga kutembelea nchi ambayo inazingatiwa kuwa eneo la vita anapaswa kupata mafunzo ya kitaalamu.
translations.reference: Anyone planning a visit to a country that could be considered a war zone should get professional training.
translations.hypothesis: Anyone planning to visit a country considered to be a war zone should get professional advice.

translations.source: Utafutaji wa ‘Kozi ya mazingira yenye uhasama’ kwenye Intaneti huenda pengine ukatoa anwani ya kampuni ya kienyeji.
translations.reference: A search of the Internet for 'Hostile environment course' will probably provide the address of a local company.
translations.hypothesis: A search for "environmental course" online might just as easily turn up a local company's contact information.

translations.source: Kwa kawaida kozi itashughulikia masuala yote yaliyojadiliwa hapa kwa kina, na aghalabu pamoja na uzoefu wa moja kwa moja.
translations.reference: A course will normally cover all the issues discussed here in far greater detail, usually with practical experience.
translations.hypothesis: The course will most likely cover all the topics listed above in great detail, and possibly even go into live demos.

translations.source: Kwa kawaida kozi itachukua siku 2-5 na itahusisha uigizaji, huduma nyingi za kwanza na wakati mwingine mafunzo ya kutumia silaha.
translations.reference: A course will normally be from 2-5 days and will involve role play, a lot of first aid and sometimes weapons training.
translations.hypothesis: The course normally lasts 2–5 days and involves physical training, first aid and sometimes weapons training.

translations.source: Vitabu na majarida yanayozungumzia maisha ya nyikani ni ya kawaida, lakini machapisho yanayohusiana na maeneo ya vita ni machache.
translations.reference: Books and magazines dealing with wilderness survival are common, but publications dealing with war zones are few.
translations.hypothesis: Books and magazines about the outdoors are common, but publications specifically about war zones are rare.

translations.source: Wasafiri wanaonuia kwenda ng'ambo kwa upasuaji wa kijinsia lazima wahakikishe kuwa wamebeba stakabadhi halali kwa sababu ya safari ya kurudi.
translations.reference: Voyagers planning sex reassignment surgery abroad must ensure they're carrying valid documents for the return trip.
translations.hypothesis: Travellers undergoing gender-affirming surgery should ensure they have valid documentation for their onward travel.

translations.source: Utayari wa serikali kutoa pasipoti zisizotaja jinsia (X) au hati zilizosasishwa ili kulingana na jina na jinsia inayonuiwa unatofautiana.
translations.reference: The willingness of governments to issue passports with gender not stated (X) or documents updated to match a desired name and gender varies.
translations.hypothesis: The willingness of governments to issue gender-neutral passports (X) or updated identity documents to better reflect a person’s gender varies.

translations.source: Utayari wa serikali za kigeni kukubali nyaraka hizi unatofautiana vilevile.
translations.reference: Willingness of foreign governments to honour these documents is just as widely variable.
translations.hypothesis: The willingness of foreign governments to accept these documents varies.

translations.source: Utafutaji katika vituo vya ukaguzi wa kiusalama pia umekuwa wenye uingiliaji zaidi katika enzi za baada ya Septemba 11, 2001.
translations.reference: Searches at security checkpoints have also become far more intrusive in the post-September 11, 2001 era.
translations.hypothesis: Screenings at security checkpoints have also become more intrusive in the years since September 11, 2001.

translations.source: Wasenge hawafai kutarajia kupitia kwenye kiwambo cha uchunguzi na watoke huko ikiwa utu na siri zao ziko kamilifu.
translations.reference: Pre-operative transgender people should not expect to pass through the scanners with their privacy and dignity intact.
translations.hypothesis: Applicants shouldn't be judged by their background and should be given a fair chance.

translations.source: Mikondo ya mawimbi ya maji ni yale yanayorudi kutokwa kwa mawimbi yanayoachana ufukoni, aghalabu mwambani au mahali sawa.
translations.reference: Rip currents are the returning flow from waves breaking off the beach, often at a reef or similar.
translations.hypothesis: Tidal bores are a phenomenon where a wave or series of waves travel up a river against the current, often breaking at the river mouth or a similar point.

translations.source: Kwa sababu ya topolojia ya chini ya maji, yale yanayorudi huwa yamelimbikizia katika maeneo machache ya kina, na mawimbi ya kasi kwa maji ya kina yanaweza kuundika hapo.
translations.reference: Due to the underwater topology the return flow is concentrated at a few deeper sections, and a fast current to deep water may form there.
translations.hypothesis: Because of the low density of the water, the light is able to penetrate to great depths, and the scattering of light by the water molecules creates the blue color.

translations.source: Vifo vingi hutokea kutokana na machovu ya kujaribu kuogelea kinyume na mawimbi, hali ambayo huenda ikawa ngumu.
translations.reference: Most deaths happen as result of fatigue trying to swim back against the current, which may be impossible.
translations.hypothesis: Most deaths are due to drowning after being overcome by the waves, which can be especially difficult for inexperienced swimmers.

translations.source: Mara tu utakapotoka kwenye mkondo, kuogelea kurudi si kugumu zaidi ya kawaida.
translations.reference: As soon as you get out of the current, swimming back is no more difficult than normally.
translations.hypothesis: Once you are out of the current, swimming back to shore is not much more difficult than normal.

translations.source: Jaribu kulenga mahali ambapo hutashikwa tena au, kulingana na ujuzi wako au kama umeonekana, huenda ukataka kungoja uokovu.
translations.reference: Try aiming somewhere where you are not caught again or, depending on your skills and on whether you have been noticed, you might want to wait for rescue.
translations.hypothesis: Try to aim for a spot where you won't be disturbed again or, depending on your skill and the conditions, you may want to wait for a rescue.

translations.source: Mshtuko wa kurudi tena huja upesi kuliko mshtuko wa tamaduni (kuna kipindi chini ya fungate), hukaa kwa muda mrefu, na huweza kuwa kali zaidi.
translations.reference: Re-entry shock comes on sooner than culture shock (there's less of a honeymoon phase), lasts longer, and can be more severe.
translations.hypothesis: Relapse is more frequent with culture-negative endocarditis (occurs less frequently during the course of the infection), is sustained for longer, and is more likely to be fatal.

translations.source: Wasafiri ambao walikuwa na wakati rahisi kuzoea utamaduni mpya wakati mwingine wana wakati mgumu wa kurekebisha upya utamaduni wao wa asili.
translations.reference: Travellers who had an easy time adjusting to the new culture sometimes have a particularly hard time readjusting to their native culture.
translations.hypothesis: Travellers who had an easy time adjusting to a new culture sometimes have a hard time readjusting to their native culture.

translations.source: Wakati wa kurudi nyumbani baada ya kuishi ughaibuni, umezoea utamaduni mpya na kupoteza baadhi ya tabia zako kutoka kwa utamaduni wako wa nyumbani.
translations.reference: When returning home after living abroad, you've adapted to the new culture and lost some of your habits from your home culture.
translations.hypothesis: When you go back home after living in diaspora, you realise you're not as connected to your roots as you thought you were.

translations.source: Wakati ulienda ng’ambo kwa mara ya kwanza, watu walikuwa pengine na subira na kuelewa, wakijua wasafiri katika nchi ya kigeni, wanahitaji kuzoea.
translations.reference: When you went abroad at first, people were probably patient and understanding, knowing that travellers in a new country need to adapt.
translations.hypothesis: When you go to a foreign country for the first time, people are usually patient and understanding, knowing that foreigners need time to get used to things.

translations.source: Huenda watu wasitarajie kwamba uvumilivu na ufahamu pia ni muhimu kwa wasafiri wanaorudi nyumbani.
translations.reference: People may not anticipate that patience and understanding are also necessary for travellers returning home.
translations.hypothesis: People may not expect that patience and understanding are also necessary for returningees.

translations.source: Sauti ya piramidi na onyesho la nuru ni mojawapo ya mambo yanayofurahisha zaidi katika eneo la watoto.
translations.reference: The pyramid sound and light show is one of the most interesting things in the area for kids.
translations.hypothesis: The Sound and Light Show at the Giza Pyramids is one of the most amazing things to do in the area with kids.

translations.source: Unaweza kuona piramidi gizani na unaweza kuziona katika utulivu kabla ya maonyesho kuanza.
translations.reference: You can see the pyramids in the dark and you can see them in silence before the show begins.
translations.hypothesis: You can see the pyramids in the dark and you can see them in peace before the shows begin.

translations.source: Kwa kawaida huwa unasikia sauti ya watalii na wauzaji. Hadithi ya sauti na mwanga ni kama kitabu cha hadithi.
translations.reference: Usually you always here the sound of tourists and vendors. The story of the sound and light is just like a story book.
translations.hypothesis: You usually hear the voices of the tour guide and the driver. The audio tour is like an audiobook.

translations.source: Sphinx amewekwa kama usuli na msimulizi wa hadithi ndefu.
translations.reference: The Sphinx is set as the backdrop and the narrator of a long story.
translations.hypothesis: The Sphinx is set up as the background and the narrator of the long story.

translations.source: Matuko yanaonyeshwa kwenye piramidi na piramidi tofauti huangaza.
translations.reference: The scenes are displayed on the pyramids and the different pyramids are lit up.
translations.hypothesis: The glyphs are displayed on a pyramid and different pyramids light up.

translations.source: Visiwa vya kusini mwa Shetlandi, vilivyogunduliwa mnamo 1819, vinadaiwa kuwa milki ya mataifa kadhaa na vina misingi mingi, ikiwemo kumi na sita iliyo hai mnamo 2020.
translations.reference: South Shetland Islands, discovered in 1819, are claimed by several nations and have the most bases, with sixteen active in 2020.
translations.hypothesis: The South Shetland Islands, discovered in 1819, are claimed by several nations and have many bases, including sixteen active as of 2020.

translations.source: Visiwa vimo kilomita 120 kaskazini mwa Rasi. Kubwa zaidi ni Kisiwa cha King George kilicho na makazi ya Villa Las Estrellas.
translations.reference: The archipelago lies 120 km north of the Peninsula. The largest is King George Island with the settlement of Villa Las Estrellas.
translations.hypothesis: The islands are located 120 km (75 mi) north of the Cape. The largest is King George Island which hosts the Villa Las Estrellas settlement.

translations.source: Vingine ni pamoja na Kisiwa cha Livingston, na Udanganyifu, ambapo kaldera iliyofurika ya volkano hai hutoa bandari asili ya kipekee.
translations.reference: Others include Livingston Island, and Deception where the flooded caldera of a still-active volcano provides a spectacular natural harbour.
translations.hypothesis: Others include Livingston Island and Deception Island, where the flooded caldera of an active volcano provides a unique natural harbour.

translations.source: Ellsworth Land ni mkoa kusini mwa Peninsula, unaopakana na Bahari la Bellingshausen.
translations.reference: Ellsworth Land is the region south of the Peninsula, bounded by the Bellingshausen Sea.
translations.hypothesis: Ellsworth Land is a region in Antarctica, a peninsula that extends from the continent towards the Bellingshausen Sea.

translations.source: Milima ya Peninsula hapa inajiunga na huu uwanda, kisha ikaibuka tena kuunda safu ya kilomita 360 ya Milima ya Ellsworth, na kugawanywa na Tungamo za barafu za Minnesota.
translations.reference: The mountains of the Peninsula here merge into the plateau, then re-emerge to form the 360 km chain of the Ellsworth Mountains, bisected by the Minnesota Glacier.
translations.hypothesis: The Peninsula Mountains here join this plateau, then rise again to form the 360-mile-long Ellsworth Mountains, split by the Minnesota Ice Tongue.

translations.source: Sehemu ya kaskazini au msafa wa Sentinel una milima mirefu zaidi ya Antaktika kama vile Vinson Massif, iliyofikia urefu wa 4892 na Mlima Vinson.
translations.reference: The northern part or Sentinel Range has Antarctica's highest mountains, the Vinson Massif, peaking at 4892 m Mount Vinson.
translations.hypothesis: The northernmost part of the continent or the Sentinel Range contains the highest mountains of Antarctica, such as the Vinson Massif, which reaches a height of 4,892 m (16,050 ft) at Vinson Peak.

translations.source: Katika sehemu za mbali, bila signali za simu za mkononi, simu ya setilaiti huenda ikawa chaguo lako la pekee.
translations.reference: In remote locations, without cell phone coverage, a satellite phone may be your only option.
translations.hypothesis: In remote areas, without cell phone coverage, a satellite phone may be your only option.

translations.source: Simu ya satelaiti sio kwa ujumla mbadala wa simu ya rununu, kwani lazima uwe nje wazi na kuona laini za satelaiti ili kupiga simu.
translations.reference: A satellite phone is not generally a replacement for a mobile phone, as you have to be outdoors with clear line of sight to the satellite to make a phone call.
translations.hypothesis: Satellite phones are not a general replacement for mobile phones, as you need to be in the line of sight of the satellite to make a call.

translations.source: Huduma hutumika mara kwa mara na usafirishaji, vikiwemo vyombo vya anasa, vilevile safari zilizo na mahitaji ya data na sauti ya mbali.
translations.reference: The service is frequently used by shipping, including pleasure craft, as well as expeditions who have remote data and voice needs.
translations.hypothesis: Services are used by everyone from frequent travelers and logistics companies to governments and broadcasters, and include everything from basic text messaging to high-bandwidth data and voice calls.

translations.source: Mtoaji wako wa huduma za simu anastahili aweze kutoa habari zaidi kuhusu kuunganishwa na huduma hii.
translations.reference: Your local telephone service provider should be able to give more information about connecting to this service.
translations.hypothesis: Your mobile service provider is the best source of information about connecting to this service.

translations.source: Uchaguzi unaozidi kuwa maarufu kwa wale wanaopanga pengo la mwaka mmoja ni kusafiri na kujifunza.
translations.reference: An increasingly more popular option for those planning a gap-year is to travel and learn.
translations.hypothesis: A growing number of people who take a year off to travel and learn are choosing to volunteer.

translations.source: Hii haswa ni maarufu kwa waliohitimu shuleni, ikiwaruhusu kukaa nje kwa mwaka mmoja kabla ya kuingia chuo kikuu, bila kuathiri masomo yao.
translations.reference: This is especially popular with school leavers, allowing them to take a year out before university, without compromising their education.
translations.hypothesis: This is particularly popular among school leavers, allowing them to spend a year out before starting university without affecting their studies.

translations.source: Katika hali nyingi, kujisajilisha kwa kozi mwaka-pengo ughaibuni kwa hakika kunaweza kuboresha nafasi zako za kuendeleza elimu ya juu katika nchi yako.
translations.reference: In many cases, enrolling on a gap-year course abroad can actually improve your chances of moving into higher education back in your home country.
translations.hypothesis: In most cases, enrolling in a course abroad can only improve your chances of getting a scholarship for further education in your home country.

translations.source: Kwa kawaida kutakuwa na ada ya mafunzo ili kujisajili katika mipango hii ya kielimu.
translations.reference: Typically there will be a tuition fee to enroll in these educational programs.
translations.hypothesis: There will usually be a fee for applying to these educational programmes.

translations.source: Ufini ni mahali pazuri pa uendeshaji mashua. “Nchi ya maziwa elfu” ina maelfu ya visiwa pia, katika maziwa na katika visiwa vya pwani.
translations.reference: Finland is a great boating destination. The "Land of a thousand lakes" has thousands of islands too, in the lakes and in the coastal archipelagos.
translations.hypothesis: Finland is a great place for canoeing. The "Land of a Thousand Lakes" has thousands of islands too, in the lakes and along the coast.

translations.source: Kwa funguvisiwa na visiwa sio lazima uhitaji meli.
translations.reference: In the archipelagos and lakes you do not necessarily need a yacht.
translations.hypothesis: For the mainland and islands you do not need a boat.

translations.source: Ingawa visiwa vya pwani na maziwa makubwa zaidi kwa kweli ni makubwa kutosha kwa mashua yoyote, boti ndogo ama hata kayaki hutoa uzoefu tofauti.
translations.reference: Although the coastal archipelagos and the biggest lakes are indeed big enough for any yacht, smaller boats or even a kayak offer a different experience.
translations.hypothesis: While the main islands and lakes are easily accessible by any boat, canoe or kayak, they offer a different experience.

translations.source: Kuendesha mashua ni mchezo wa kimataifa nchini Finland, na mashua kwa kila watu saba au nane.
translations.reference: Boating is a national pastime in Finland, with a boat to every seven or eight people.
translations.hypothesis: Boating is a national sport in Finland, with a boat for every seven or eight people.

translations.source: Hii inaendana na Norway, Sweden na Nyuzilandi, lakini vinginevyo ni tofauti kabisa (kwa mfano katika Uholanzi takwimu ni moja kwa arobaini).
translations.reference: This is matched by Norway, Sweden and New Zealand, but otherwise quite unique (e.g. in the Netherlands the figure is one to forty).
translations.hypothesis: This is comparable to Norway, Sweden and New Zealand, but otherwise much higher (in the Netherlands the figure is 1 in 40).

translations.source: Nyingi ya safari za Baltic huwa na kukaa kwa muda mrefu katika St. Petersburg, Urusi.
translations.reference: Most of the distinct Baltic Cruises feature an extended stay in St. Petersburg, Russia.
translations.hypothesis: Most Baltic cruises include an overnight stay in St. Petersburg, Russia.

translations.source: Hii ina maana kuwa unaweza kulitembelea jiji la kihistoria kwa kutwa kadhaa huku ukirudi na kulala kwenye meli wakati wa usiku.
translations.reference: This means you can visit the historic city for a couple of full days while returning and sleeping on the ship at night.
translations.hypothesis: This means that you can explore a historic city for a few days while using a boat as your hotel.

translations.source: Ikiwa huwa unaenda ufukweni tu ukitumia safari za meli hutahitaji visa tofauti (kufikia mwaka wa 2009).
translations.reference: If you only go ashore using shipboard excursions you will not need a separate visa (as of 2009).
translations.hypothesis: If you are only going to the beach using the regular ferry service you do not need a special permit (as of 2009).

translations.source: Baadhi ya safari za baharini huonyesha Berlin na Ujerumani katika brosha zao. Kama unavyoona katika ramani iliyo hapo juu, Berlin haipo popote karibu na bahari na safari ya jiji hili haijumuishwi katika bei ya safari za baharini.
translations.reference: Some cruises feature Berlin, Germany in the brochures. As you can see from the map above Berlin is no where near the sea and a visit to the city is not included in the price of the cruise.
translations.hypothesis: Some cruises feature Berlin and Germany in their itineraries. As you can see in the map above, Berlin is not located near any sea and a city tour is not included in the regular cruise prices.

translations.source: Kusafiri kwa ndege kunaweza kuwa uzoefu wa kuogofya kwa watu wa umri na malezi yote, hasa kama hawajasafiri kwa ndege tena au walipatwa na tukio la kufadhaisha.
translations.reference: Travelling by plane can be a scary experience for people of all ages and backgrounds, particularly if they've not flown before or have experienced a traumatic event.
translations.hypothesis: Flying can be an anxiety-provoking experience for people of all ages and backgrounds, especially for those who do not travel by air frequently or have had a negative experience in the past.

translations.source: Si jambo la kuaibikia: si tofauti sana na hofu ya kibinafsi na isiyopenda vitu vingine ambayo watu wengi wako nayo.
translations.reference: It is not something to be ashamed of: it is no different from the personal fears and dislikes of other things that very many people have.
translations.hypothesis: There's nothing to be ashamed of: it's no different from other personal and lifestyle choices that many people have.

translations.source: Kwa wengine, kuelewa jinsi ndege inavyofanya kazi na kinachotokea wakati wa ndege kuruka inaweza kusaidia kushinda hofu ambayo msingi wake ni mambo yasiyojulikana ama kutokuwa kwenye udhibiti.
translations.reference: For some, understanding something about how aircraft work and what happens during a flight may help to overcome a fear which is based on the unknown or on not being in control.
translations.hypothesis: For others, understanding how the drone works and what the process is for a drone flight can help overcome an anxiety that is based on the unknown or a fear of losing control.

translations.source: Kampuni za uchukuzi hulipwa vizuri kwa kufikisha vitu haraka. Mara kwa mara, muda ni muhimu sana kwa hati za kibiashara, bidhaa, au vipuli kwa ukarabati wa haraka.
translations.reference: Courier companies are well paid for delivering things quickly. Frequently, time is very important with business documents, merchandise or spare parts for an urgent repair.
translations.hypothesis: The logistics companies are well paid for the speed with which they deliver. Often, time is of the essence for commercial documents, goods, or even organs for medical procedures.

translations.source: Katika baadhi ya njia, kampuni kubwa zina ndege zao wenyewe, lakini kwa njia nyingine na kampuni ndogo kulikuwa na shida.
translations.reference: On some routes, the larger companies have their own planes, but for other routes and smaller firms there was a problem.
translations.hypothesis: In some ways, the big companies had their own planes, but for other ways and smaller companies it was a problem.

translations.source: Kama wangetuma vitu kwa mizigo ya ndege, katika baadhi ya njia huenda ingechukua siku kadhaa kukamilisha upakuaji na forodha.
translations.reference: If they sent things by air freight, on some routes it may have taken days to get through unloading and customs.
translations.hypothesis: If they were to ship items via air freight, it could take several days to complete the customs clearance and delivery.

translations.source: Njia pekee ya kuipitisha kwa haraka ilikuwa kuituma kama mzigo uliokaguliwa. Kanuni za kampuni za ndege hazitazikubalia kutuma mzigo bila abiria, ambapo ndipo unaingilia.
translations.reference: The only way to get it through faster was to send it as checked luggage. Airline regulations will not allow them to send luggage without a passenger, which is where you come in.
translations.hypothesis: The only way to get it across quickly was to send it as air freight. The airline companies' policies do not permit the carriage of unaccompanied goods, where you come in.

translations.source: Njia dhahiri ya kusafiri katika daraja la kwanza au kibiashara ni kutoa pesa nyingi kwa fursa hiyo (au, bora zaidi, kufanya kampuni yako ikulipie).
translations.reference: The obvious way of flying in first or business class is to fork out a thick wad of money for the privilege (or, better yet, get your company to do it for you).
translations.hypothesis: The most obvious way to travel in first class or business is to pay a lot more money for the privilege (or, better yet, get your company to pay for it).

translations.source: Walakini, hii haikuji kwa bei rahisi: kwa sababu ya sheria mbaya zisizobainika, unaweza kutarajia kulipa hadi mara nne ya kawaida ya uchumi, nauli ya biashara, na mara 11 kwa cheo cha kwanza!
translations.reference: However, this does not come cheap: as rough rules of thumb, you can expect to pay up to four times the normal economy fare for business, and eleven times for first class!
translations.hypothesis: However, this does not come cheap: due to unfavourable exchange rates, you can expect to pay up to four times more than the actual economic cost, and up to eleven times more for first class!

translations.source: Kuongea kwa jumla, hakuna haja ya hata kutafuta vipunguzo kwa biashara au viti vya daraja la kwanza katika safari za ndege za moja kwa moja toka A hadi B.
translations.reference: Generally speaking, there is no point in even looking for discounts for business or first-class seats on direct flights from A to B.
translations.hypothesis: In general, there is no need to book in advance for business or first class seats on direct A to B flights.

translations.source: Kampuni za ndege zinajua vizuri kwamba kuna kundi fulani la ndani la wasafiri ambao wako tayari kulipa pesa nyingi kwa haki ya kufika mahali kwa haraka na kwa starehe, na wanabadilisha ipasavyo.
translations.reference: Airlines know well that there is a certain core group of flyers who are willing to pay top dollar for the privilege of getting somewhere fast and in comfort, and charge accordingly.
translations.hypothesis: Airlines know very well that there is a certain segment of the population that is willing to pay a premium for the privilege of getting somewhere quickly and in comfort, and they cater to that segment.

translations.source: Mji mkuu wa Moldova ni Chisinau. Lugha ya ndani ni Kiroma, lakini Kirusi inatumika sana.
translations.reference: The capital of Moldova is Chişinău. The local language is Romanian, but Russian is widely used.
translations.hypothesis: The capital of Moldova is Chisinau. The official language is Romanian, but Russian is widely spoken.

translations.source: Moldova ni taifa lenye makabila mngi ambayo yameteseka kutokana na migogoro ya kikabila.
translations.reference: Moldova is a multi-ethnic republic that has suffered from ethnic conflict.
translations.hypothesis: Moldova is a multi-ethnic state that has suffered from ethnic conflicts.

translations.source: Mnamo 1994, migogoro hii ilipelekea kuundwa na kujitangaza kwa Taifa la Transnistria mashariki mwa Moldova, ambalo lina serikali na sarafu yake, lakini halitambuliwa na taifa lolote wanachama wa Umoja wa Mataifa.
translations.reference: In 1994, this conflict led to the creation of the self-proclaimed Transnistria Republic in eastern Moldova, which has its own government and currency but is not recognised by any UN member country.
translations.hypothesis: In 1994, these conflicts led to the creation and self-declaration of Transnistria, a breakaway republic in eastern Moldova, which has its own government and currency, but is not recognised by any UN member states.

translations.source: Viungo vya kiuchumi vimeanzishwa tena kati ya sehemu hizi mbili za Moldova licha ya kutofaulu kwa majadiliano ya kisiasa.
translations.reference: Economic links have been re-established between these two parts of Moldova despite the failure in political negotiations.
translations.hypothesis: Economic links between these two parts of Moldova have been restored despite the lack of political progress.

translations.source: Dini kuu katika Moldova ni Ukristo wa Kiorthodoksi.
translations.reference: The major religion in Moldova is Orthodox Christian.
translations.hypothesis: The predominant religion in Moldova is Eastern Orthodox Christianity.

translations.source: Izmir ni mji wa tatu kwa ukubwa nchini Uturuki na idadi ya watu ya takribani milioni 3.7, bandari ya pili kwa ukubwa baada ya Istanbul, na kitovu kizuri sana cha uchukuzi.
translations.reference: İzmir is the third largest city in Turkey with a population of around 3.7 million, the second biggest port after Istanbul, and a very good transport hub.
translations.hypothesis: Izmir is Turkey's third most populous city, with a population of about 3.7 million, the country's second-largest port after Istanbul, and a major transportation hub.

translations.source: Uliokuwa mji wa kale wa Smyma, sasa ni wa kisasa, ulioendelea, na wa kibiashara wenye shughuli nyingi, ulioewekwa kuzunguka kituo kikubwa na umezungukwa na milima.
translations.reference: Once the ancient city of Smyrna, it is now a modern, developed, and busy commercial center, set around a huge bay and surrounded by mountains.
translations.hypothesis: Once an ancient city, Smyrna is now a modern, developed, and busy commercial center, set around a large natural harbor and backed by mountains.

translations.source: Njia pana, majengo yenye vioo sehemu za mbele na vituo vya kisasa vya kibiashara vimejaa paa za vigae vyekundu vya jadi, soko la karne ya 18, misikiti na makanisa ya zamani, ingawa jiji lenyewe lina anga ya Uropa kuliko Uturuki ya jadi.
translations.reference: The broad boulevards, glass-fronted buildings and modern shopping centers are dotted with traditional red-tiled roofs, the 18th century market, and old mosques and churches, although the city has an atmosphere more of Mediterranean Europe than traditional Turkey.
translations.hypothesis: The broad streets, buildings with bay windows and modern commercial centres are combined with traditional red-tiled roofs, an 18th-century marketplace, mosques and ancient churches, though the city itself has more of a European than a traditional Turkish feel.

translations.source: Kijiji cha Haldarsvik kina mtazamo wa kisiwa kilicho karibu cha Eysturoi na kina kanisa lenye umbo lisilo la kawaida la pembe nane.
translations.reference: The village of Haldarsvík offer views of the nearby island Eysturoy and has an unusual octagonal church.
translations.hypothesis: The village of Haldorsvik has a view over the neighbouring island of Eysturoy and has a church with a unique eight-sided design.

translations.source: Katika uwanja wa kanisa, kuna vinyago vya kuvutia vya marumaru vya njiwa juu ya kaburi.
translations.reference: In the churchyard, there are interesting marble sculptures of doves over some tombs.
translations.hypothesis: In the churchyard there are interesting tombs with epitaphs.

translations.source: Inafaa nusu saa kutembeatembea katika kijiji hicho ambacho kinavutia.
translations.reference: It's worth half an hour to stroll about the intriguing village.
translations.hypothesis: It is worth spending half a day to stroll around this picturesque village.

translations.source: Upande wa kaskazini na mahali rahisi kufika kuna mji wa mahaba na wa kuvutia, uliofanywa maarufu na wageni baada ya kusimulia mapambo yake ya kung'aa kama yalivyorekodiwa na Lord Byron.
translations.reference: To the north and within easy reach is the romantic and fascinating town of Sintra and which was made famous to foreigners after a glowing account of its splendours recorded by Lord Byron.
translations.hypothesis: The north side and the easiest to access is the town of Ios, a vibrant and picturesque town, made famous by visitors after Lord Byron recited its praises.

translations.source: Basi la Skotabu 403 husafiri mara kwa mara hadi Sintra, na kusimama Kabo da Roka.
translations.reference: Scotturb Bus 403 travels regularly to Sintra, stopping at Cabo da Roca.
translations.hypothesis: The 403 bus regularly goes to Sintra, stopping at Cabo da Roca.

translations.source: Pia upande wa kaskazini tembelea Hekalu la Mama Yetu Fatima (Madhabahu), mahali maarufu duniani pa maonyesho ya Maria.
translations.reference: Also to the north visit the great Sanctuary of Our Lady of Fatima (Shrine), a place of worldwide famous Marian apparitions.
translations.hypothesis: Also in the north is the Sanctuary of Our Lady of Fatima, the world-renowned site of Marian apparitions.

translations.source: Tafadhali kumbuka kuwa hasa unatembelea mahali penye kaburi la watu wengi, na pia mahali ambapo pana maana isiyoweza kutabiriwa kwa sehemu kubwa ya idadi ya watu ulimwenguni.
translations.reference: Please remember that you are essentially visiting a mass grave site, as well as a site that has an almost incalculable meaning to a significant portion of the world's population.
translations.hypothesis: Please keep in mind that you are visiting the final resting place of many people, and also a place that holds great significance for a large segment of the world's population.

translations.source: Kungali kuna wanaume na wanawake wengi walio hai walioishi muda wao hapa, na wengine wengi ambao wapendwa wao waliuawa au walifanyishwa kazi hadi kufa, Wayahudi na wasio Wayahudi vilevile.
translations.reference: There are still many men and women alive who survived their time here, and many more who had loved ones who were murdered or worked to death there, Jews and non-Jews alike.
translations.hypothesis: There are still many survivors alive today, and many more who have lost loved ones, both Jewish and non-Jewish.

translations.source: Tafadhali tendea mahali hapo kwa hadhi yote, utaratibu na heshima inayostahiki. Usifanye utani juu ya Maangamizo au Wanazi.
translations.reference: Please treat the site with all of the dignity, solemnity and respect it deserves. Do not make jokes about the Holocaust or Nazis.
translations.hypothesis: Please treat the place with all due respect, decorum and dignity. Do not make light of the Holocaust or Nazis.

translations.source: Usiumbue tovuti kwa kuashiria au kukata michoro kwenye miundo.
translations.reference: Do not deface the site by marking or scratching graffiti into structures.
translations.hypothesis: Don't build websites by drawing or sketching on paper.

translations.source: Lugha rasmi za Baselona Kikatalani na Kihispania. Takribani nusu yao wanapendelea kuongea Kikatalani, idadi kubwa wanaielewa, na karibu kila mtu anajua Kihispania.
translations.reference: Barcelona's official languages are Catalan and Spanish. About a half prefer to speak Catalan, a vast majority understands it, and virtually everyone knows Spanish.
translations.hypothesis: The official languages of Barcelona are Catalan and Spanish. About half of them prefer to speak Catalan, a large minority speak Spanish, and almost everyone understands Spanish.

translations.source: Hata hivyo, ishara nyingi huonyeshwa kwa Kikatalani kwa sababu imewekwa kisheria kama lugha rasmi ya kwanza.
translations.reference: However, most signs are indicated only in Catalan because it is established by law as the first official language.
translations.hypothesis: However, many signs are also in Catalan because it is an official language.

translations.source: Kihispania bado hutumika sana katika uchukuzi wa umma na maeneo mengine.
translations.reference: Yet, Spanish is also widely used in public transport and other facilities.
translations.hypothesis: Spanish is still widely used in public transportation and other areas.

translations.source: Matangazo ya mara kwa mara katika Metro hufanywa tu kwa Kitalani, lakini usumbufu usiopangwa hutangazwa kwa mifumo otomatiki kwa kutumia lugha mbalimbali zikiwemo Kihispania, Kiingereza, Kifaransa, Kiarabu na Kijapanisi.
translations.reference: Regular announcements in the Metro are made only in Catalan, but unplanned disruptions are announced by an automated system in a wide variety of languages including Spanish, English, French, Arabic and Japanese.
translations.hypothesis: Announcements on the Metro are only made in Korean, but automated announcements are made in several languages including Spanish, English, French, Arabic, and Japanese.

translations.source: Waparisi wana sifa ya kujipenda, jeuri na wenye kiburi.
translations.reference: Parisians have a reputation for being egocentric, rude and arrogant.
translations.hypothesis: The Parisians are characterized by their charm, their elegance and their sense of style.

translations.source: Wakati hii mara nyingi ni aina ya dhana tu isiyofaa, njia nzuri ya kupatana kule Paris bado ni kuwa katika tabia yako njema, kufanya kama mtu ambaye ni “bien e’lev’e” (amelelewa vizuri). Itafanya kupatana rahisi mno.
translations.reference: While this is often only an inaccurate stereotype, the best way to get along in Paris still is to be on your best behavior, acting like someone who is "bien élevé" (well brought up). It will make getting about considerably easier.
translations.hypothesis: While this is often just a polite formality, a good way to go about meeting someone in Paris is still to be on your best behaviour, acting like someone who is "bien élevé" (well-bred). It will make networking much easier.

translations.source: Umbo za nje za ghafla za Parisiani zitayeyuka haraka ikiwa unaonyesha ustahifu kadhaa za kimsingi.
translations.reference: Parisians' abrupt exteriors will rapidly evaporate if you display some basic courtesies.
translations.hypothesis: The outer layers of the Parisian shape will quickly melt if you show any basic signs of attraction.

translations.source: Mbuga ya Kitaifa ya Plitvice Lakes ina misitu sana, hususan mifune, misonobari, na miti ya misonobari, na mchanganyiko wa uoto wa safu ya milima ya Alp na mediterania.
translations.reference: The Plitvice Lakes national park is heavily forested, mainly with beech, spruce, and fir trees, and features a mixture of Alpine and Mediterranean vegetation.
translations.hypothesis: Plitvice Lakes National Park is heavily forested, with a high percentage of beech, fir, spruce and pine trees, and a mixed stock of alpine and Mediterranean flora.

translations.source: Ina aina anuwai za jamii za mimea, kutokana na masafa yake ya hali ndogondogo za anga, mchanga tofauti na kutofautiana kwa viwango vya urefu.
translations.reference: It has a notably wide variety of plant communities, due to its range of microclimates, differing soils and varying levels of altitude.
translations.hypothesis: It has a great diversity of plant communities, due to the wide range of climatic conditions, soils and the resulting variation in elevation.

translations.source: Eneo hilo pia ni nyumbani mwa aina nyingi sana mbalimbali za spishi za wanyama na ndege.
translations.reference: The area is also home to an extremely wide variety of animal and bird species.
translations.hypothesis: The area is also home to a wide variety of amphibian and reptile species.

translations.source: Wanyama nadra kama vile Dubu wa hudhurungi wa Ulaya, mbwa mwitu, tai, bundi, simba-mangu, paka mwitu na kware wa Ulaya wanaweza kupatikana huko, pamoja na spishi nyingine nyingi za kawaida.
translations.reference: Rare fauna such as the European brown bear, wolf, eagle, owl, lynx, wild cat and capercaillie can be found there, along with many more common species
translations.hypothesis: Rare animals such as the European bison, wolves, lynx, bears, wolverines, wild cats and European beavers can be found there, as well as many other common species.

translations.source: Wakati wa kutembelea nyumba za watawa, wanawake wanatarajiwa kuvaa sketi zinazofunika magoti na pia wafunike mabega yao.
translations.reference: While visiting the monasteries, women are required to wear skirts covering the knees and have their shoulders covered, too.
translations.hypothesis: When visiting temples, women are expected to wear skirts that cover their knees and also cover their shoulders.

translations.source: Nyingi za monasteri hutoa kanga kwa wanawake wanaokuja bila, lakini ukija na kanga yako, haswa iliyo na rangi kali, utapata tabasamu kutoka kwa monaki au sista kwenye kiingilio.
translations.reference: Most of the monasteries do provide wraps for women who come unprepared, but if you bring your own, especially one with bright colors, you'll get a smile from the monk or nun at the entrance.
translations.hypothesis: Most monasteries provide robes for women visitors who do not bring their own, but if you bring your own robe, especially a brightly colored one, you will be given a warmer welcome by the monks or nuns at the entrance.

translations.source: Vile vile, wanaume wanahitajika kuvaa suruali zinazofunika magoti.
translations.reference: Along the same line, men are required to wear trousers covering the knees.
translations.hypothesis: Men are also required to wear trousers that cover the knees.

translations.source: Hii pia inaweza kuombwa kutoka kwa akiba kwenye lango lakini nguo hizo hazifuliwi baada ya kila mtumiaji kwa hivyo huenda usijihisi mwenye starehe unapovaa sketi hizo. Saizi moja hutosha wote kwa wanaume!
translations.reference: This too can be borrowed from the stock at the entrance but that clothing isn't washed after every user so you may not feel comfortable wearing these skirts. One size fits all for men!
translations.hypothesis: This can also be obtained from the lobby but the clothes are not washed after each user so you may not be comfortable wearing them. One size fits most men!

translations.source: Vyakula vya Majokan, kama vile vya sehemu nyingine kwenye kanda ya bahari ya Mediterranean, vimetengenezwa kwa mkate, mboga na nyama (hasa ya nguruwe), na hutumia mafuta ya mizeituni nyakati zote.
translations.reference: Majorcan cuisine, like that of similar zones in the Mediterranean, is based on bread, vegetables and meat (specially pork), and uses olive oil throughout.
translations.hypothesis: Cypriot cuisine, like that of other parts of the Mediterranean, is based on bread, vegetables and meat (mainly pork), and uses olive oil abundantly.

translations.source: Chakula rahisi cha jioni, hasa wakati wa kiangazi, huwa ni Pa ambi Oli: Mkate wa mafuta ya mizeituni, nyanya, na viungo vingine vinavyopatikana kama vile jibini na samakituna.
translations.reference: A simple popular dinner, especially during the summer, is the Pa amb Oli: Bread with olive oil, tomato, and any available condiments such as cheese, tunafish, etc.
translations.hypothesis: A simple dinner, especially in summer, is often Pa amb Olio: pasta with olive oil, tomatoes, and other available ingredients such as cheese or tuna.

translations.source: Nomino zote, ikiwemo Sie kwa wewe, daima huanza kwa herufi kubwa, hata katika katikati mwa sentensi.
translations.reference: All nouns, alongside the word Sie for you, always begin with a capital letter, even in the middle of a sentence.
translations.hypothesis: All nouns, including Sie and you, are always capitalised, even in the middle of a sentence.

translations.source: Hii ni njia muhimu ya kutofautisha kati ya baadhi ya vitenzi na vitu.
translations.reference: This is an important way to distinguish between some verbs and objects.
translations.hypothesis: This is an important distinction from some other actions.

translations.source: Pia bila shaka inafanya kusoma rahisi, ingawa kuandika kwa kiasi fulani ni ngumu kwa haja ya kutaka kujua kama kitenzi au kivumishi kinatumika kwa umuhimu.
translations.reference: It also arguably makes reading easier, though writing is somewhat complicated by the need to find out whether a verb or adjective is used in a substantivized form.
translations.hypothesis: It also makes reading much easier, although the writing is slightly more difficult because you have to decide which case the nouns and adjectives need to be in.

translations.source: Matamshi ni rahisi kiasi kwa Kiitaliano kwani maneno mengi hutamkwa hasa yalivyoandikwa
translations.reference: Pronunciation is relatively easy in Italian since most words are pronounced exactly how they are written
translations.hypothesis: The pronunciation is relatively easy for Italians as words are pronounced much as they are written.

translations.source: Herufi muhimu za kuzingatia ni c na g, kwani matamshi yake hubadilika kulingana na vokali inayofuata.
translations.reference: The main letters to watch out for are c and g, since their pronunciation varies based on the following vowel.
translations.hypothesis: The key letters to keep in mind are c and g, as their pronunciation changes depending on the following vowel.

translations.source: Pia, hakikisha kutamka r na rr tofauti: caro inamaanisha mpenzi, ilhali carro inamaanisha gari la kuvurutwa na farasi.
translations.reference: Also, make sure to pronounce r and rr differently: caro means dear, whereas carro means chariot.
translations.hypothesis: Also, be careful to pronounce r and rr differently: caro means dear, while carro means carriage.

translations.source: Kiajemi ina sarufi rahisi kiasi, na mara nyingi ya kawaida.
translations.reference: Persian has a relatively easy and mostly regular grammar.
translations.hypothesis: Modern Persian has a relatively simple, regular grammar.

translations.source: Kwa hivyo, kusoma chanzo hiki cha sarufi kutakusaidia wewe kujifunza mengi kuhusu sarufi ya Kiajemi na kuelewa bora zaidi.
translations.reference: Therefore, reading this grammar primer would help you learn much about Persian grammar and understand phrases better.
translations.hypothesis: Thus, reading this book will help you learn a lot about Persian grammar and improve your understanding of the language.

translations.source: Bila haja ya kusema, ikiwa unaifahamu lugha ya mahaba, itakuwa rahisi kwako kujifunza Kireno.
translations.reference: Needless to say, if you know a Romance language, it will be easier for you to learn Portuguese.
translations.hypothesis: Unsurprisingly, if you know the language of love, it will be easy for you to learn Italian.

translations.source: Hata hivyo, watu wanaofahamu Kihispania kidogo wanaweza kuhitimisha kwa haraka kuwa Kireno kinakaribiana sana na kwamba hakihitaji kusomwa kando.
translations.reference: However, people who know a little Spanish may hastily conclude that Portuguese is close enough that it need not be studied separately.
translations.hypothesis: However, people with a little knowledge of Spanish can often guess the general meaning, and the Basque language is not very different from Spanish.

translations.source: Uchunguzi kabla ya kisasa kwa kawaida hautumiki leo, na hubaki kama makavazi, ama sehemu za elimu.
translations.reference: Pre-modern observatories are usually obsolete today, and remain as museums, or sites of education.
translations.hypothesis: The pre-modern Inquisition is generally not considered a witch hunt, and remains a subject of academic debate.

translations.source: Kwani uchafuzi wa mwanga nyakati zao haukuwa shida kama ilivyo leo, mara nyingi wako mijini au katikavyuo vikuu, rahisi kufikia kuliko zile zimejengwa siku za kisasa.
translations.reference: As light pollution in their heyday was not the kind of problem it is today, they are usually located in cities or at campuses, easier to reach than those built in modern times.
translations.hypothesis: Because light pollution was not an issue in their time, they often lived in rural or suburban areas, far from the bright lights of the cities and towns.

translations.source: Darubini nyingi za utafiti za kisasa ni vifaa kuu katika maeneo ya mbali yaliyo na hali nzuri za angahewa.
translations.reference: Most modern research telescopes are enormous facilities in remote areas with favorable atmospheric conditions.
translations.hypothesis: Many modern research telescopes are large instruments housed in observatories located at high altitude sites with dark skies and good weather conditions.

translations.source: Utazamaji wa maua ya cheri, inayojulikana kama hanami, imekuwa sehemu ya utamaduni wa Kijapani tangu karne ya 8.
translations.reference: Cherry blossom viewing, known as hanami, has been a part of Japanese culture since the 8th century.
translations.hypothesis: Cherry blossom viewing, known as hanami, has been a part of Japanese culture since the 8th century.

translations.source: Dhana hiyo ilitoka Uchina ambapo maua ya plamu ndiyo yaliyokuwa maua yaliyopendelewa.
translations.reference: The concept came from China where plum blossoms were the flower of choice.
translations.hypothesis: The concept comes from China, where the plum blossom is the national flower.

translations.source: Huko Japani, sherehe za kwanza za maua ya mcheri ziliandaliwa na maliki kwa ajili yake mwenyewe na washiriki wengine wa upatanishi waliozunguka Mahakama ya Imperi.
translations.reference: In Japan, the first cherry blossom parties were hosted by the emperor only for himself and other members of the aristocracy around the Imperial Court.
translations.hypothesis: In Japan, the earliest cherry blossom viewing parties were given by the Imperial Court and other aristocrats in the Heian period.

translations.source: Mimea inaonekana bora ikiwa katika mazingira ya asili, kwa hivyo epuka kishawishi cha kutoa hata kiolezo "kimoja tu".
translations.reference: Plants look their best when in a natural environment, so resist the temptation to remove even "just one" specimen.
translations.hypothesis: Plants look best when they are in their natural environment, so avoid the temptation to give them all the same "perfect" look.

translations.source: Ikiwa unatembelea bustani iliyopangwa rasmi, kukusanya “violezo” pia kutakufanya uodolewe, bila majadiliano.
translations.reference: If visiting a formally arranged garden, collecting "specimens" is also going to get you ejected, without discussion.
translations.hypothesis: If you are visiting a formally managed garden, collecting "souvenirs" of any kind is usually prohibited, without exception.

translations.source: Singapori kwa ujumla ni mahali salama zaidi kuwa na rahisi sana kuabiri, na unaweza kununua karibu chochote baada ya kuwasili.
translations.reference: Singapore is generally an extremely safe place to be and very easy to navigate, and you can buy almost anything after arriving.
translations.hypothesis: Singapore is generally a very safe place to be and easy to get around, and you can buy almost anything you need or want after you arrive.

translations.source: Lakini kwa kuwekwa katika “tropiki za juu” digrii chache tu kaskazini mwa istiwai utahitaji kukabiliana na joto jingi (kila wakati) na jua kali (wakati anga ni safi, nadra zaidi).
translations.reference: But being placed in the "high tropics" just a few degrees north of equator you will need to deal with both heat (always) and strong sun (when the sky is clear, more rarely).
translations.hypothesis: But being set just a few degrees north of the equator you have to put up with a lot of heat (all the time) and strong sunshine (when the sky is clear, which is most of the time).

translations.source: Pia kuna mabasi machache yanayoelekea kaskazini mwa Hebroni, mahali pa makaburi ya jadi ya mashujaa wa Biblia Abrahamu, Isaka, Yakobo, na wake zao.
translations.reference: There are also a few buses going north to Hebron, the traditional burial place of the Biblical patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and their wives.
translations.hypothesis: There are also a few buses heading north to Hebron, the traditional burial site of the biblical patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and their wives.

translations.source: Hakikisha kwamba basi unalofikiria kuabiri linaenda Hebron na si katika makazi ya karibu ya Kiyahudi ya Kiryat Arba tu.
translations.reference: Check that the bus you are thinking of taking goes into Hebron and not just to the nearby Jewish settlement of Kiryat Arba.
translations.hypothesis: Make sure the bus you board is headed to Hebron and not just to the nearby Jewish settlement of Kiryat Arba.

translations.source: Njia za maji za barani zinaweza kuwa mandhari mzuri ya kufanyia likizo.
translations.reference: Inland waterways can be a good theme to base a holiday around.
translations.hypothesis: The continent's waterways can be a relaxing way to see the sights.

translations.source: Kwa mfano, kutembelea ngome katika Bonde la Loire, Bonde la Rhine au kusafiri katika maeneo ya kuvutia kwa Danube au kusafiri kwa mashua upande wa Mfereji wa Erie.
translations.reference: For example visiting castles in the Loire Valley, the Rhine valley or taking a cruise to interesting cites on the Danube or boating along the Erie Canal.
translations.hypothesis: For example, touring castles in the Loire Valley, Rhine Valley or travelling through the Danube Delta or along the Erie Canal.

translations.source: Pia wao hufafanua njia maarufu za matembezi na uendeshaji baiskeli.
translations.reference: They also define routes for popular hiking and cycling trails.
translations.hypothesis: They also define popular routes for walking and cycling.

translations.source: Krismasi ni moja ya likizo muhimu zaidi ya Ukristo, na inaadhimishwa kama siku ya kuzaliwa kwa Yesu.
translations.reference: Christmas is one of the most important holidays of Christianity, and is celebrated as the birthday of Jesus.
translations.hypothesis: Christmas is one of the most important holidays in Christianity, and it is celebrated as the day of Jesus' birth.

translations.source: Nyingi za tamaduni zinazozunguka likizo zimesilikwa pia na wasioamini katika nchi za Kikristo na wasio Wakristo duniani kote.
translations.reference: Many of the traditions surrounding the holiday have been adopted also by non-believers in Christian countries and non-Christians around the world.
translations.hypothesis: Many of the customs surrounding the holidays have been adopted by non-Christian and secular populations around the world.

translations.source: Kuna desturi ya kukesha usiku wa Pasaka katika sehemu fulani wazi ili kuona jua likichomoza.
translations.reference: There's a tradition to pass the Easter night awake at some exposed point to see the sunrise.
translations.hypothesis: There is a custom in some places to camp out on Easter night in the open air to watch the sunrise.

translations.source: Kwa kweli kuna maelezo ya thiolojia ya Kikristo ya utamaduni huu, lakini pia huenda ikawa ibada ya Majira ya kuchipua na Uzazi kabla ya Ukristo.
translations.reference: There are of course Christian theological explanations for this tradition, but it may well be a pre-Christian Spring and Fertility ritual.
translations.hypothesis: There is certainly a Christian theological interpretation of this cultural event, but it possibly goes back to pre-Christian spring fertility rituals and celebrations of new life.

translations.source: Makanisa zaidi ya jadi huwa na Mkesha wa Pasaka usiku wa Jumamosi wakati wa wikendi ya Pasaka, waumini wakisherehekea saa sita kamili za usiku kuadhimisha ufufuo wa Kristo.
translations.reference: More traditional churches often hold an Easter Vigil on Saturday night during the Easter weekend, with the congregations often breaking into celebration at the stroke of midnight to celebrate Christ's resurrection.
translations.hypothesis: Some Christian denominations have a special Easter Vigil service on the night of Saturday before Easter Sunday, with the congregation spending several hours overnight to mark the resurrection of Jesus.

translations.source: Wanyama wote asili waliofika katika visiwa hivi walikuja hapa pengine kwa kuogelea, kupaa au kuelea.
translations.reference: All animals that originally arrived in the islands came here either by swimming, flying or floating.
translations.hypothesis: All native land animals on islands arrived there by swimming, flying, or floating.

translations.source: Kwa sababu ya masafa marefu kutoka kwa bara, mamalia walishindwa kumalize mwendo, huku mzee kobe jitu akiwa mnyama wa kimsingi mla nyasi katika Galapagosi.
translations.reference: Due to the long distance from the continent mammals were unable to make the journey making the giant tortoise the primary grazing animal in the Galapagos.
translations.hypothesis: Due to the long distance from the mainland, the mammals failed to evolve any large herbivores, with the giant tortoise being the largest herbivore in the Galapagos.

translations.source: Tangu kuwasili kwa mwanadamu katika Galapagos, mamalia wengi wamewasilishwa pamoja na mbuzi, farasi, ng'ombe, panya, paka na mbwa.
translations.reference: Since the arrival of man to the Galapagos, many mammals have been introduced including goats, horses, cows, rats, cats and dogs.
translations.hypothesis: Since the arrival of humans in the Galápagos, many mammals have been introduced along with goats, horses, cattle, pigs, cats, dogs and rats.

translations.source: Ukitembelea maeneo ya Aktiki na Antaktiki msimu wa baridi utapata tajriba ya usiku wa pola, ambayo ina maana kuwa jua halichomozi juu ya upeo wa macho.
translations.reference: If you visit the Arctic or Antarctic areas in the winter you will experience the polar night, which means that the sun doesn't rise above the horizon.
translations.hypothesis: If you visit the Arctic and Antarctic regions during winter you will experience the polar night, which means that the sun does not rise above the horizon.

translations.source: Hii inatoa fursa nzuri ya kuona mwanga wa Aurora, kwani anga itakuwa giza kwa kadiri fulani mchana na usiku.
translations.reference: This offers a good opportunity to see the Aurora borealis, as the sky will be dark more or less around the clock.
translations.hypothesis: This gives a good chance to see the Aurora, as the sky will be dark enough at night.

translations.source: Kwa kuwa maeneo hayo hayana idadi kubwa ya watu, na uchafuzi kidogo aghalabu huwa si tatizo, pia utaweza kufuruhia nyota.
translations.reference: As the areas are sparsely populated, and light pollution therefore often not a problem, you will also be able to enjoy the stars.
translations.hypothesis: Since these areas are far from any major population centres, and light pollution is minimal, you'll be able to enjoy the stars.

translations.source: Desturi ya kazi ya Kijapani ni ya kimfumo na rasmi kuliko mazoea ya Wanamagharibi.
translations.reference: Japanese work culture is more hierarchical and formal that what Westerners may be used to.
translations.hypothesis: Japanese work culture is more formal and hierarchical than Western work culture.

translations.source: Suti ni mavazi ya kawaida ya kibiashara, na wafanyikazi huita wenzao kwa majina ya familia zao au kwa majina ya kikazi.
translations.reference: Suits are standard business attire, and coworkers call each other by their family names or by job titles.
translations.hypothesis: Suits are the typical business attire, and employees refer to each other by their first names or nicknames.

translations.source: Ulinganifu katika mahali pa kazi ni muhimu, kusisitiza juhudi za vikundi badala ya kusifu mafanikio ya kibinafsi.
translations.reference: Workplace harmony is crucial, emphasizing group effort rather than praising individual accomplishments.
translations.hypothesis: Equity in the workplace is crucial, emphasising team efforts rather than individual achievements.

translations.source: Mara kwa mara wafanyakazi hupata kibali cha maamuzi yoyote wanayofanya kutoka kwa wasimamizi wao, na wanatarajiwa kutii maagizo ya wakuu wao bila maswali.
translations.reference: Workers must often get their superiors' approval for any decisions they make, and are expected to obey their superiors' instructions without question.
translations.hypothesis: Employees often receive approval for any decisions they make from their managers, and are expected to follow their bosses’ orders without question.
